verses.en: And the Lord called unto Moses, and spake unto him out of the tabernacle of the congregation, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel appela Moïse; de la tente d''assignation, il lui parla et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ሙሴን ጠርቶ እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, If any man of you bring an offering unto the Lord, ye shall bring your offering of the cattle, even of the herd, and of the flock.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis-leur: Lorsque quelqu''un d''entre vous fera une offrande à l''Eternel, il offrira du bétail, du gros ou du menu bétail.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራችው። ከእናንተ ማናቸውም ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር መባ ሲያቀርብ መባችሁን ከእንስሳ ወገን ከላሞች ወይም ከበጎች ታቀርባላችሁ።

verses.en: If his offering be a burnt sacrifice of the herd, let him offer a male without blemish: he shall offer it of his own voluntary will at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord.
verses.fr: Si son offrande est un holocauste de gros bétail, il offrira un mâle sans défaut; il l''offrira à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, devant l''Eternel, pour obtenir sa faveur.
verses.am: መባውም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከላሞች መንጋ ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባቱን ያቀርባል፤ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት እንዲሠምር በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ፊት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And he shall put his hand upon the head of the burnt offering; and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.
verses.fr: Il posera sa main sur la tête de l''holocauste, qui sera agréé de l''Eternel, pour lui servir d''expiation.
verses.am: እጁንም በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፤ ያስተሰርይለትም ዘንድ የሠመረ ይሆንለታል።

verses.en: And he shall kill the bullock before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall bring the blood, and sprinkle the blood round about upon the altar that is by the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Il égorgera le veau devant l''Eternel; et les sacrificateurs, fils d''Aaron, offriront le sang, et le répandront tout autour sur l''autel qui est à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: በሬውንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን ያቀርባሉ፤ ደሙንም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ፊት ባለው በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall flay the burnt offering, and cut it into his pieces.
verses.fr: Il dépouillera l''holocauste, et le coupera par morceaux.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት ይገፍፈዋል፥ በየብልቱም ይቈርጠዋል።

verses.en: And the sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire upon the altar, and lay the wood in order upon the fire:
verses.fr: Les fils du sacrificateur Aaron mettront du feu sur l''autel, et arrangeront du bois sur le feu.
verses.am: የካህኑም የአሮን ልጆች በመሠዊያው ላይ እሳት ያነድዳሉ፥ በእሳቱም ላይ እንጨት ይደረድራሉ፤

verses.en: And the priests, Aaron's sons, shall lay the parts, the head, and the fat, in order upon the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.fr: Les sacrificateurs, fils d''Aaron, poseront les morceaux, la tête et la graisse, sur le bois mis au feu sur l''autel.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ የተቈረቱትን ብልቶች ራሱንም ስቡንም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ይረበርቡታል፤

verses.en: But his inwards and his legs shall he wash in water: and the priest shall burn all on the altar, to be a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Il lavera avec de l''eau les entrailles et les jambes; et le sacrificateur brûlera le tout sur l''autel. C''est un holocauste, un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹን ግን በውኃ ያጥባል፤ ካህኑም ሁሉን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And if his offering be of the flocks, namely, of the sheep, or of the goats, for a burnt sacrifice; he shall bring it a male without blemish.
verses.fr: Si son offrande est un holocauste de menu bétail, d''agneaux ou de chèvres, il offrira un mâle sans défaut.
verses.am: ቍርባኑም የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከበጎች ወይም ከፍየሎች ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባቱን ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And he shall kill it on the side of the altar northward before the Lord: and the priests, Aaron's sons, shall sprinkle his blood round about upon the altar.
verses.fr: Il l''égorgera au côté septentrional de l''autel, devant l''Eternel; et les sacrificateurs, fils d''Aaron, en répandront le sang sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም አጠገብ በሰሜን ወገን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall cut it into his pieces, with his head and his fat: and the priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is upon the altar:
verses.fr: Il le coupera par morceaux; et le sacrificateur les posera, avec la tête et la graisse, sur le bois mis au feu sur l''autel.
verses.am: በየብልቱም ራሱንም ስቡንም ይቈርጠዋል፤ ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ይረበርበዋል፤

verses.en: But he shall wash the inwards and the legs with water: and the priest shall bring it all, and burn it upon the altar: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Il lavera avec de l''eau les entrailles et les jambes; et le sacrificateur sacrifiera le tout, et le brûlera sur l''autel. C''est un holocauste, un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹን ግን በውኃ ያጥባል። ካህኑም ሁሉን አቅርቦ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.en: And if the burnt sacrifice for his offering to the Lord be of fowls, then he shall bring his offering of turtledoves, or of young pigeons.
verses.fr: Si son offrande à l''Eternel est un holocauste d''oiseaux, il offrira des tourterelles ou de jeunes pigeons.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም የሚቀርበው ቍርባን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከወፎች ቢሆን፥ ቍርባኑን ከዋኖስ ወይም ከርግብ ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And the priest shall bring it unto the altar, and wring off his head, and burn it on the altar; and the blood thereof shall be wrung out at the side of the altar:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur sacrifiera l''oiseau sur l''autel; il lui ouvrira la tête avec l''ongle, et la brûlera sur l''autel, et il exprimera le sang contre un côté de l''autel.
verses.am: ካህኑም ወደ መሠዊያው ያቀርበዋል፥ ራሱንም ይቈለምመዋል፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ደሙም በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ይንጠፈጠፋል፤

verses.en: And he shall pluck away his crop with his feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, by the place of the ashes:
verses.fr: Il ôtera le jabot avec ses plumes, et le jettera près de l''autel, vers l''orient, dans le lieu où l''on met les cendres.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንም ከላባዎች ጋር ለይቶ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ በምሥራቅ ወገን በአመዱ ስፍራ ይጥለዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall cleave it with the wings thereof, but shall not divide it asunder: and the priest shall burn it upon the altar, upon the wood that is upon the fire: it is a burnt sacrifice, an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Il déchirera les ailes, sans les détacher; et le sacrificateur brûlera l''oiseau sur l''autel, sur le bois mis au feu. C''est un holocauste, un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: በክንፎቹም ይቀድደዋል፥ ነገር ግን አይከፍለውም። ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የእሳት ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.en: And when any will offer a meat offering unto the Lord, his offering shall be of fine flour; and he shall pour oil upon it, and put frankincense thereon:
verses.fr: Lorsque quelqu''un fera à l''Eternel une offrande en don, son offrande sera de fleur de farine; il versera de l''huile dessus, et il y ajoutera de l''encens.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው የእህል ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ሲያቀርብ ቍርባኑ ከመልካም ዱቄት ይሁን፤ ዘይትም ያፈስስበታል፥ ዕጣንም ይጨምርበታል፤

verses.en: And he shall bring it to Aaron's sons the priests: and he shall take thereout his handful of the flour thereof, and of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof; and the priest shall burn the memorial of it upon the altar, to be an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord:
verses.fr: Il l''apportera aux sacrificateurs, fils d''Aaron; le sacrificateur prendra une poignée de cette fleur de farine, arrosée d''huile, avec tout l''encens, et il brûlera cela sur l''autel comme souvenir. C''est une offrande d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ወደ አሮንም ልጆች ወደ ካህናቱ ያመጣዋል፤ ከመልካም ዱቄቱና ከዘይቱም አንድ እፍኝ ሙሉና ዕጣኑን ሁሉ ወስዶ ካህኑ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለመታሰቢያ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And the remnant of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.
verses.fr: Ce qui restera de l''offrande sera pour Aaron et pour ses fils; c''est une chose très sainte parmi les offrandes consumées par le feu devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእህሉም ቍርባን የተረፈው ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: And if thou bring an oblation of a meat offering baken in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mingled with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.
verses.fr: Si tu fais une offrande de ce qui est cuit au four, qu''on se serve de fleur de farine, et que ce soient des gâteaux sans levain pétris à l''huile et des galettes sans levain arrosées d''huile.
verses.am: በእቶን የተጋገረውን የእህል ቍርባን ስታቀርብ በዘይት የተለወሰ የመልካም ዱቄት የቂጣ እንጐቻ ወይም በዘይት የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ ይሁን።

verses.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in a pan, it shall be of fine flour unleavened, mingled with oil.
verses.fr: Si ton offrande est un gâteau cuit à la poêle, il sera de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile, sans levain.
verses.am: ቍርባንህም በምጣድ የተጋገረ የእህል ቍርባን ቢሆን፥ በዘይት የተለወሰ የመልካም ዱቄት ቂጣ ይሁን።

verses.en: Thou shalt part it in pieces, and pour oil thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.fr: Tu le rompras en morceaux, et tu verseras de l''huile dessus; c''est une offrande.
verses.am: ቈርሰህም ዘይት ታፈስስበታለህ፤ የእህል ቍርባን ነው።

verses.en: And if thy oblation be a meat offering baken in the fryingpan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.
verses.fr: Si ton offrande est un gâteau cuit sur le gril, il sera fait de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile.
verses.am: ቍርባንህም በመቀቀያ የበሰለ የእህል ቍርባን ቢሆን፥ ዘይት የገባበት ከመልካም ዱቄት የተደረገ ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt bring the meat offering that is made of these things unto the Lord: and when it is presented unto the priest, he shall bring it unto the altar.
verses.fr: Tu apporteras l''offrande qui sera faite à l''Eternel avec ces choses-là; elle sera remise au sacrificateur, qui la présentera sur l''autel.
verses.am: ከዚህም የተደረገውን የእህል ቍርባን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ታመጣለህ፤ ለካህኑም ይሰጣል፥ እርሱም ወደ መሠዊያው ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take from the meat offering a memorial thereof, and shall burn it upon the altar: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur en prélèvera ce qui doit être offert comme souvenir, et le brûlera sur l''autel. C''est une offrande d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከእህሉ ቍርባን መታሰቢያውን አንሥቶ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And that which is left of the meat offering shall be Aaron's and his sons': it is a thing most holy of the offerings of the Lord made by fire.
verses.fr: Ce qui restera de l''offrande sera pour Aaron et pour ses fils; c''est une chose très sainte parmi les offrandes consumées par le feu devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእህሉም ቍርባን የተረፈው ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሆናል፤ ይህም ለእግዚአብሔር የሚሆን የእሳት ቍርባን ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: No meat offering, which ye shall bring unto the Lord, shall be made with leaven: for ye shall burn no leaven, nor any honey, in any offering of the Lord made by fire.
verses.fr: Aucune des offrandes que vous présenterez à l''Eternel ne sera faite avec du levain; car vous ne brûlerez rien qui contienne du levain ou du miel parmi les offrandes consumées par le feu devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: እርሾ ያለበት ነገር ማርም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ይሆን ዘንድ አታቀርቡምና ለእግዚአብሔር የምታቀርቡት የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ እርሾ አይሁንበት።

verses.en: As for the oblation of the firstfruits, ye shall offer them unto the Lord: but they shall not be burnt on the altar for a sweet savour.
verses.fr: Vous pourrez en offrir à l''Eternel comme offrande des prémices; mais il n''en sera point présenté sur l''autel comme offrande d''une agréable odeur.
verses.am: እነዚህንም የበኵራት ቍርባን አድርጋችሁ ለእግዚአብሔር ታቀርባላችሁ፤ እንደ ጣፋጭ ሽታ ግን በመሠዊያው ላይ አይቃጠሉም።

verses.en: And every oblation of thy meat offering shalt thou season with salt; neither shalt thou suffer the salt of the covenant of thy God to be lacking from thy meat offering: with all thine offerings thou shalt offer salt.
verses.fr: Tu mettras du sel sur toutes tes offrandes; tu ne laisseras point ton offrande manquer de sel, signe de l''alliance de ton Dieu; sur toutes tes offrandes tu mettras du sel.
verses.am: የምታቀርበውን የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ በጨው ታጣፍጠዋለህ፤ የአምላክህንም ቃል ኪዳን ጨው ከእህል ቍርባንህ አታጐድልም፤ በቍርባንህ ሁሉ ላይ ጨው ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And if thou offer a meat offering of thy firstfruits unto the Lord, thou shalt offer for the meat offering of thy firstfruits green ears of corn dried by the fire, even corn beaten out of full ears.
verses.fr: Si tu fais à l''Eternel une offrande des prémices, tu présenteras des épis nouveaux, rôtis au feu et broyés, comme offrande de tes prémices.
verses.am: ከበኵራትም የእህል ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ብታቀርብ ስለዚህ ቍርባን በእሳት የተጠበሰና የተፈተገ የእህል እሸት ታቀርባለህ።

verses.en: And thou shalt put oil upon it, and lay frankincense thereon: it is a meat offering.
verses.fr: Tu verseras de l''huile dessus, et tu y ajouteras de l''encens; c''est une offrande.
verses.am: ዘይትም ታፈስስበታለህ፥ ዕጣንም ትጨምርበታለህ፤ የእህል ቍርባን ነው።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn the memorial of it, part of the beaten corn thereof, and part of the oil thereof, with all the frankincense thereof: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur brûlera comme souvenir une portion des épis broyés et de l''huile, avec tout l''encens. C''est une offrande consumée par le feu devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከተፈተገው እህል ከዘይቱም ወስዶ ከዕጣኑ ሁሉ ጋር መታሰቢያውን ያቃጥላል፤ ይህ ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ነው።

verses.en: And if his oblation be a sacrifice of peace offering, if he offer it of the herd; whether it be a male or female, he shall offer it without blemish before the Lord.
verses.fr: Lorsque quelqu''un offrira à l''Eternel un sacrifice d''actions de grâces: S''il offre du gros bétail, mâle ou femelle, il l''offrira sans défaut, devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ቍርባኑም የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ቢሆን፥ ከላሞች መንጋ ተባት ወይም እንስት ቢያቀርብ፥ ነውር የሌለበትን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቅርብ።

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons the priests shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.fr: Il posera sa main sur la tête de la victime, qu''il égorgera à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation; et les sacrificateurs, fils d''Aaron, répandront le sang sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: እጁንም ለቍርባን በቀረበው ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.fr: De ce sacrifice d''actions de grâces, il offrira en sacrifice consumé par le feu devant l''Eternel: la graisse qui couvre les entrailles et toute celle qui y est attachée;
verses.am: ከደኅንነቱም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርባል፤ የሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.fr: les deux rognons, et la graisse qui les entoure, qui couvre les flancs, et le grand lobe du foie, qu''il détachera près des rognons.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And Aaron's sons shall burn it on the altar upon the burnt sacrifice, which is upon the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Aaron brûleront cela sur l''autel, par-dessus l''holocauste qui sera sur le bois mis au feu. C''est un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ከሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ጋር በመሠዊያው ላይ በእሳቱ ላይ ባለው በእንጨቱ ላይ ያቃጥሉታል፤ የእሳት ቍርባን ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ ነው።

verses.en: And if his offering for a sacrifice of peace offering unto the Lord be of the flock; male or female, he shall offer it without blemish.
verses.fr: S''il offre du menu bétail, mâle ou femelle, en sacrifice d''actions de grâces à l''Eternel, il l''offrira sans défaut.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔርም ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርበው ቍርባኑ ከበጎች ተባት ወይም እንስት ቢሆን፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ያቀርባል።

verses.en: If he offer a lamb for his offering, then shall he offer it before the Lord.
verses.fr: S''il offre en sacrifice un agneau, il le présentera devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ለቍርባኑ ጠቦትን ቢያቀርብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of his offering, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and Aaron's sons shall sprinkle the blood thereof round about upon the altar.
verses.fr: Il posera sa main sur la tête de la victime, qu''il égorgera devant la tente d''assignation; et les fils d''Aaron en répandront le sang sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: እጁንም ለቍርባን በቀረበው ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall offer of the sacrifice of the peace offering an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat thereof, and the whole rump, it shall he take off hard by the backbone; and the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.fr: De ce sacrifice d''actions de grâces, il offrira en sacrifice consumé par le feu devant l''Eternel: la graisse, la queue entière, qu''il séparera près de l''échine, la graisse qui couvre les entrailles et toute celle qui y est attachée,
verses.am: ከደኅንነቱም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርባል፤ ስቡን፥ እስከ ጀርባውም ድረስ የተቈረጠ ላቱን ሁሉ፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.fr: les deux rognons, et la graisse qui les entoure, qui couvre les flancs, et le grand lobe du foie, qu''il détachera près des rognons.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn it upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur brûlera cela sur l''autel. C''est l''aliment d''un sacrifice consumé par le feu devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ በእሳት ላይ ለእግዚአብሔር የተደረገ የቍርባን መብል ነው።

verses.en: And if his offering be a goat, then he shall offer it before the Lord.
verses.fr: Si son offrande est une chèvre, il la présentera devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ቍርባኑም ፍየል ቢሆን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of it, and kill it before the tabernacle of the congregation: and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle the blood thereof upon the altar round about.
verses.fr: Il posera sa main sur la tête de sa victime, qu''il égorgera devant la tente d''assignation; et les fils d''Aaron en répandront le sang sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: እጁንም በራሱ ላይ ይጭንበታል፥ በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ፊት ያርደዋል፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጩታል።

verses.en: And he shall offer thereof his offering, even an offering made by fire unto the Lord; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.fr: De la victime, il offrira en sacrifice consumé par le feu devant l''Eternel: la graisse qui couvre les entrailles et toute celle qui y est attachée,
verses.am: ከእርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን አድርጎ ያቀርበዋል፤ ሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away.
verses.fr: les deux rognons, et la graisse qui les entoure, qui couvre les flancs, et le grand lobe du foie, qu''il détachera près des rognons.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire for a sweet savour: all the fat is the Lord's.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur brûlera cela sur l''autel. Toute la graisse est l''aliment d''un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ በእሳት ላይ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የተደረገ መብል ነው። ስቡ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ነው።

verses.en: It shall be a perpetual statute for your generations throughout all your dwellings, that ye eat neither fat nor blood.
verses.fr: C''est ici une loi perpétuelle pour vos descendants, dans tous les lieux où vous habiterez: vous ne mangerez ni graisse ni sang.
verses.am: ስብና ደም እንዳትበሉ በምትኖሩበት ሁሉ ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a soul shall sin through ignorance against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which ought not to be done, and shall do against any of them:
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis: Lorsque quelqu''un péchera involontairement contre l''un des commandements de l''Eternel, en faisant des choses qui ne doivent point se faire;
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ማናቸውም ሰው ሳያውቅ ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፍ፥

verses.en: If the priest that is anointed do sin according to the sin of the people; then let him bring for his sin, which he hath sinned, a young bullock without blemish unto the Lord for a sin offering.
verses.fr: Si c''est le sacrificateur ayant reçu l''onction qui a péché et a rendu par là le peuple coupable, il offrira à l''Eternel, pour le péché qu''il a commis, un jeune taureau sans défaut, en sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: የተቀባውም ካህን በሕዝቡ ላይ በደል እንዲቈጠርባቸው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ ስለ ሠራው ስለ ኃጢአቱ ነውር የሌለበት ወይፈን ለእግዚአብሔር ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And he shall bring the bullock unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation before the Lord; and shall lay his hand upon the bullock's head, and kill the bullock before the Lord.
verses.fr: Il amènera le taureau à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, devant l''Eternel; et il posera sa main sur la tête du taureau, qu''il égorgera devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ወይፈኑንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያመጣዋል፤ እጁንም በወይፈኑ ራስ ላይ ይጭነዋል፥ ወይፈኑንም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል።

verses.en: And the priest that is anointed shall take of the bullock's blood, and bring it to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur ayant reçu l''onction prendra du sang du taureau, et l''apportera dans la tente d''assignation;
verses.am: የተቀባውም ካህን ከወይፈኑ ደም ወስዶ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ያመጣዋል፤

verses.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle of the blood seven times before the Lord, before the vail of the sanctuary.
verses.fr: il trempera son doigt dans le sang, et il en fera sept fois l''aspersion devant l''Eternel, en face du voile du sanctuaire.
verses.am: ካህኑም ጣቱን በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመቅደሱ መጋረጃ ፊት ደሙን ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the Lord, which is in the tabernacle of the congregation; and shall pour all the blood of the bullock at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur mettra du sang sur les cornes de l''autel des parfums odoriférants, qui est devant l''Eternel dans la tente d''assignation; et il répandra tout le sang du taureau au pied de l''autel des holocaustes, qui est à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ካህኑም በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያለው ጣፋጭ ዕጣን በሚታጠንበት መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ከደሙ ያደርጋል፤ የተረፈውንም የወይፈኑን ደም ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ ባለው ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take off from it all the fat of the bullock for the sin offering; the fat that covereth the inwards, and all the fat that is upon the inwards,
verses.fr: Il enlèvera toute la graisse du taureau expiatoire, la graisse qui couvre les entrailles et toute celle qui y est attachée,
verses.am: ለኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት ከሚታረደው ወይፈን ስብን ሁሉ ይወስዳል፤ ሆድ ዕቃውን የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is upon them, which is by the flanks, and the caul above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away,
verses.fr: les deux rognons, et la graisse qui les entoure, qui couvre les flancs, et le grand lobe du foie, qu''il détachera près des rognons.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶች ጋር፥

verses.en: As it was taken off from the bullock of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall burn them upon the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur enlèvera ces parties comme on les enlève du taureau dans le sacrifice d''actions de grâces, et il les brûlera sur l''autel des holocaustes.
verses.am: ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ከታረደው ወይፈን እንደ ተወሰደው ይወስዳል። ካህኑም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And the skin of the bullock, and all his flesh, with his head, and with his legs, and his inwards, and his dung,
verses.fr: Mais la peau du taureau, toute sa chair, avec sa tête, ses jambes, ses entrailles et ses excréments,
verses.am: የወይፈኑን ቁርበት፥ ሥጋውንም ሁሉ፥ ራሱንም፥ እግሮቹንም፥ ሆድ ዕቃውንም፥

verses.en: Even the whole bullock shall he carry forth without the camp unto a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn him on the wood with fire: where the ashes are poured out shall he be burnt.
verses.fr: le taureau entier, il l''emportera hors du camp, dans un lieu pur, où l''on jette les cendres, et il le brûlera au feu sur du bois: c''est sur le tas de cendres qu''il sera brûlé.
verses.am: ፈርሱንም፥ ወይፈኑን ሁሉ ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ አመድ ወደሚፈስስበት ወደ ንጹሕ ስፍራ ይወስደዋል፥ በእንጨትም ላይ በእሳት ያቃጥለዋል፤ አመድ በሚፈስስበት ስፍራ ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: And if the whole congregation of Israel sin through ignorance, and the thing be hid from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done somewhat against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which should not be done, and are guilty;
verses.fr: Si c''est toute l''assemblée d''Israël qui a péché involontairement et sans s''en apercevoir, en faisant contre l''un des commandements de l''Eternel des choses qui ne doivent point se faire et en se rendant ainsi coupable,
verses.am: የእስራኤል ማኅበር ሁሉ ቢስቱ፥ ነገሩም ከጉባኤው ፊት ቢሸሸግ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፉ፥

verses.en: When the sin, which they have sinned against it, is known, then the congregation shall offer a young bullock for the sin, and bring him before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: et que le péché qu''on a commis vienne à être découvert, l''assemblée offrira un jeune taureau en sacrifice d''expiation, et on l''amènera devant la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: እንዲህም ቢበድሉ፥ የሠሩት ኃጢአት ሲታወቅ ጉባኤው ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወይፈንን ያቀርባሉ፤ ወደ መገናኛውም ድንኳን ፊት ያመጡታል።

verses.en: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands upon the head of the bullock before the Lord: and the bullock shall be killed before the Lord.
verses.fr: Les anciens d''Israël poseront leurs mains sur la tête du taureau devant l''Eternel, et on égorgera le taureau devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: የጉባኤውም ሽማግሌዎች እጆቻቸውን በወይፈኑ ራስ ላይ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይጭናሉ፤ ወይፈኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታረዳል።

verses.en: And the priest that is anointed shall bring of the bullock's blood to the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur ayant reçu l''onction apportera du sang du taureau dans la tente d''assignation;
verses.am: የተቀባውም ካህን ከወይፈኑ ደም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ያመጣል፤

verses.en: And the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord, even before the vail.
verses.fr: il trempera son doigt dans le sang, et il en fera sept fois l''aspersion devant l''Eternel, en face du voile.
verses.am: ካህኑም ጣቱን በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመጋረጃው ፊት ለፊት ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And he shall put some of the blood upon the horns of the altar which is before the Lord, that is in the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall pour out all the blood at the bottom of the altar of the burnt offering, which is at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Il mettra du sang sur les cornes de l''autel qui est devant l''Eternel dans la tente d''assignation; et il répandra tout le sang au pied de l''autel des holocaustes, qui est à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: በመገናኛውም ድንኳን ውስጥ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ባለው በዕጣን መሠዊያው ቀንዶች ላይ ከደሙ ያደርጋል፤ ደሙንም ሁሉ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጅ ባለው ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take all his fat from him, and burn it upon the altar.
verses.fr: Il enlèvera toute la graisse du taureau, et il la brûlera sur l''autel.
verses.am: ስቡንም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ወስዶ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And he shall do with the bullock as he did with the bullock for a sin offering, so shall he do with this: and the priest shall make an atonement for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
verses.fr: Il fera de ce taureau comme du taureau expiatoire; il fera de même. C''est ainsi que le sacrificateur fera pour eux l''expiation, et il leur sera pardonné.
verses.am: እንዲህም በወይፈኑ ያደርጋል፤ ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት በታረደው ወይፈን እንዳደረገ እንዲሁ በዚህ ያደርጋል፤ ካህኑም ስለ እነርሱ ያስተሰርያል፥ እነርሱም ይቅር ይባላሉ።

verses.en: And he shall carry forth the bullock without the camp, and burn him as he burned the first bullock: it is a sin offering for the congregation.
verses.fr: Il emportera le taureau hors du camp, et il le brûlera comme le premier taureau. C''est un sacrifice d''expiation pour l''assemblée.
verses.am: ወይፈኑንም ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ ይወስደዋል፥ የፊተኛውንም ወይፈን እንዳቃጠለ ያቃጥለዋል፤ ይህ የማኅበሩ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: When a ruler hath sinned, and done somewhat through ignorance against any of the commandments of the Lord his God concerning things which should not be done, and is guilty;
verses.fr: Si c''est un chef qui a péché, en faisant involontairement contre l''un des commandements de l''Eternel, son Dieu, des choses qui ne doivent point se faire et en se rendant ainsi coupable,
verses.am: አንድ መኰንንም ኃጢአትን ሲሠሩ፥ ሳያውቅም እግዚአብሔር አምላኩ። አትሥራ ያለውን ትእዛዝ ሲተላለፍ፥ እንዲህም ሲበድል፥

verses.en: Or if his sin, wherein he hath sinned, come to his knowledge; he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a male without blemish:
verses.fr: et qu''il vienne à découvrir le péché qu''il a commis, il offrira en sacrifice un bouc mâle sans défaut.
verses.am: የሠራው ኃጢአት ቢታወቅ፥ ነውር የሌለበትን ተባት ፍየል ለቍርባኑ ያቀርበዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the Lord: it is a sin offering.
verses.fr: Il posera sa main sur la tête du bouc, qu''il égorgera dans le lieu où l''on égorge les holocaustes devant l''Eternel. C''est un sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: በፍየሉም ራስ ላይ እጁን ይጭናል፤ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያርደዋል፤ እርሱ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out his blood at the bottom of the altar of burnt offering.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra avec son doigt du sang de la victime expiatoire, il en mettra sur les cornes de l''autel des holocaustes, et il répandra le sang au pied de l''autel des holocaustes.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ደም በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ያደርገዋል፤ የተረፈውንም ደም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ከሚሆነው መሠዊያ በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall burn all his fat upon the altar, as the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings: and the priest shall make an atonement for him as concerning his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.fr: Il brûlera toute la graisse sur l''autel, comme la graisse du sacrifice d''actions de grâces. C''est ainsi que le sacrificateur fera pour ce chef l''expiation de son péché, et il lui sera pardonné.
verses.am: ስቡንም ሁሉ እንደ ደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ስብ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ካህኑም ኃጢአቱን ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And if any one of the common people sin through ignorance, while he doeth somewhat against any of the commandments of the Lord concerning things which ought not to be done, and be guilty;
verses.fr: Si c''est quelqu''un du peuple qui a péché involontairement, en faisant contre l''un des commandements de l''Eternel des choses qui ne doivent point se faire et en se rendant ainsi coupable,
verses.am: ከአገሩ ሕዝብም አንድ ሰው ኃጢአትን ሳያውቅ ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥራ ያለውን ትእዛዝ ቢተላለፍ፥ ቢበድልም፥

verses.en: Or if his sin, which he hath sinned, come to his knowledge: then he shall bring his offering, a kid of the goats, a female without blemish, for his sin which he hath sinned.
verses.fr: et qu''il vienne à découvrir le péché qu''il a commis, il offrira en sacrifice une chèvre, une femelle sans défaut, pour le péché qu''il a commis.
verses.am: ለእርሱም የሠራው ኃጢአት ቢታወቀው፥ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ነውር የሌለባትን እንስት ፍየል ለቍርባኑ ያመጣል።

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay the sin offering in the place of the burnt offering.
verses.fr: Il posera sa main sur la tête de la victime expiatoire, qu''il égorgera dans le lieu où l''on égorge les holocaustes.
verses.am: እጁንም በኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፤ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ የኃጢአትን መስዋዕት ያርዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood thereof with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra avec son doigt du sang de la victime, il en mettra sur les cornes de l''autel des holocaustes, et il répandra tout le sang au pied de l''autel.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከደምዋ በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ያደርገዋል፥ ደሙንም ሁሉ ከመሠዊያው በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat is taken away from off the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour unto the Lord; and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur ôtera toute la graisse, comme on ôte la graisse du sacrifice d''actions de grâces, et il la brûlera sur l''autel, et elle sera d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel. C''est ainsi que le sacrificateur fera pour cet homme l''expiation, et il lui sera pardonné.
verses.am: ስቡም ሁሉ ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ላይ እንደሚወሰድ፥ ስብዋን ሁሉ ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ ካህኑም ስለ እርሱ ያስተሰርያል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And if he bring a lamb for a sin offering, he shall bring it a female without blemish.
verses.fr: S''il offre un agneau en sacrifice d''expiation, il offrira une femelle sans défaut.
verses.am: ስለ ኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት የበግ ጠቦት ቢያቀርብ፥ ነውር የሌለባትን እንስት ያመጣል።

verses.en: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
verses.fr: Il posera sa main sur la tête de la victime, qu''il égorgera en sacrifice d''expiation dans le lieu où l''on égorge les holocaustes.
verses.am: እጁንም በኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ የሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያርዳታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it upon the horns of the altar of burnt offering, and shall pour out all the blood thereof at the bottom of the altar:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra avec son doigt du sang de la victime, il en mettra sur les cornes de l''autel des holocaustes, et il répandra tout le sang au pied de l''autel.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ደም በጣቱ ወስዶ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚሆነው መሠዊያ ቀንዶች ላይ ያደርገዋል፥ ደሙንም ሁሉ ከመሠዊያው በታች ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take away all the fat thereof, as the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of the peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them upon the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the Lord: and the priest shall make an atonement for his sin that he hath committed, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur ôtera toute la graisse, comme on ôte la graisse de l''agneau dans le sacrifice d''actions de grâces, et il la brûlera sur l''autel, comme un sacrifice consumé par le feu devant l''Eternel. C''est ainsi que le sacrificateur fera pour cet homme l''expiation du péché qu''il a commis, et il lui sera pardonné.
verses.am: ስቡ ሁሉ ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ከታረደው ጠቦት ላይ እንደሚወሰድ ስብዋን ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር በእሳት በተቃጠለው ቍርባን ላይ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል። ካህኑም ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And if a soul sin, and hear the voice of swearing, and is a witness, whether he hath seen or known of it; if he do not utter it, then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.fr: Lorsque quelqu''un, après avoir été mis sous serment comme témoin, péchera en ne déclarant pas ce qu''il a vu ou ce qu''il sait, il restera chargé de sa faute.
verses.am: ማንም ሰው የሚያምለውን ቃል ቢሰማ፥ ምስክር ሆኖም አንድ ነገር አይቶ እንደ ሆነ ወይም አውቆ እንደ ሆነ ባይናገር፥ ኃጢአት መሥራቱ ነውና በደሉን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: Or if a soul touch any unclean thing, whether it be a carcase of an unclean beast, or a carcase of unclean cattle, or the carcase of unclean creeping things, and if it be hidden from him; he also shall be unclean, and guilty.
verses.fr: Lorsque quelqu''un, sans s''en apercevoir, touchera une chose souillée, comme le cadavre d''un animal impur, que ce soit d''une bête sauvage ou domestique, ou bien d''un reptile, il deviendra lui-même impur et il se rendra coupable.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ሳይታወቀው ርኩስ ነገር ቢነካ፥ የረከሰም አውሬ በድን፥ ወይም የረከሰ ከብት በድን፥ ወይም የረከሰ የተንቀሳቀሰ እንስሳ በድን ቢሆን፥ እርሱም ርኩስ ቢሆን ነገሩ በታወቀው ጊዜ በደል ይሆንበታል፤

verses.en: Or if he touch the uncleanness of man, whatsoever uncleanness it be that a man shall be defiled withal, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty.
verses.fr: Lorsque, sans y prendre garde, il touchera une souillure humaine quelconque, et qu''il s''en aperçoive plus tard, il en sera coupable.
verses.am: ወይም ርኩስነቱን ሳይውቅ ርኩስን ሰው ቢነካ፥ በማናቸውም ርኵሰት ቢረክስ፥ ነገሩ በታወቀው ጊዜ በደል ይሆንበታል።

verses.en: Or if a soul swear, pronouncing with his lips to do evil, or to do good, whatsoever it be that a man shall pronounce with an oath, and it be hid from him; when he knoweth of it, then he shall be guilty in one of these.
verses.fr: Lorsque quelqu''un, parlant à la légère, jure de faire du mal ou du bien, et que, ne l''ayant pas remarqué d''abord, il s''en aperçoive plus tard, il en sera coupable.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ሳያውቅ ክፉን ወይም መልካምን ያደርግ ዘንድ ሳያስብ በከንፈሩ ተናግሮ ቢምል፤ ሳያስብ የማለው ስለ ማናቸውም ነገር ቢሆን፤ በታወቀው ጊዜ ከዚህ ነገር በአንዱ በደለኛ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And it shall be, when he shall be guilty in one of these things, that he shall confess that he hath sinned in that thing:
verses.fr: Celui donc qui se rendra coupable de l''une de ces choses, fera l''aveu de son péché.
verses.am: ከእነዚህ ነገሮች በአንዲቱ በደለኛ ሲሆን፥ የሠራውን ኃጢአት ይናዘዛል።

verses.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord for his sin which he hath sinned, a female from the flock, a lamb or a kid of the goats, for a sin offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his sin.
verses.fr: Puis il offrira en sacrifice de culpabilité à l''Eternel, pour le péché qu''il a commis, une femelle de menu bétail, une brebis ou une chèvre, comme victime expiatoire. Et le sacrificateur fera pour lui l''expiation de son péché.
verses.am: ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ለእግዚአብሔር የበደል መሥዋዕት ያመጣል፤ እርሱም ከመንጋው የበግ ወይም የፍየል እንስት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ይሆናል፤ ካህኑም ስለ ኃጢአቱ ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.en: And if he be not able to bring a lamb, then he shall bring for his trespass, which he hath committed, two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, unto the Lord; one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering.
verses.fr: S''il n''a pas de quoi se procurer une brebis ou une chèvre, il offrira en sacrifice de culpabilité à l''Eternel pour son péché deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, l''un comme victime expiatoire, l''autre comme holocauste.
verses.am: ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ለበደል መሥዋዕት ጠቦትን ለማምጣት ገንዘቡ ያልበቃ እንደ ሆነ፥ ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች፥ አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁለተኛውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And he shall bring them unto the priest, who shall offer that which is for the sin offering first, and wring off his head from his neck, but shall not divide it asunder:
verses.fr: Il les apportera au sacrificateur, qui sacrifiera d''abord celui qui doit servir de victime expiatoire. Le sacrificateur lui ouvrira la tête avec l''ongle près de la nuque, sans la séparer;
verses.am: ወደ ካህኑም ያመጣቸዋል፤ እርሱም አስቀድሞ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን ያቀርባል፥ ራሱንም ከአንገቱ ይቈለምመዋል፥ ነገር ግን አይቈርጠውም።

verses.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood of the sin offering upon the side of the altar; and the rest of the blood shall be wrung out at the bottom of the altar: it is a sin offering.
verses.fr: il fera sur un côté de l''autel l''aspersion du sang de la victime expiatoire, et le reste du sang sera exprimé au pied de l''autel: c''est un sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: ከኃጢአቱም መሥዋዕት ደም በመሠዊያው ግድግዳ ላይ ይረጨዋል፤ የተረፈውም ደም ከመሠዊያው በታች ይንጠፈጠፋል፤ እርሱ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: And he shall offer the second for a burnt offering, according to the manner: and the priest shall make an atonement for him for his sin which he hath sinned, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.fr: Il fera de l''autre oiseau un holocauste, d''après les règles établies. C''est ainsi que le sacrificateur fera pour cet homme l''expiation du péché qu''il a commis, et il lui sera pardonné.
verses.am: እንደ ሥርዓቱም ሁለተኛውን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያዘጋጀዋል። ካህኑም ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: But if he be not able to bring two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, then he that sinned shall bring for his offering the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall put no oil upon it, neither shall he put any frankincense thereon: for it is a sin offering.
verses.fr: S''il n''a pas de quoi se procurer deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, il apportera en offrande pour son péché un dixième d''épha de fleur de farine, comme offrande d''expiation; il ne mettra point d''huile dessus, et il n''y ajoutera point d''encens, car c''est une offrande d''expiation.
verses.am: ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ለማምጣት ገንዘቡ ያልበቃ እንደ ሆነ፥ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል መልካም ዱቄት ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል፤ የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነውና ዘይት አያፈስስበትም፥ ዕጣንም አይጨምርበትም።

verses.en: Then shall he bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take his handful of it, even a memorial thereof, and burn it on the altar, according to the offerings made by fire unto the Lord: it is a sin offering.
verses.fr: Il l''apportera au sacrificateur, et le sacrificateur en prendra une poignée comme souvenir, et il la brûlera sur l''autel, comme les offrandes consumées par le feu devant l''Eternel: c''est une offrande d''expiation.
verses.am: ወደ ካህኑም ያመጣዋል፥ ካህኑም መታሰቢያው ይሆን ዘንድ ከእርሱ እፍኝ ሙሉ ይውሰድ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም በእሳት በተቃጠለው ቍርባን ላይ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ እርሱም የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him as touching his sin that he hath sinned in one of these, and it shall be forgiven him: and the remnant shall be the priest's, as a meat offering.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi que le sacrificateur fera pour cet homme l''expiation du péché qu''il a commis à l''égard de l''une de ces choses, et il lui sera pardonné. Ce qui restera de l''offrande sera pour le sacrificateur, comme dans l''offrande en don.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከእነዚያ በአንዳቸው ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል። የተረፈውም እንደ እህል ቍርባን ለካህኑ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: If a soul commit a trespass, and sin through ignorance, in the holy things of the Lord; then he shall bring for his trespass unto the Lord a ram without blemish out of the flocks, with thy estimation by shekels of silver, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for a trespass offering.
verses.fr: Lorsque quelqu''un commettra une infidélité et péchera involontairement à l''égard des choses consacrées à l''Eternel, il offrira en sacrifice de culpabilité à l''Eternel pour son péché un bélier sans défaut, pris du troupeau d''après ton estimation en sicles d''argent, selon le sicle du sanctuaire.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ቢበድል፥ ሳያውቅም ለእግዚአብሔር በተቀደሰው በማናቸውም ነገር ኃጢአትን ቢሠራ፥ ለበደል መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ከመንጋ ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ያቀርባል፤ እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን በብር ሰቅል እንደ መቅደሱ ሰቅል ሚዛን ለበደል መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And he shall make amends for the harm that he hath done in the holy thing, and shall add the fifth part thereto, and give it unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.fr: Il donnera, en y ajoutant un cinquième, la valeur de la chose dont il a frustré le sanctuaire, et il la remettra au sacrificateur. Et le sacrificateur fera pour lui l''expiation avec le bélier offert en sacrifice de culpabilité, et il lui sera pardonné.
verses.am: በተቀደሰ ነገር ላይ ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት ዕዳ ይከፍላል፥ አምስተኛውንም እጅ ይጨምርበታል፥ ለካህኑም ይሰጠዋል። ካህኑም በበደል መሥዋዕት አውራ በግ ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And if a soul sin, and commit any of these things which are forbidden to be done by the commandments of the Lord; though he wist it not, yet is he guilty, and shall bear his iniquity.
verses.fr: Lorsque quelqu''un péchera en faisant, sans le savoir, contre l''un des commandements de l''Eternel, des choses qui ne doivent point se faire, il se rendra coupable et sera chargé de sa faute.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ኃጢአት ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርም። አትሥሩ ካላቸው ትእዛዛት አንዲቱን ቢተላለፍ፥ ባያውቅም፥ ያ ሰው በደለኛ ነው፥ ኃጢአቱንም ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And he shall bring a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest: and the priest shall make an atonement for him concerning his ignorance wherein he erred and wist it not, and it shall be forgiven him.
verses.fr: Il présentera au sacrificateur en sacrifice de culpabilité un bélier sans défaut, pris du troupeau d''après ton estimation. Et le sacrificateur fera pour lui l''expiation de la faute qu''il a commise sans le savoir, et il lui sera pardonné.
verses.am: ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ ከመንጋው ለበደል መሥዋዕት እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን ወደ ካህኑ ያመጣዋል፤ ካህኑም ሳያውቅ ስለ ሳተው ስሕተት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ እርሱም ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: It is a trespass offering: he hath certainly trespassed against the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est un sacrifice de culpabilité. Cet homme s''était rendu coupable envers l''Eternel.
verses.am: እርሱም የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ በእውነት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በደለኛ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: If a soul sin, and commit a trespass against the Lord, and lie unto his neighbour in that which was delivered him to keep, or in fellowship, or in a thing taken away by violence, or hath deceived his neighbour;
verses.fr: Lorsque quelqu''un péchera et commettra une infidélité envers l''Eternel, en mentant à son prochain au sujet d''un dépôt, d''un objet confié à sa garde, d''une chose volée ou soustraite par fraude,
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ኃጢአትን ቢሠራ፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ቢበድል፥ ያኖረበትን አደራ ወይም ብድር ወስዶ ባልንጀራውን ቢክድ፥ ወይም ቢቀማ፥ ወይም በባልንጀራው ላይ ግፍ ቢያደርግ፥

verses.en: Or have found that which was lost, and lieth concerning it, and sweareth falsely; in any of all these that a man doeth, sinning therein:
verses.fr: en niant d''avoir trouvé une chose perdue, ou en faisant un faux serment sur une chose quelconque de nature à constituer un péché;
verses.am: ወይም የጠፋውን ነገር ቢያገኝ፥ ያንንም ሸሽጎ በሐሰት ቢምል፥ ሰው ከሚያደርጋቸው ከእነዚህ ነገሮች ሁሉ በአንዲቱ ቢበድል፥

verses.en: Then it shall be, because he hath sinned, and is guilty, that he shall restore that which he took violently away, or the thing which he hath deceitfully gotten, or that which was delivered him to keep, or the lost thing which he found,
verses.fr: lorsqu''il péchera ainsi et se rendra coupable, il restituera la chose qu''il a volée ou soustraite par fraude, la chose qui lui avait été confiée en dépôt, la chose perdue qu''il a trouvée,
verses.am: እርሱ ኃጢአትን ሠርቶ በደለኛ ቢሆን፥ በቅሚያ የወሰደውን ወይም በግፍ የተቀበለውን ወይም የተሰጠውን አደራ ወይም ጠፍቶ ያገኘውን፥

verses.en: Or all that about which he hath sworn falsely; he shall even restore it in the principal, and shall add the fifth part more thereto, and give it unto him to whom it appertaineth, in the day of his trespass offering.
verses.fr: ou la chose quelconque sur laquelle il a fait un faux serment. Il la restituera en son entier, y ajoutera un cinquième, et la remettra à son propriétaire, le jour même où il offrira son sacrifice de culpabilité.
verses.am: ወይም በሐሰት የማለበትን ነገር ይመልስ፤ በሙሉ ይመልስ፥ ከዚያም በላይ አምስተኛውን ክፍል ጨምሮ የበደሉን መሥዋዕት በሚያቀርብበት ቀን ለባለ ገንዘቡ ይስጠው።

verses.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, a ram without blemish out of the flock, with thy estimation, for a trespass offering, unto the priest:
verses.fr: Il présentera au sacrificateur en sacrifice de culpabilité à l''Eternel pour son péché un bélier sans défaut, pris du troupeau d''après ton estimation.
verses.am: ስለ በደል መሥዋዕትም ለእግዚአብሔር ከመንጋው ነውር የሌለበትን አውራ በግ እንደ ግምጋሜህ መጠን ስለ በደል መሥዋዕት ወደ ካህኑ ያምጣ።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord: and it shall be forgiven him for any thing of all that he hath done in trespassing therein.
verses.fr: Et le sacrificateur fera pour lui l''expiation devant l''Eternel, et il lui sera pardonné, quelle que soit la faute dont il se sera rendu coupable.
verses.am: ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል፥ ስለዚያም ስላደረገው በደል ሁሉ ይቅር ይባላል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Command Aaron and his sons, saying, This is the law of the burnt offering: It is the burnt offering, because of the burning upon the altar all night unto the morning, and the fire of the altar shall be burning in it.
verses.fr: Donne cet ordre à Aaron et à ses fils, et dis: Voici la loi de l''holocauste. L''holocauste restera sur le foyer de l''autel toute la nuit jusqu''au matin, et le feu brûlera sur l''autel.
verses.am: አሮንንና ልጆቹን እንዲህ ብለህ እዘዛቸው። የሚቃጠለው የመሥዋዕቱ ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት በመሠዊያው ላይ ባለው እንጨት ላይ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ እስኪጸባ ድረስ ይሆናል፤ እሳቱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ዘወትር ይነድዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall put on his linen garment, and his linen breeches shall he put upon his flesh, and take up the ashes which the fire hath consumed with the burnt offering on the altar, and he shall put them beside the altar.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur revêtira sa tunique de lin, et mettra des caleçons sur sa chair, il enlèvera la cendre faite par le feu qui aura consumé l''holocauste sur l''autel, et il la déposera près de l''autel.
verses.am: ካህኑም የበፍታ ቀሚስና የበፍታ ሱሪ በሥጋው ላይ ይለብሳል፤ በመሠዊያውም ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት እሳቱ ከበላው በኋላ አመዱን አንሥቶ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And he shall put off his garments, and put on other garments, and carry forth the ashes without the camp unto a clean place.
verses.fr: Puis il quittera ses vêtements et en mettra d''autres, pour porter la cendre hors du camp, dans un lieu pur.
verses.am: ልብሱንም ያወልቃል፥ ሌላም ልብስ ይለብሳል፤ አመዱንም ተሸክሞ ከሰፈሩ ንጹሕ ስፍራ ወደ ሆነ ወደ ውጭ ያወጣዋል።

verses.en: And the fire upon the altar shall be burning in it; it shall not be put out: and the priest shall burn wood on it every morning, and lay the burnt offering in order upon it; and he shall burn thereon the fat of the peace offerings.
verses.fr: Le feu brûlera sur l''autel, il ne s''éteindra point; chaque matin, le sacrificateur y allumera du bois, arrangera l''holocauste, et brûlera la graisse des sacrifices d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: እሳቱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ዘወትር ይነድዳል፥ አይጠፋም፤ ካህኑም ማለዳ ማለዳ እንጨት ያቃጥልበታል፤ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በዚያ ላይ ይረበርባል፤ በዚያም የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ስብ ያቃጥላል።

verses.en: The fire shall ever be burning upon the altar; it shall never go out.
verses.fr: Le feu brûlera continuellement sur l''autel, il ne s''éteindra point.
verses.am: ዘወትር በመሠዊያው ላይ እሳት ይነድዳል፤ አይጠፋም።

verses.en: And this is the law of the meat offering: the sons of Aaron shall offer it before the Lord, before the altar.
verses.fr: Voici la loi de l''offrande. Les fils d''Aaron la présenteront devant l''Eternel, devant l''autel.
verses.am: የእህሉም ቍርባን ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የአሮን ልጆች በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በመሠዊያው ፊት ያቀርቡታል።

verses.en: And he shall take of it his handful, of the flour of the meat offering, and of the oil thereof, and all the frankincense which is upon the meat offering, and shall burn it upon the altar for a sweet savour, even the memorial of it, unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prélèvera une poignée de la fleur de farine et de l''huile, avec tout l''encens ajouté à l''offrande, et il brûlera cela sur l''autel comme souvenir d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከእህሉ ቍርባን መልካሙን ዱቄት ከዘይት ጋር እፍኝ ሙሉ፥ ደግሞም በእህሉ ቍርባን ላይ ያለውን ዕጣን ሁሉ ያነሣል፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ለመታሰቢያ በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And the remainder thereof shall Aaron and his sons eat: with unleavened bread shall it be eaten in the holy place; in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation they shall eat it.
verses.fr: Aaron et ses fils mangeront ce qui restera de l''offrande; ils le mangeront sans levain, dans un lieu saint, dans le parvis de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ከእርሱም የተረፈውን አሮንና ልጆቹ ይበሉታል፤ ቂጣ ሆኖ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበላል፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዙሪያ ባለው አደባባይ ይበሉታል።

verses.en: It shall not be baken with leaven. I have given it unto them for their portion of my offerings made by fire; it is most holy, as is the sin offering, and as the trespass offering.
verses.fr: On ne le cuira pas avec du levain. C''est la part que je leur ai donnée de mes offrandes consumées par le feu. C''est une chose très sainte, comme le sacrifice d''expiation et comme le sacrifice de culpabilité.
verses.am: በእርሾ ቦክቶ አይጋገርም። እርሱን ከእሳቱ ቍርባኔ ለእነርሱ እድል ፈንታ እንዲሆን ሰጠሁ፤ እርሱም እንደ ኃጢአትና እንደ በደል መሥዋዕት ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: All the males among the children of Aaron shall eat of it. It shall be a statute for ever in your generations concerning the offerings of the Lord made by fire: every one that toucheth them shall be holy.
verses.fr: Tout mâle d''entre les enfants d''Aaron en mangera. C''est une loi perpétuelle pour vos descendants, au sujet des offrandes consumées par le feu devant l''Eternel: quiconque y touchera sera sanctifié.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ከቀረበ ከእሳት ቍርባን ለዘላለም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ እድል ፈንታቸው እንዲሆን ከአሮን ልጆች ወንዶቹ ሁሉ ይበሉታል። የሚነካቸው ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the Lord in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
verses.fr: Voici l''offrande qu''Aaron et ses fils feront à l''Eternel, le jour où ils recevront l''onction: un dixième d''épha de fleur de farine, comme offrande perpétuelle, moitié le matin et moitié le soir.
verses.am: በተቀቡበት ቀን የኢፍ መስፈሪያ አሥረኛ ክፍል መልካሙን ዱቄት እኵሌታውን በጥዋት፥ እኵሌታውንም በማታ ለዘወትር የእህል ቍርባን አድርገው ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርቡት የአሮንና የልጆቹ ቍርባን ይህ ነው።

verses.en: In a pan it shall be made with oil; and when it is baken, thou shalt bring it in: and the baken pieces of the meat offering shalt thou offer for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Elle sera préparée à la poêle avec de l''huile, et tu l''apporteras frite; tu la présenteras aussi cuite et en morceaux comme une offrande d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከዘይት ጋር በምጣድ ላይ ይደረጋል፤ ሲለወስ ታገባዋለህ፤ ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የእህሉን ቍርባን ቈራርሰህ ታቀርበዋለህ።

verses.en: And the priest of his sons that is anointed in his stead shall offer it: it is a statute for ever unto the Lord; it shall be wholly burnt.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur qui, parmi les fils d''Aaron, sera oint pour lui succéder, fera aussi cette offrande. C''est une loi perpétuelle devant l''Eternel: elle sera brûlée en entier.
verses.am: ከልጆቹም በአባቱ ፋንታ የተቀባው ካህን ያቀርበዋል። ለዘላለም ሥርዓት እንዲሆን ፈጽሞ ለእግዚአብሔር ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: For every meat offering for the priest shall be wholly burnt: it shall not be eaten.
verses.fr: Toute offrande d''un sacrificateur sera brûlée en entier; elle ne sera point mangée.
verses.am: ካህኑም የሚያቀርበው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ይቃጠላል፤ ከእርሱም አንዳች አይበላም።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto Aaron and to his sons, saying, This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where the burnt offering is killed shall the sin offering be killed before the Lord: it is most holy.
verses.fr: Parle à Aaron et à ses fils, et dis: Voici la loi du sacrifice d''expiation. C''est dans le lieu où l''on égorge l''holocauste que sera égorgée devant l''Eternel la victime pour le sacrifice d''expiation: c''est une chose très sainte.
verses.am: አሮንንና ልጆቹን እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት በሚታረድበት ስፍራ የኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይታረዳል፤ እርሱ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: The priest that offereth it for sin shall eat it: in the holy place shall it be eaten, in the court of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur qui offrira la victime expiatoire la mangera; elle sera mangée dans un lieu saint, dans le parvis de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ለኃጢአት የሚሠዋው ካህን ይበላዋል፤ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ዙሪያ ባለው አደባባይ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበላል።

verses.en: Whatsoever shall touch the flesh thereof shall be holy: and when there is sprinkled of the blood thereof upon any garment, thou shalt wash that whereon it was sprinkled in the holy place.
verses.fr: Quiconque en touchera la chair sera sanctifié. S''il en rejaillit du sang sur un vêtement, la place sur laquelle il aura rejailli sera lavée dans un lieu saint.
verses.am: ሥጋውን የሚነካ ሁሉ ቅዱስ ይሆናል፤ ማናቸው ልብስ ደም ቢረጭበት የተረጨበትን በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ታጥበዋለህ።

verses.en: But the earthen vessel wherein it is sodden shall be broken: and if it be sodden in a brasen pot, it shall be both scoured, and rinsed in water.
verses.fr: Le vase de terre dans lequel elle aura cuit sera brisé; si c''est dans un vase d''airain qu''elle a cuit, il sera nettoyé et lavé dans l''eau.
verses.am: የሚቀቀልበትም ሸክላ ይሰበራል፤ በናስም ዕቃ ቢቀቀል ይፈገፈጋል፥ በውኃም ይለቀለቃል።

verses.en: All the males among the priests shall eat thereof: it is most holy.
verses.fr: Tout mâle parmi les sacrificateurs en mangera: c''est une chose très sainte.
verses.am: ከካህናት ወገን የሆነ ወንድ ሁሉ ከእርሱ ይበላል፤ እርሱ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: And no sin offering, whereof any of the blood is brought into the tabernacle of the congregation to reconcile withal in the holy place, shall be eaten: it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.fr: Mais on ne mangera aucune victime expiatoire dont on apportera du sang dans la tente d''assignation, pour faire l''expiation dans le sanctuaire: elle sera brûlée au feu.
verses.am: ነገር ግን በመቅደሱ ውስጥ ለማስተስረያ ይሆን ዘንድ ከደሙ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን የሚገባው የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁሉ አይበላም፤ በእሳት ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: Likewise this is the law of the trespass offering: it is most holy.
verses.fr: Voici la loi du sacrifice de culpabilité: c''est une chose très sainte.
verses.am: የበደል መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው፤ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: In the place where they kill the burnt offering shall they kill the trespass offering: and the blood thereof shall he sprinkle round about upon the altar.
verses.fr: C''est dans le lieu où l''on égorge l''holocauste que sera égorgée la victime pour le sacrifice de culpabilité. On en répandra le sang sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት በሚያርዱበት ስፍራ የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ያርዱታል፤ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And he shall offer of it all the fat thereof; the rump, and the fat that covereth the inwards,
verses.fr: On en offrira toute la graisse, la queue, la graisse qui couvre les entrailles,
verses.am: ስቡንም ሁሉ፥ ላቱንም፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ ያቀርበዋል።

verses.en: And the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the flanks, and the caul that is above the liver, with the kidneys, it shall he take away:
verses.fr: les deux rognons, et la graisse qui les entoure, qui couvre les flancs, et le grand lobe du foie, qu''on détachera près des rognons.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች፥ በእነርሱም ላይና በጎድኑ አጠገብ ያለውን ስብ፥ በጕበቱም ላይ ያለውን መረብ ከኵላሊቶቹ ጋር ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn them upon the altar for an offering made by fire unto the Lord: it is a trespass offering.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur brûlera cela sur l''autel en sacrifice consumé devant l''Eternel. C''est un sacrifice de culpabilité.
verses.am: ካህኑም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን እንዲሆን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል፤ እርሱ የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው።

verses.en: Every male among the priests shall eat thereof: it shall be eaten in the holy place: it is most holy.
verses.fr: Tout mâle parmi les sacrificateurs en mangera; il le mangera dans un lieu saint: c''est une chose très sainte.
verses.am: ከካህናት ወገን የሆነ ወንድ ሁሉ ይበላዋል፤ በተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይበሉታል፤ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: As the sin offering is, so is the trespass offering: there is one law for them: the priest that maketh atonement therewith shall have it.
verses.fr: Il en est du sacrifice de culpabilité comme du sacrifice d''expiation; la loi est la même pour ces deux sacrifices: la victime sera pour le sacrificateur qui fera l''expiation.
verses.am: የኃጢአት መሥዋዕት እንደ ሆነ እንዲሁ የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ ለሁለቱ አንድ ሕግ ነው፤ በእርሱ የሚያስተሰርይ ካህን ይወስደዋል።

verses.en: And the priest that offereth any man's burnt offering, even the priest shall have to himself the skin of the burnt offering which he hath offered.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur qui offrira l''holocauste de quelqu''un aura pour lui la peau de l''holocauste qu''il a offert.
verses.am: የማናቸውንም ሰው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ ካህን ያቀረበው የሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ቁርበት ለዚያው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And all the meat offering that is baken in the oven, and all that is dressed in the fryingpan, and in the pan, shall be the priest's that offereth it.
verses.fr: Toute offrande cuite au four, préparée sur le gril ou à la poêle, sera pour le sacrificateur qui l''a offerte.
verses.am: በእቶን የተጋገረው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ፥ በመቀቀያም ወይም በምጣድ የበሰለው ሁሉ ለሚያቀርበው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And every meat offering, mingled with oil, and dry, shall all the sons of Aaron have, one as much as another.
verses.fr: Toute offrande pétrie à l''huile et sèche sera pour tous les fils d''Aaron, pour l''un comme pour l''autre.
verses.am: በዘይትም የተለወሰው ወይም የደረቀው የእህል ቍርባን ሁሉ ለአሮን ልጆች ሁሉ ይሆናል፤ ለሁሉም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And this is the law of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which he shall offer unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Voici la loi du sacrifice d''actions de grâces, qu''on offrira à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰው ለእግዚአብሔር የሚያቀርበው የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: If he offer it for a thanksgiving, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of thanksgiving unleavened cakes mingled with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil, and cakes mingled with oil, of fine flour, fried.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un l''offre par reconnaissance, il offrira, avec le sacrifice d''actions de grâces, des gâteaux sans levain pétris à l''huile, des galettes sans levain arrosées d''huile, et des gâteaux de fleur de farine frite et pétris à l''huile.
verses.am: ለምስጋና ቢያቀርበው፥ ከምስጋናው መሥዋዕት ጋር በዘይት የተለወሰ የቂጣ እንጎቻ፥ በዘይትም የተቀባ ስስ ቂጣ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት ያቀርባል።

verses.en: Besides the cakes, he shall offer for his offering leavened bread with the sacrifice of thanksgiving of his peace offerings.
verses.fr: A ces gâteaux il ajoutera du pain levé pour son offrande, avec son sacrifice de reconnaissance et d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: ለምስጋና የሚሆነውን የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ባቀረበ ጊዜ እርሾ ያለበትን ኅብስት ያቀርባል።

verses.en: And of it he shall offer one out of the whole oblation for an heave offering unto the Lord, and it shall be the priest's that sprinkleth the blood of the peace offerings.
verses.fr: On présentera par élévation à l''Eternel une portion de chaque offrande; elle sera pour le sacrificateur qui a répandu le sang de la victime d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: ከቍርባኑም ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር የማንሣት ቍርባን እንዲሆን ከእነርሱ አንዱን ያነሣል። እርሱም የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ደም ለሚረጨው ካህን ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten the same day that it is offered; he shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.fr: La chair du sacrifice de reconnaissance et d''actions de grâces sera mangée le jour où il est offert; on n''en laissera rien jusqu''au matin.
verses.am: ለምስጋና የሚሆነው የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ በሚቀርብበት ቀን ይበሉታል፤ ከእርሱ እስከ ነገ ምንም አያድርም።

verses.en: But if the sacrifice of his offering be a vow, or a voluntary offering, it shall be eaten the same day that he offereth his sacrifice: and on the morrow also the remainder of it shall be eaten:
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un offre un sacrifice pour l''accomplissement d''un voeu ou comme offrande volontaire, la victime sera mangée le jour où il l''offrira, et ce qui en restera sera mangé le lendemain.
verses.am: የቍርባኑም መሥዋዕት የስእለት ወይም የፈቃድ ቢሆን፥ መሥዋዕቱ በሚቀርብበት ቀን ይብሉት፤ ከእርሱም የቀረውን በነጋው ይብሉት፤

verses.en: But the remainder of the flesh of the sacrifice on the third day shall be burnt with fire.
verses.fr: Ce qui restera de la chair de la victime sera brûlé au feu le troisième jour.
verses.am: ከመሥዋዕቱም ሥጋ እስከ ሦስተኛው ቀን የሚቆየው በእሳት ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: And if any of the flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings be eaten at all on the third day, it shall not be accepted, neither shall it be imputed unto him that offereth it: it shall be an abomination, and the soul that eateth of it shall bear his iniquity.
verses.fr: Dans le cas où l''on mangerait de la chair de son sacrifice d''actions de grâces le troisième jour, le sacrifice ne sera point agréé; il n''en sera pas tenu compte à celui qui l''a offert; ce sera une chose infecte, et quiconque en mangera restera chargé de sa faute.
verses.am: በሦስተኛው ቀን ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ አይሠምርም፤ ላቀረበው ሰው የተጠላ ይሆንበታል እንጂ ቍርባን ሆኖ አይቈጠርለትም፤ ከእርሱም ቢበላ ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And the flesh that toucheth any unclean thing shall not be eaten; it shall be burnt with fire: and as for the flesh, all that be clean shall eat thereof.
verses.fr: La chair qui a touché quelque chose d''impur ne sera point mangée: elle sera brûlée au feu.
verses.am: ርኩስ ነገር የሚነካውን ሥጋ አይብሉት፤ በእሳት ይቃጠል። ንጹሕ የሆነ ሰው ሁሉ ግን ከሥጋው ይብላ።

verses.en: But the soul that eateth of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, that pertain unto the Lord, having his uncleanness upon him, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.fr: Tout homme pur peut manger de la chair; mais celui qui, se trouvant en état d''impureté, mangera de la chair du sacrifice d''actions de grâces qui appartient à l''Eternel, celui-là sera retranché de son peuple.
verses.am: ሰውም የረከሰ ቢሆን፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ከሆነው ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: Moreover the soul that shall touch any unclean thing, as the uncleanness of man, or any unclean beast, or any abominable unclean thing, and eat of the flesh of the sacrifice of peace offerings, which pertain unto the Lord, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.fr: Et celui qui touchera quelque chose d''impur, une souillure humaine, un animal impur, ou quoi que ce soit d''impur, et qui mangera de la chair du sacrifice d''actions de grâces qui appartient à l''Eternel, celui-là sera retranché de son peuple.
verses.am: ማናቸውንም ርኵስ ነገር ቢነካ፥ የሰውን ወይም የረከሰን እንስሳ ወይም ሌላውን የተጠላ ርኩስን ቢነካ፥ ለእግዚአብሔርም ከሆነው ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሥጋ ቢበላ፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, Ye shall eat no manner of fat, of ox, or of sheep, or of goat.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis: Vous ne mangerez point de graisse de boeuf, d''agneau ni de chèvre.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። የበሬ ወይም የበግ ወይም የፍየል ስብ ከቶ አትብሉ።

verses.en: And the fat of the beast that dieth of itself, and the fat of that which is torn with beasts, may be used in any other use: but ye shall in no wise eat of it.
verses.fr: La graisse d''une bête morte ou déchirée pourra servir à un usage quelconque; mais vous ne la mangerez point.
verses.am: የሞተውን ስብ፥ አውሬ የሰበረውንም ስብ ለሌላ ተግባር አድርጉት፤ ነገር ግን ከእርሱ ምንም አትብሉ፤

verses.en: For whosoever eateth the fat of the beast, of which men offer an offering made by fire unto the Lord, even the soul that eateth it shall be cut off from his people.
verses.fr: Car celui qui mangera de la graisse des animaux dont on offre à l''Eternel des sacrifices consumés par le feu, celui-là sera retranché de son peuple.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር በእሳት ከሚቀርበው ከእንስሳ ስብ የሚበላ ሁሉ፥ ያ የበላ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋልና።

verses.en: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez point de sang, ni d''oiseau, ni de bétail, dans tous les lieux où vous habiterez.
verses.am: በማደሪያዎቻችሁም ሁሉ የወፍ ወይም የእንስሳ ደም ቢሆን አትብሉ።

verses.en: Whatsoever soul it be that eateth any manner of blood, even that soul shall be cut off from his people.
verses.fr: Celui qui mangera du sang d''une espèce quelconque, celui-là sera retranché de son peuple.
verses.am: ደም የሚበላ ሰው ሁሉ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, He that offereth the sacrifice of his peace offerings unto the Lord shall bring his oblation unto the Lord of the sacrifice of his peace offerings.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis: Celui qui offrira à l''Eternel son sacrifice d''actions de grâces apportera son offrande à l''Eternel, prise sur son sacrifice d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ተናገራቸው። ለእግዚአብሔር የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት የሚያቀርብ ሰው ቍርባኑን ለእግዚአብሔር ከደኅንነቱ መሥዋዕት ያመጣል።

verses.en: His own hands shall bring the offerings of the Lord made by fire, the fat with the breast, it shall he bring, that the breast may be waved for a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.fr: Il apportera de ses propres mains ce qui doit être consumé par le feu devant l''Eternel; il apportera la graisse avec la poitrine, la poitrine pour l''agiter de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: የእርሱ እጆች ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳቱን ቍርባን ያመጣሉ፤ ፍርምባው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ይወዘውዝ ዘንድ ስቡንና ፍርምባውን ያመጣል።

verses.en: And the priest shall burn the fat upon the altar: but the breast shall be Aaron's and his sons'.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur brûlera la graisse sur l''autel, et la poitrine sera pour Aaron et pour ses fils.
verses.am: ካህኑም ስቡን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቃጥላል፤ ፍርምባውም ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ይሁን።

verses.en: And the right shoulder shall ye give unto the priest for an heave offering of the sacrifices of your peace offerings.
verses.fr: Dans vos sacrifices d''actions de grâces, vous donnerez au sacrificateur l''épaule droite, en la présentant par élévation.
verses.am: ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕታችሁ ቀኝ ወርቹን ለማንሣት ቍርባን እንዲሆን ለካህኑ ትሰጡታላችሁ።

verses.en: He among the sons of Aaron, that offereth the blood of the peace offerings, and the fat, shall have the right shoulder for his part.
verses.fr: Celui des fils d''Aaron qui offrira le sang et la graisse du sacrifice d''actions de grâces aura l''épaule droite pour sa part.
verses.am: ከአሮንም ልጆች የደኅንነትን መሥዋዕት ደሙንና ስቡን ለሚያቀርብ ለእርሱ ቀኝ ወርቹ እድል ፈንታው ይሆናል።

verses.en: For the wave breast and the heave shoulder have I taken of the children of Israel from off the sacrifices of their peace offerings, and have given them unto Aaron the priest and unto his sons by a statute for ever from among the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Car je prends sur les sacrifices d''actions de grâces offerts par les enfants d''Israël la poitrine qu''on agitera de côté et d''autre et l''épaule qu''on présentera par élévation, et je les donne au sacrificateur Aaron et à ses fils, par une loi perpétuelle qu''observeront les enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: የሚወዘወዘውን ፍርምባና የሚነሣውን ወርች ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕታቸው ወስጄአለሁ፥ ለካህኑ ለአሮንና ለልጆቹም ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታ እንዲሆን ከእስራኤል ልጆች ዘንድ ሰጥቼአቸዋለሁ።

verses.en: This is the portion of the anointing of Aaron, and of the anointing of his sons, out of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, in the day when he presented them to minister unto the Lord in the priest's office;
verses.fr: C''est là le droit que l''onction d''Aaron et de ses fils leur donnera sur les sacrifices consumés par le feu devant l''Eternel, depuis le jour où ils seront présentés pour être à mon service dans le sacerdoce.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርን በክህነት ያገለግሉት ዘንድ ባቀረባቸው ቀን ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነ ከእሳት ቍርባን የአሮንና የልጆቹ እድል ፈንታ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Which the Lord commanded to be given them of the children of Israel, in the day that he anointed them, by a statute for ever throughout their generations.
verses.fr: C''est ce que l''Eternel ordonne aux enfants d''Israël de leur donner depuis le jour de leur onction; ce sera une loi perpétuelle parmi leurs descendants.
verses.am: ለልጅ ልጃቸው ለዘላለም እድል ፈንታቸው እንዲሆን በቀባቸው ቀን የእስራኤል ልጆች ይሰጡአቸው ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: This is the law of the burnt offering, of the meat offering, and of the sin offering, and of the trespass offering, and of the consecrations, and of the sacrifice of the peace offerings;
verses.fr: Telle est la loi de l''holocauste, de l''offrande, du sacrifice d''expiation, du sacrifice de culpabilité, de la consécration, et du sacrifice d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትና የእህል ቍርባን፥ የኃጢአትና የበደል መሥዋዕት፥ የቅድስናና የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: Which the Lord commanded Moses in mount Sinai, in the day that he commanded the children of Israel to offer their oblations unto the Lord, in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.fr: L''Eternel la prescrivit à Moïse sur la montagne de Sinaï, le jour où il ordonna aux enfants d''Israël de présenter leurs offrandes à l''Eternel dans le désert du Sinaï.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር በሲና ምድረ በዳ ቍርባናቸውን ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡ ዘንድ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ባዘዘ ጊዜ በሲና ተራራ ለሙሴ ያዘዘው ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Take Aaron and his sons with him, and the garments, and the anointing oil, and a bullock for the sin offering, and two rams, and a basket of unleavened bread;
verses.fr: Prends Aaron et ses fils avec lui, les vêtements, l''huile d''onction, le taureau expiatoire, les deux béliers et la corbeille de pains sans levain;
verses.am: አሮንን፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ልጆቹን፥ ልብሱንም፥ የቅብዓቱንም ዘይት፥ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕትም የሆነውን ወይፈን፥ ሁለቱንም አውራ በጎች፥ የቂጣውንም እንጀራ ሌማት ውሰድ፤

verses.en: And gather thou all the congregation together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: et convoque toute l''assemblée à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ማኅበሩንም ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሰብስባቸው።

verses.en: And Moses did as the Lord commanded him; and the assembly was gathered together unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Moïse fit ce que l''Eternel lui avait ordonné; et l''assemblée se réunit à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ሙሴም እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘው አደረገ፤ ማኅበሩ ሁሉ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ተሰበሰቡ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto the congregation, This is the thing which the Lord commanded to be done.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à l''assemblée: Voici ce que l''Eternel a ordonné de faire.
verses.am: ሙሴም ማኅበሩን። እግዚአብሔር ይደረግ ዘንድ ያዘዘው ነገር ይህ ነው አላቸው።

verses.en: And Moses brought Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.fr: Moïse fit approcher Aaron et ses fils, et il les lava avec de l''eau.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንንና ልጆቹን አቀረበ፥ በውኃም አጠባቸው።

verses.en: And he put upon him the coat, and girded him with the girdle, and clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod upon him, and he girded him with the curious girdle of the ephod, and bound it unto him therewith.
verses.fr: Il mit à Aaron la tunique, il le ceignit de la ceinture, il le revêtit de la robe, et il plaça sur lui l''éphod, qu''il serra avec la ceinture de l''éphod dont il le revêtit.
verses.am: ሸሚዝም አለበሰው፥ በመታጠቂያም አስታጠቀው፥ ቀሚስም አለበሰው፥ ኤፉድም ደረበለት፥ በብልሃትም በተጠለፈ ቋድ አስታጠቀውና በእርሱ ላይ አሰረው።

verses.en: And he put the breastplate upon him: also he put in the breastplate the Urim and the Thummim.
verses.fr: Il lui mit le pectoral, et il joignit au pectoral l''urim et le thummim.
verses.am: የደረት ኪስ በእርሱ ላይ አደረገ፤ በደረቱ ኪስም ውስጥ ኡሪምንና ቱሚምን አኖረበት።

verses.en: And he put the mitre upon his head; also upon the mitre, even upon his forefront, did he put the golden plate, the holy crown; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Il posa la tiare sur sa tête, et il plaça sur le devant de la tiare la lame d''or, diadème sacré, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው በራሱ ላይ መጠምጠሚያውን አደረገ፤ በመጠምጠሚያውም ላይ በፊቱ በኩል የተቀደሰውን አክሊል፥ ቅጠል የሚመስለውን የወርቅ ምልክት፥ አደረገ።

verses.en: And Moses took the anointing oil, and anointed the tabernacle and all that was therein, and sanctified them.
verses.fr: Moïse prit l''huile d''onction, il oignit le sanctuaire et toutes les choses qui y étaient, et le sanctifia.
verses.am: ሙሴም የቅብዓቱን ዘይት ወሰደ፥ ማደሪያውንና በውስጡ ያለውን ሁሉ ቀብቶ ቀደሳቸው።

verses.en: And he sprinkled thereof upon the altar seven times, and anointed the altar and all his vessels, both the laver and his foot, to sanctify them.
verses.fr: Il en fit sept fois l''aspersion sur l''autel, et il oignit l''autel et tous ses ustensiles, et la cuve avec sa base, afin de les sanctifier.
verses.am: ከእርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ ሰባት ጊዜ ረጨ፤ ይቀድሳቸውም ዘንድ መሠዊያውንና ዕቃውን ሁሉ፥ የመታጠቢያውን ሰንና መቀመጫውን ቀባ።

verses.en: And he poured of the anointing oil upon Aaron's head, and anointed him, to sanctify him.
verses.fr: Il répandit de l''huile d''onction sur la tête d''Aaron, et l''oignit, afin de la sanctifier.
verses.am: ከቅብዓቱም ዘይት በአሮን ራስ ላይ አፈሰሰ፥ ይቀድሰውም ዘንድ ቀባው።

verses.en: And Moses brought Aaron's sons, and put coats upon them, and girded them with girdles, and put bonnets upon them; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Moïse fit aussi approcher les fils d''Aaron; il les revêtit de tuniques, les ceignit de ceintures, et leur attacha des bonnets, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ሙሴ የአሮንን ልጆች አቀረበ፥ ቀሚሶችንም አለበሳቸው፥ በመታጠቂያም አስታጠቃቸው፥ ቆብም ደፋባቸው።

verses.en: And he brought the bullock for the sin offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the bullock for the sin offering.
verses.fr: Il fit approcher le taureau expiatoire, et Aaron et ses fils posèrent leurs mains sur la tête du taureau expiatoire.
verses.am: የኃጢአትንም መሥዋዕት ወይፈን አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ወይፈን ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.en: And he slew it; and Moses took the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about with his finger, and purified the altar, and poured the blood at the bottom of the altar, and sanctified it, to make reconciliation upon it.
verses.fr: Moïse l''égorgea, prit du sang, et en mit avec son doigt sur les cornes de l''autel tout autour, et purifia l''autel; il répandit le sang au pied de l''autel, et le sanctifia pour y faire l''expiation.
verses.am: አረደውም፤ ሙሴም ደሙን ወስዶ በጣቱ የመሠዊያውን ቀንዶች ዙሪያ ቀባ፥ መሠዊያውንም አነጻው፤ ደሙንም ከመሠዊያው በታች አፈሰሰው፥ ያስተሰርይለትም ዘንድ ቀደሰው።

verses.en: And he took all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and Moses burned it upon the altar.
verses.fr: Il prit toute la graisse qui couvre les entrailles, le grand lobe du foie, et les deux rognons avec leur graisse, et il brûla cela sur l''autel.
verses.am: በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ፥ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች ስባቸውንም ወሰደ፤ ሙሴም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: But the bullock, and his hide, his flesh, and his dung, he burnt with fire without the camp; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Mais il brûla au feu hors du camp le taureau, sa peau, sa chair et ses excréments, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ወይፈኑን፥ ቁርበቱንም፥ ሥጋውንም፥ ፈርሱንም ከሰፈሩ ውጭ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And he brought the ram for the burnt offering: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.fr: Il fit approcher le bélier de l''holocauste, et Aaron et ses fils posèrent leurs mains sur la tête du bélier.
verses.am: ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትም የሚሆን አውራ በግ አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.en: And he killed it; and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.fr: Moïse l''égorgea, et répandit le sang sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: አረደውም፤ ሙሴም ደሙን በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ረጨው።

verses.en: And he cut the ram into pieces; and Moses burnt the head, and the pieces, and the fat.
verses.fr: Il coupa le bélier par morceaux, et il brûla la tête, les morceaux et la graisse.
verses.am: አውራውንም በግ በየብልቱ ቈረጠ፤ ሙሴም ጭንቅላቱን ብልቶቹንም ስቡንም አቃጠለ።
