verses.en: And he washed the inwards and the legs in water; and Moses burnt the whole ram upon the altar: it was a burnt sacrifice for a sweet savour, and an offering made by fire unto the Lord; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Il lava avec de l''eau les entrailles et les jambes, et il brûla tout le bélier sur l''autel: ce fut l''holocauste, ce fut un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹንም በውኃ አጠበ፤ ሙሴም አውራውን በግ ሁሉ በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው፤ ይህ ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ነበረ፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቍርባን ነበረ።

verses.en: And he brought the other ram, the ram of consecration: and Aaron and his sons laid their hands upon the head of the ram.
verses.fr: Il fit approcher l''autre bélier, le bélier de consécration, et Aaron et ses fils posèrent leurs mains sur la tête du bélier.
verses.am: ለቅድስናም የሚሆነውን ሁለተኛውን አውራ በግ አቀረበ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹም በአውራው በግ ራስ ላይ እጆቻቸውን ጫኑ።

verses.en: And he slew it; and Moses took of the blood of it, and put it upon the tip of Aaron's right ear, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot.
verses.fr: Moïse égorgea le bélier, prit de son sang, et en mit sur le lobe de l''oreille droite d''Aaron, sur le pouce de sa main droite et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit.
verses.am: አረደውም፤ ሙሴን ከደሙ ወስዶ የአሮንን የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት አስነካው።

verses.en: And he brought Aaron's sons, and Moses put of the blood upon the tip of their right ear, and upon the thumbs of their right hands, and upon the great toes of their right feet: and Moses sprinkled the blood upon the altar round about.
verses.fr: Il fit approcher les fils d''Aaron, mit du sang sur le lobe de leur oreille droite, sur le pouce de leur main droite et sur le gros orteil de leur pied droit, et il répandit le sang sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: የአሮንንም ልጆች አቀረበ፤ ሙሴም የቀኝ ጆሮአቸውን ጫፍ፥ የቀን እጃቸውንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግራቸውንም አውራ ጣት ከደሙ አስነካ፤ ሙሴም ደሙን በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ረጨ።

verses.en: And he took the fat, and the rump, and all the fat that was upon the inwards, and the caul above the liver, and the two kidneys, and their fat, and the right shoulder:
verses.fr: Il prit la graisse, la queue, toute la graisse qui couvre les entrailles, le grand lobe du foie, les deux rognons avec leur graisse, et l''épaule droite;
verses.am: ስቡንና ላቱን፥ በሆድ ዕቃውም ላይ ያለውን ስብ ሁሉ፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ፥ ሁለቱንም ኵላሊቶች ስባቸውንም፥ ቀኝ ወርቹንም ወሰደ፤

verses.en: And out of the basket of unleavened bread, that was before the Lord, he took one unleavened cake, and a cake of oiled bread, and one wafer, and put them on the fat, and upon the right shoulder:
verses.fr: il prit aussi dans la corbeille de pains sans levain, placée devant l''Eternel, un gâteau sans levain, un gâteau de pain à l''huile et une galette, et il les posa sur les graisses et sur l''épaule droite.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ካለው ከቂጣው እንጀራ ሌማት አንድ የቂጣ እንጐቻ፥ አንድም የዘይት እንጀራ፥ አንድም ስስ ቂጣ ወስዶ በስቡና በቀኝ ወርቹ ላይ አኖራቸው።

verses.en: And he put all upon Aaron's hands, and upon his sons' hands, and waved them for a wave offering before the Lord.
verses.fr: Il mit toutes ces choses sur les mains d''Aaron et sur les mains de ses fils, et il les agita de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሁሉንም በአሮንና በልጆቹ እጆች ላይ አደረገ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ወዘወዛቸው።

verses.en: And Moses took them from off their hands, and burnt them on the altar upon the burnt offering: they were consecrations for a sweet savour: it is an offering made by fire unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Puis Moïse les ôta de leurs mains, et il les brûla sur l''autel, par-dessus l''holocauste: ce fut le sacrifice de consécration, ce fut un sacrifice consumé par le feu, d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከእጃቸው ተቀብሎ በመሠዊያው በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ላይ አቃጠለው፤ የጣፋጭ ሽታ መቀደሻ ነበረ። እርሱም ለእግዚአብሔር የእሳት ቁርባን ነበረ።

verses.en: And Moses took the breast, and waved it for a wave offering before the Lord: for of the ram of consecration it was Moses' part; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Moïse prit la poitrine du bélier de consécration, et il l''agita de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel: ce fut la portion de Moïse, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: ሙሴም ፍርምባውን ወስዶ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን ወዘወዘው፤ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ይህ ለቅድስና ከታረደው አውራ በግ የሙሴ እድል ፈንታ ሆነ።

verses.en: And Moses took of the anointing oil, and of the blood which was upon the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and upon his garments, and upon his sons, and upon his sons' garments with him; and sanctified Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and his sons' garments with him.
verses.fr: Moïse prit de l''huile d''onction et du sang qui était sur l''autel; il en fit l''aspersion sur Aaron et sur ses vêtements, sur les fils d''Aaron et sur leurs vêtements; et il sanctifia Aaron et ses vêtements, les fils d''Aaron et leurs vêtements avec lui.
verses.am: ሙሴም ከቅብዓቱ ዘይትና በመሠዊያው ላይ ካለው ከደሙ ወስዶ በአሮንና በልብሱ ላይ፥ በልጆቹና በልጆቹ ልብስ ላይ ረጨው፤ አሮንንና ልብሱንም፥ ልጆቹንም የልጆቹንም ልብስ ቀደሰ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron and to his sons, Boil the flesh at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and there eat it with the bread that is in the basket of consecrations, as I commanded, saying, Aaron and his sons shall eat it.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Aaron et à ses fils: Faites cuire la chair à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation; c''est là que vous la mangerez, avec le pain qui est dans la corbeille de consécration, comme je l''ai ordonné, en disant: Aaron et ses fils la mangeront.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንንና ልጆቹን አላቸው። ሥጋውን በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ቀቅሉ፤ አሮንና ልጆቹ ይበሉታል ብዬ እንዳዘዝሁ በዚያ እርሱንና በሌማቱ ያለውን የቅድስናውን እንጀራ ብሉ።

verses.en: And that which remaineth of the flesh and of the bread shall ye burn with fire.
verses.fr: Vous brûlerez dans le feu ce qui restera de la chair et du pain.
verses.am: ከሥጋውና ከእንጀራውም የተረፈውን በእሳት ታቃጥሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And ye shall not go out of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation in seven days, until the days of your consecration be at an end: for seven days shall he consecrate you.
verses.fr: Pendant sept jours, vous ne sortirez point de l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, jusqu''à ce que les jours de votre consécration soient accomplis; car sept jours seront employés à vous consacrer.
verses.am: ሰባት ቀን ይክናችኋልና የክህነታችሁ ቀን እስኪፈጸም ድረስ ሰባት ቀን ከማኅበሩ ድንኳን ደጃፍ አትውጡ።

verses.en: As he hath done this day, so the Lord hath commanded to do, to make an atonement for you.
verses.fr: Ce qui s''est fait aujourd''hui, l''Eternel a ordonné de le faire comme expiation pour vous.
verses.am: በዚህ ቀን እንደ ተደረገ ለእናንተ ለማስተስረያ ይደረግ ዘንድ እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔር አዘዘ።

verses.en: Therefore shall ye abide at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation day and night seven days, and keep the charge of the Lord, that ye die not: for so I am commanded.
verses.fr: Vous resterez donc sept jours à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, jour et nuit, et vous observerez les commandements de l''Eternel, afin que vous ne mouriez pas; car c''est là ce qui m''a été ordonné.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔር እንዲሁ አዝዞኛልና እንዳትሞቱ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ሌሊቱንና ቀኑን ሰባት ቀን ተቀመጡ፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ሥርዓት ጠብቁ።

verses.en: So Aaron and his sons did all things which the Lord commanded by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: Aaron et ses fils firent toutes les choses que l''Eternel avait ordonnées par Moïse.
verses.am: አሮንና ልጆቹም እግዚአብሔር በሙሴ እጅ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ።

verses.en: And it came to pass on the eighth day, that Moses called Aaron and his sons, and the elders of Israel;
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, Moïse appela Aaron et ses fils, et les anciens d''Israël.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን እንዲህ ሆነ፤ ሙሴ አሮንንና ልጆቹን የእስራኤልንም ሽማግሌዎች ጠራ።

verses.en: And he said unto Aaron, Take thee a young calf for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering, without blemish, and offer them before the Lord.
verses.fr: Il dit à Aaron: Prends un jeune veau pour le sacrifice d''expiation, et un bélier pour l''holocauste, l''un et l''autre sans défaut, et sacrifie-les devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: አሮንንም አለው። ስለ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ከመንጋው እምቦሳውን፥ ስለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አውራውን በግ ነውር የሌለባቸውን ወስደህ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቅርባቸው።

verses.en: And unto the children of Israel thou shalt speak, saying, Take ye a kid of the goats for a sin offering; and a calf and a lamb, both of the first year, without blemish, for a burnt offering;
verses.fr: Tu parleras aux enfants d''Israël, et tu diras: Prenez un bouc, pour le sacrifice d''expiation, un veau et un agneau, âgés d''un an et sans défaut, pour l''holocauste;
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም ልጆች። ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር ይገለጥላችኋልና ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አውራ ፍየልን፥ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸውን አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸውን እምቦሳና ጠቦትን፥ ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት በሬንና አውራን በግ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ የእህልን ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይሠዉ ዘንድ ውሰዱ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.en: Also a bullock and a ram for peace offerings, to sacrifice before the Lord; and a meat offering mingled with oil: for to day the Lord will appear unto you.
verses.fr: un boeuf et un bélier, pour le sacrifice d''actions de grâces, afin de les sacrifier devant l''Eternel; et une offrande pétrie à l''huile. Car aujourd''hui l''Eternel vous apparaîtra.
verses.am: የእስራኤልንም ልጆች። ዛሬ እግዚአብሔር ይገለጥላችኋልና ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት አውራ ፍየልን፥ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት ነውር የሌለባቸውን አንድ ዓመት የሆናቸውን እምቦሳና ጠቦትን፥ ለደኅንነትም መሥዋዕት በሬንና አውራን በግ፥ በዘይትም የተለወሰ የእህልን ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይሠዉ ዘንድ ውሰዱ ብለህ ንገራቸው።

verses.en: And they brought that which Moses commanded before the tabernacle of the congregation: and all the congregation drew near and stood before the Lord.
verses.fr: Ils amenèrent devant la tente d''assignation ce que Moïse avait ordonné; et toute l''assemblée s''approcha, et se tint devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሙሴም ያዘዛቸውን ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አመጡ፤ ማኅበሩም ሁሉ ቀርበው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆሙ።

verses.en: And Moses said, This is the thing which the Lord commanded that ye should do: and the glory of the Lord shall appear unto you.
verses.fr: Moïse dit: Vous ferez ce que l''Eternel a ordonné; et la gloire de l''Eternel vous apparaîtra.
verses.am: ሙሴም። ታደርጉት ዘንድ እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ይህ ነው፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ይገለጥላችኋል አለ።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Go unto the altar, and offer thy sin offering, and thy burnt offering, and make an atonement for thyself, and for the people: and offer the offering of the people, and make an atonement for them; as the Lord commanded.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Aaron: Approche-toi de l''autel; offre ton sacrifice d''expiation et ton holocauste, et fais l''expiation pour toi et pour le peuple; offre aussi le sacrifice du peuple, et fais l''expiation pour lui, comme l''Eternel l''a ordonné.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። ወደ መሠዊያው ቀርበህ የኃጢአትህን መሥዋዕትና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትህን ሠዋ፥ ለራስህና ለሕዝቡም አስተስርይ፤ እግዚአብሔርም እንዳዘዘ የሕዝቡን ቍርባን አቅርብ አስተስርይላቸውም አለው።

verses.en: Aaron therefore went unto the altar, and slew the calf of the sin offering, which was for himself.
verses.fr: Aaron s''approcha de l''autel, et il égorgea le veau pour son sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: አሮንም ወደ መሠዊያው ቀርቦ ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን እምቦሳ አረደ።

verses.en: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood unto him: and he dipped his finger in the blood, and put it upon the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the bottom of the altar:
verses.fr: Les fils d''Aaron lui présentèrent le sang; il trempa son doigt dans le sang, en mit sur les cornes de l''autel, et répandit le sang au pied de l''autel.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አቀረቡለት፤ ጣቱንም በደሙ ውስጥ ነክሮ የመሠዊያውን ቀንዶች አስነካ፥ ደሙንም ከመሠዊያው በታች አፈሰሰው።

verses.en: But the fat, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver of the sin offering, he burnt upon the altar; as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Il brûla sur l''autel la graisse, les rognons, et le grand lobe du foie de la victime expiatoire, comme l''Eternel l''avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው ከኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ስቡንና ኵላሊቶቹን፥ የጕበቱንም መረብ በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And the flesh and the hide he burnt with fire without the camp.
verses.fr: Mais il brûla au feu hors du camp la chair et la peau.
verses.am: ሥጋውንና ቁርበቱንም ከሰፈሩ ውጭ በእሳት አቃጠለ።

verses.en: And he slew the burnt offering; and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled round about upon the altar.
verses.fr: Il égorgea l''holocauste. Les fils d''Aaron lui présentèrent le sang, et il le répandit sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አረደ፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አመጡለት፥ እርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ በዙሪያው ረጨው።

verses.en: And they presented the burnt offering unto him, with the pieces thereof, and the head: and he burnt them upon the altar.
verses.fr: Ils lui présentèrent l''holocauste coupé par morceaux, avec la tête, et il les brûla sur l''autel.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት በየብልቱ፥ ራሱንም አመጡለት፤ እርሱም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: And he did wash the inwards and the legs, and burnt them upon the burnt offering on the altar.
verses.fr: Il lava les entrailles et les jambes, et il les brûla sur l''autel, par dessus l''holocauste.
verses.am: የሆድ ዕቃውንና እግሮቹንም አጠበ፤ በመሠዊያውም በሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: And he brought the people's offering, and took the goat, which was the sin offering for the people, and slew it, and offered it for sin, as the first.
verses.fr: Ensuite, il offrit le sacrifice du peuple. Il prit le bouc pour le sacrifice expiatoire du peuple, il l''égorgea, et l''offrit en expiation, comme la première victime.
verses.am: የሕዝቡንም ቍርባን አቀረበ፤ ስለ ሕዝቡ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት የሆነውን ፍየል ወስዶ አረደው፥ ስለ ኃጢአትም እንደ ፊተኛው ሠዋው።

verses.en: And he brought the burnt offering, and offered it according to the manner.
verses.fr: Il offrit l''holocauste, et le sacrifia, d''après les règles établies.
verses.am: የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕት አቀረበ፥ እንደ ሥርዓቱም አደረገው።

verses.en: And he brought the meat offering, and took an handful thereof, and burnt it upon the altar, beside the burnt sacrifice of the morning.
verses.fr: Il présenta l''offrande, en prit une poignée, et la brûla sur l''autel, outre l''holocauste du matin.
verses.am: የእህሉንም ቍርባን አቀረበ፥ ከእርሱም እፍኝ ሙሉ ወስዶ በጥዋት ከሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ሌላ በመሰዊያው ላይ አቃጠለው።

verses.en: He slew also the bullock and the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings, which was for the people: and Aaron's sons presented unto him the blood, which he sprinkled upon the altar round about,
verses.fr: Il égorgea le boeuf et le bélier, en sacrifice d''actions de grâces pour le peuple. Les fils d''Aaron lui présentèrent le sang, et il le répandit sur l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡ የሆነውን የደኅንነት መሥዋዕት በሬውንና አውራውን በግ አረደ፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ደሙን አመጡለት፥

verses.en: And the fat of the bullock and of the ram, the rump, and that which covereth the inwards, and the kidneys, and the caul above the liver:
verses.fr: Ils lui présentèrent la graisse du boeuf et du bélier, la queue, la graisse qui couvre les entrailles, les rognons, et le grand lobe du foie;
verses.am: በመሠዊያውም ላይ በዙሪያው ረጨው፤ የበሬውንና የአራውንም በግ ስብ፥ ላቱንም፥ የሆድ ዕቃውንም የሚሸፍነውን ስብ፥ ኩላሊቶቹንም፥ የጉበቱንም መረብ አመጡለት።

verses.en: And they put the fat upon the breasts, and he burnt the fat upon the altar:
verses.fr: ils mirent les graisses sur les poitrines, et il brûla les graisses sur l''autel.
verses.am: ስቡንም በፍርምባዎቹ ላይ አደረጉ፥ ስቡንም በመሠዊያው ላይ አቃጠለ፤

verses.en: And the breasts and the right shoulder Aaron waved for a wave offering before the Lord; as Moses commanded.
verses.fr: Aaron agita de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel les poitrines et l''épaule droite, comme Moïse l''avait ordonné.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው አሮን ፍርምባዎቹንና ቀኝ ወርቹን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቁርባን ወዘወዘው።

verses.en: And Aaron lifted up his hand toward the people, and blessed them, and came down from offering of the sin offering, and the burnt offering, and peace offerings.
verses.fr: Aaron leva ses mains vers le peuple, et il le bénit. Puis il descendit, après avoir offert le sacrifice d''expiation, l''holocauste et le sacrifice d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: አሮንም እጆቹን ወደ ሕዝቡ ዘረጋ ባረካቸውም፤ የኃጢያቱን የሚቃጠለውንም የደኅንነቱንም መሥዋዕት ከሠዋ በኋላ ወረደ።

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron went into the tabernacle of the congregation, and came out, and blessed the people: and the glory of the Lord appeared unto all the people.
verses.fr: Moïse et Aaron entrèrent dans la tente d''assignation. Lorsqu''ils en sortirent, ils bénirent le peuple. Et la gloire de l''Eternel apparut à tout le peuple.
verses.am: ሙሴና አሮንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ገቡ፤ ወጡም፥ ሕዝቡንም ባረኩ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ክብር ለሕዝቡ ሁሉ ተገለጠ።

verses.en: And there came a fire out from before the Lord, and consumed upon the altar the burnt offering and the fat: which when all the people saw, they shouted, and fell on their faces.
verses.fr: Le feu sortit de devant l''Eternel, et consuma sur l''autel l''holocauste et les graisses. Tout le peuple le vit; et ils poussèrent des cris de joie, et se jetèrent sur leur face.
verses.am: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ወጣ፥ በመሠዊያውም ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ስቡንም በላ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ አይተው እልል አሉ፥ በግምባራቸውም ወደቁ።

verses.en: And Nadab and Abihu, the sons of Aaron, took either of them his censer, and put fire therein, and put incense thereon, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which he commanded them not.
verses.fr: Les fils d''Aaron, Nadab et Abihu, prirent chacun un brasier, y mirent du feu, et posèrent du parfum dessus; ils apportèrent devant l''Eternel du feu étranger, ce qu''il ne leur avait point ordonné.
verses.am: የአሮንም ልጆች ናዳብና አብዩድ በየራሳቸው ጥናውን ወስደው እሳት አደረጉበት፥ በላዩም ዕጣን አኖሩበት፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እርሱ ያላዘዛቸውን ሌላ እሳት አቀረቡ።

verses.en: And there went out fire from the Lord, and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.
verses.fr: Alors le feu sortit de devant l''Eternel, et les consuma: ils moururent devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: እሳትም ከእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወጥቶ በላቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ሞቱ።

verses.en: Then Moses said unto Aaron, This is it that the Lord spake, saying, I will be sanctified in them that come nigh me, and before all the people I will be glorified. And Aaron held his peace.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Aaron: C''est ce que l''Eternel a déclaré, lorsqu''il a dit: Je serai sanctifié par ceux qui s''approchent de moi, et je serai glorifié en présence de tout le peuple. Aaron garda le silence.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን። እግዚአብሔር። ወደ እኔ በሚቀርቡ እቀድሳለሁ፥ በሕዝቡም ሁሉ ፊት እከብራለሁ ብሎ የተናገረው ይህ ነው አለው፤ አሮንም ዝም አለ

verses.en: And Moses called Mishael and Elzaphan, the sons of Uzziel the uncle of Aaron, and said unto them, Come near, carry your brethren from before the sanctuary out of the camp.
verses.fr: Et Moïse appela Mischaël et Eltsaphan, fils d''Uziel, oncle d''Aaron, et il leur dit: Approchez-vous, emportez vos frères loin du sanctuaire, hors du camp.
verses.am: ሙሴም የአሮንን አጎት የዑዝኤልን ልጆች ሚሳኤልንና ኤልጻፋንን ጠርቶ። ቅረቡ፥ ወንድሞቻችሁንም ከመቅደሱ ፊት አንሥታችሁ ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ውሰዱአቸው አላቸው።

verses.en: So they went near, and carried them in their coats out of the camp; as Moses had said.
verses.fr: Ils s''approchèrent, et ils les emportèrent dans leurs tuniques hors du camp, comme Moïse l''avait dit.
verses.am: እነርሱም ቀርበው አነሡአቸው፥ ሙሴም እንዳለ በቀሚሳቸው ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ወሰዱአቸው።

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons, Uncover not your heads, neither rend your clothes; lest ye die, and lest wrath come upon all the people: but let your brethren, the whole house of Israel, bewail the burning which the Lord hath kindled.
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Aaron, à Eléazar et à Ithamar, fils d''Aaron: Vous ne découvrirez point vos têtes, et vous ne déchirerez point vos vêtements, de peur que vous ne mouriez, et que l''Eternel ne s''irrite contre toute l''assemblée. Laissez vos frères, toute la maison d''Israël, pleurer sur l''embrasement que l''Eternel a allumé.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን፥ ልጆቹንም አልዓዛርንና ኢታምርን። እንዳትሞቱ በማኅበሩም ሁሉ ላይ ቁጣ እንዳይወርድ ራሳችሁን አትንጩ፥ ልብሳችሁንም አትቅደዱ፤ እግዚአብሔር ስላቃጠለው ማቃጠል ግን ወንድሞቻችሁ የእስራኤል ቤት ሁሉ ያልቅሱ።

verses.en: And ye shall not go out from the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: for the anointing oil of the Lord is upon you. And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.fr: Vous ne sortirez point de l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, de peur que vous ne mouriez; car l''huile de l''onction de l''Eternel est sur vous. Ils firent ce que Moïse avait dit.
verses.am: የእግዚአብሔር የቅብዓት ዘይት በላያችሁ ነውና እንዳትሞቱ ከመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አትወጡም አላቸው። እንደ ሙሴ ቃልም አደረጉ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Do not drink wine nor strong drink, thou, nor thy sons with thee, when ye go into the tabernacle of the congregation, lest ye die: it shall be a statute for ever throughout your generations:
verses.fr: Tu ne boiras ni vin, ni boisson enivrante, toi et tes fils avec toi, lorsque vous entrerez dans la tente d''assignation, de peur que vous ne mouriez: ce sera une loi perpétuelle parmi vos descendants,
verses.am: እንዳትሞቱ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ስትገቡ አንተና ልጆችህ የወይን ጠጅና የሚያሰክርን ነገር ሁሉ አትጠጡ፤ ይህም ለልጅ ልጃችሁ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል፤

verses.en: And that ye may put difference between holy and unholy, and between unclean and clean;
verses.fr: afin que vous puissiez distinguer ce qui est saint de ce qui est profane, ce qui est impur de ce qui est pur,
verses.am: በተቀደሰውና ባልተቀደሰው፥ በርኩሱና በንጹሑም መካከል ትለያላችሁ፤

verses.en: And that ye may teach the children of Israel all the statutes which the Lord hath spoken unto them by the hand of Moses.
verses.fr: et enseigner aux enfants d''Israël toutes les lois que l''Eternel leur a données par Moïse.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም በሙሴ ቃል የነገራቸውን ሥርዓት ሁሉ ለእስራኤል ልጆች ታስተምራላችሁ።

verses.en: And Moses spake unto Aaron, and unto Eleazar and unto Ithamar, his sons that were left, Take the meat offering that remaineth of the offerings of the Lord made by fire, and eat it without leaven beside the altar: for it is most holy:
verses.fr: Moïse dit à Aaron, à Eléazar et à Ithamar, les deux fils qui restaient à Aaron: Prenez ce qui reste de l''offrande parmi les sacrifices consumés par le feu devant l''Eternel, et mangez-le sans levain près de l''autel: car c''est une chose très sainte.
verses.am: ሙሴም አሮንን፥ የተረፉለትንም ልጆቹን አልዓዛርንና ኢታምርን አላቸው። ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነውና ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነው ከእሳት ቁርባን የቀረውን የእህሉን ቁርባን ውሰዱ፥ ቂጣም አድርጋችሁ በመሠዊያው አጠገብ ብሉት እግዚአብሔርም እንዲህ አዞኛል፥

verses.en: And ye shall eat it in the holy place, because it is thy due, and thy sons' due, of the sacrifices of the Lord made by fire: for so I am commanded.
verses.fr: Vous le mangerez dans un lieu saint; c''est ton droit et le droit de tes fils sur les offrandes consumées par le feu devant l''Eternel; car c''est là ce qui m''a été ordonné.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ከሆነው ከእሳት ቁርባን ለአንተም ለልጆችህም የተሰጠ ሥርዓት ነውና በቅዱስ ስፍራ ትበሉታላችሁ።

verses.en: And the wave breast and heave shoulder shall ye eat in a clean place; thou, and thy sons, and thy daughters with thee: for they be thy due, and thy sons' due, which are given out of the sacrifices of peace offerings of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Vous mangerez aussi dans un lieu pur, toi, tes fils et tes filles avec toi, la poitrine qu''on a agitée de côté et d''autre et l''épaule qui a été présentée par élévation; car elles vous sont données, comme ton droit et le droit de tes fils, dans les sacrifices d''actions de grâces des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: እነዚህም ከእስራኤል ልጆች ከደኅንነት መሥዋዕቶች ለአንተና ለልጆችህ ሥርዓት እንዲሆኑ ስለ ተሰጡ፥ የሚወዘወዘውን ፍርምባ፥ የሚነሣውንም ወርች አንተ፥ ከአንተ ጋርም ልጆችህ፥ ሴቶች ልጆችህም በንጹሕ ስፍራ ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: The heave shoulder and the wave breast shall they bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before the Lord; and it shall be thine, and thy sons' with thee, by a statute for ever; as the Lord hath commanded.
verses.fr: Ils apporteront, avec les graisses destinées à être consumées par le feu, l''épaule que l''on présente par élévation et la poitrine que l''on agite de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel: elles seront pour toi et pour tes fils avec toi, par une loi perpétuelle, comme l''Eternel l''a ordonné.
verses.am: የሚነሣውን ወርች የሚወዘወዘውንም ፍርምባ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ለመወዝወዝ ቁርባን እንዲወዘውዙ የእሳት ቁርባን ከሆነው ስብ ጋር ያመጣሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዳዘዘ ለአንተ ከአንተ ጋርም ለልጆችህ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሆናል።

verses.en: And Moses diligently sought the goat of the sin offering, and, behold, it was burnt: and he was angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron which were left alive, saying,
verses.fr: Moïse chercha le bouc expiatoire; et voici, il avait été brûlé. Alors il s''irrita contre Eléazar et Ithamar, les fils qui restaient à Aaron, et il dit:
verses.am: ሙሴም የኃጢያቱን መሥዋዕት ፍየል እጅግ ፈለገው፥ እነሆም ተቃጥሎ ነበር፤ ሙሴም የቀሩትን የአሮንን ልጆች አልአዛርንና ኢታምርን ተቈጥቶ።

verses.en: Wherefore have ye not eaten the sin offering in the holy place, seeing it is most holy, and God hath given it you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before the Lord?
verses.fr: Pourquoi n''avez-vous pas mangé la victime expiatoire dans le lieu saint? C''est une chose très sainte; et l''Eternel vous l''a donnée, afin que vous portiez l''iniquité de l''assemblée, afin que vous fassiez pour elle l''expiation devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነውና፥ የሕዝቡንም ኃጢያት እንድትሸከሙ፥ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት እንድታስተሰርዩላቸው ለእናንተ ሰጥቶታልና ስለ ምን የኃጢያትን መሥዋዕት በቅዱሱ ስፍራ አልበላችሁም?

verses.en: Behold, the blood of it was not brought in within the holy place: ye should indeed have eaten it in the holy place, as I commanded.
verses.fr: Voici, le sang de la victime n''a point été porté dans l''intérieur du sanctuaire; vous deviez la manger dans le sanctuaire, comme cela m''avait été ordonné.
verses.am: እነሆ ደሙን ወደ መቅደሱ ውስጥ አላገባችሁትም፤ እኔ እንዳዘዝሁ በቅዱሱ ስፍራ ውስጥ ትበሉት ዘንድ ይገባችሁ ነበር አላቸው።

verses.en: And Aaron said unto Moses, Behold, this day have they offered their sin offering and their burnt offering before the Lord; and such things have befallen me: and if I had eaten the sin offering to day, should it have been accepted in the sight of the Lord?
verses.fr: Aaron dit à Moïse: Voici, ils ont offert aujourd''hui leur sacrifice d''expiation et leur holocauste devant l''Eternel; et, après ce qui m''est arrivé, si j''eusse mangé aujourd''hui la victime expiatoire, cela aurait-il été bien aux yeux de l''Eternel?
verses.am: አሮንም ሙሴን። እነሆ ዛሬ የኃጢያታቸውን መሥዋዕት፥ የሚቃጠለውንም መሥዋዕታቸውን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት አቀረቡ፤ ይህም ሁሉ ደረሰብኝ፤ ዛሬስ የኃጢያት መሥዋዕት በበላሁ ኖሮ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት መልካም ኖሮአልን? አለው።

verses.en: And when Moses heard that, he was content.
verses.fr: Moïse entendit et approuva ces paroles.
verses.am: ሙሴም ሰማ በፊቱም መልካም ሆነ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying unto them,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et leur dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, These are the beasts which ye shall eat among all the beasts that are on the earth.
verses.fr: Parlez aux enfants d''Israël, et dites: Voici les animaux dont vous mangerez parmi toutes les bêtes qui sont sur la terre.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ በሉአቸው። ከምድር እንስሶች ሁሉ የምትበሉአቸው እነዚህ ናቸው።

verses.en: Whatsoever parteth the hoof, and is clovenfooted, and cheweth the cud, among the beasts, that shall ye eat.
verses.fr: Vous mangerez de tout animal qui a la corne fendue, le pied fourchu, et qui rumine.
verses.am: የተሰነጠቀ ሰኮና ያለውንና የሚያመሰኳውን እንስሳ ሁሉ ብሉ።

verses.en: Nevertheless these shall ye not eat of them that chew the cud, or of them that divide the hoof: as the camel, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.fr: Mais vous ne mangerez pas de ceux qui ruminent seulement, ou qui ont la corne fendue seulement. Ainsi, vous ne mangerez pas le chameau, qui rumine, mais qui n''a pas la corne fendue: vous le regarderez comme impur.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሚያመሰኩት፥ ሰኮናቸው ስንጥቅ ከሆነው ከእነዚህ አትበሉም፤ ግመል ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And the coney, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez pas le daman, qui rumine, mais qui n''a pas la corne fendue: vous le regarderez comme impur.
verses.am: ሽኮኮ ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኰናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And the hare, because he cheweth the cud, but divideth not the hoof; he is unclean unto you.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez pas le lièvre, qui rumine, mais qui n''a pas la corne fendue: vous le regarderez comme impur.
verses.am: ጥንቸልም ያመሰኳል፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ስላልተሰነጠቀ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And the swine, though he divide the hoof, and be clovenfooted, yet he cheweth not the cud; he is unclean to you.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez pas le porc, qui a la corne fendue et le pied fourchu, mais qui ne rumine pas: vous le regarderez comme impur.
verses.am: እርያም ሰኮናው ተሰንጥቋል፥ ነገር ግን ስለማያመሰኳ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: Of their flesh shall ye not eat, and their carcase shall ye not touch; they are unclean to you.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez pas de leur chair, et vous ne toucherez pas leurs corps morts: vous les regarderez comme impurs.
verses.am: የእነዚህን ሥጋ አትበሉም፥ በድናቸውንም አትነኩም፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.en: These shall ye eat of all that are in the waters: whatsoever hath fins and scales in the waters, in the seas, and in the rivers, them shall ye eat.
verses.fr: Voici les animaux dont vous mangerez parmi tous ceux qui sont dans les eaux. Vous mangerez de tous ceux qui ont des nageoires et des écailles, et qui sont dans les eaux, soit dans les mers, soit dans les rivières.
verses.am: በውኃ ውስጥ ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ በውኆች በባሕሮችም በወንዞችም ውስጥ ከሚኖሩት ሁሉ ክንፍና ቅርፊት ያላቸውን ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination unto you:
verses.fr: Mais vous aurez en abomination tous ceux qui n''ont pas des nageoires et des écailles, parmi tout ce qui se meut dans les eaux et tout ce qui est vivant dans les eaux, soit dans les mers, soit dans les rivières.
verses.am: በውኆቹ ውስጥ ከሚንቀሳቀሱ፥ በውኆች ውስጥ የሕይወት ነፍስ ካላቸው ሁሉ፥ በባሕሮችና በወንዞች ውስጥ ክንፍና ቅርፊት የሌላቸው ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ናቸው።

verses.en: They shall be even an abomination unto you; ye shall not eat of their flesh, but ye shall have their carcases in abomination.
verses.fr: Vous les aurez en abomination, vous ne mangerez pas de leur chair, et vous aurez en abomination leurs corps morts.
verses.am: በእናንተም ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ይሆናሉ፤ ሥጋቸውንም አትበሉም፥ በድናቸውንም ትጸየፋላችሁ።

verses.en: Whatsoever hath no fins nor scales in the waters, that shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.fr: Vous aurez en abomination tous ceux qui, dans les eaux, n''ont pas des nageoires et des écailles.
verses.am: ክንፍና ቅርፊትም የሌላቸው በውኃ ውስጥ የሚኖሩት ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፉ ናቸው።

verses.en: And these are they which ye shall have in abomination among the fowls; they shall not be eaten, they are an abomination: the eagle, and the ossifrage, and the ospray,
verses.fr: Voici, parmi les oiseaux, ceux que vous aurez en abomination, et dont on ne mangera pas: l''aigle, l''orfraie et l''aigle de mer;
verses.am: ከወፎችም ወገን የምትጸየፉአቸው እነዚህ ናቸው፤ አይበሉም፤ የተጸየፉ ናቸው፤

verses.en: And the vulture, and the kite after his kind;
verses.fr: le milan, l''autour et ce qui est de son espèce;
verses.am: ንስር፥ ገዲ፥ ዓሣ አውጭ፥ ጭላት፥ ጭልፊት በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: Every raven after his kind;
verses.fr: le corbeau et toutes ses espèces;
verses.am: ቁራ ሁሉ በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: And the owl, and the night hawk, and the cuckow, and the hawk after his kind,
verses.fr: l''autruche, le hibou, la mouette, l''épervier et ce qui est de son espèce;
verses.am: ሰጎን፥ ጠላቋ፥ ዝዪ፥ በቋል በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: And the little owl, and the cormorant, and the great owl,
verses.fr: le chat-huant, le plongeon et la chouette;
verses.am: ይብራ፥ ጥምብ አንሣ አሞራ፥ ሽመላ፥ ሳቢሳ በየወገኑ፥ ጅንጁላቴ ወፍ፥ የሌሊት ወፍ።

verses.en: And the swan, and the pelican, and the gier eagle,
verses.fr: le cygne, le pélican et le cormoran;
verses.am: ይብራ፥ ጥምብ አንሣ አሞራ፥ ሽመላ፥ ሳቢሳ በየወገኑ፥ ጅንጁላቴ ወፍ፥ የሌሊት ወፍ።

verses.en: And the stork, the heron after her kind, and the lapwing, and the bat.
verses.fr: la cigogne, le héron et ce qui est de son espèce, la huppe et la chauve-souris.
verses.am: የሚበርርም፥ በአራት እግሮችም የሚሔድ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፈ ነው።

verses.en: All fowls that creep, going upon all four, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.fr: Vous aurez en abomination tout reptile qui vole et qui marche sur quatre pieds.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ከሚበርሩት፥ አራትም እግሮች ካሉአቸው፥ ከእግሮቻቸውም በላይ በምድር ላይ የሚዘልሉባቸው ጭኖች ካሉአቸው ተንቀሳቃሾች እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ።

verses.en: Yet these may ye eat of every flying creeping thing that goeth upon all four, which have legs above their feet, to leap withal upon the earth;
verses.fr: Mais, parmi tous les reptiles qui volent et qui marchent sur quatre pieds, vous mangerez ceux qui ont des jambes au-dessus de leurs pieds, pour sauter sur la terre.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም እነዚህን ትበላላችሁ፤ አራቱን ዓይነት አንበጣዎች በየወገናቸው።

verses.en: Even these of them ye may eat; the locust after his kind, and the bald locust after his kind, and the beetle after his kind, and the grasshopper after his kind.
verses.fr: Voici ceux que vous mangerez: la sauterelle, le solam, le hargol et le hagab, selon leurs espèces.
verses.am: ነገር ግን የሚበርር፥ አራትም እግሮች ያሉት ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ የተጸየፈ ነው።

verses.en: But all other flying creeping things, which have four feet, shall be an abomination unto you.
verses.fr: Vous aurez en abomination tous les autres reptiles qui volent et qui ont quatre pieds.
verses.am: በእነዚህም ርኩስ ትሆናላችሁ፤ የእነርሱንም በድን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And for these ye shall be unclean: whosoever toucheth the carcase of them shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Ils vous rendront impurs: quiconque touchera leurs corps morts sera impur jusqu''au soir,
verses.am: ከእነርሱም በድን የሚያነሣ ሁሉ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever beareth ought of the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: et quiconque portera leurs corps morts lavera ses vêtements et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ሰኮናም ያለው፥ ነገር ግን ሰኮናው ያልተሰነጠቀ፥ የማያመሰኳም እንሰሳ ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው፤ እርሱን የሚነካ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: The carcases of every beast which divideth the hoof, and is not clovenfooted, nor cheweth the cud, are unclean unto you: every one that toucheth them shall be unclean.
verses.fr: Vous regarderez comme impur tout animal qui a la corne fendue, mais qui n''a pas le pied fourchu et qui ne rumine pas: quiconque le touchera sera impur.
verses.am: በአራት እግሮቹ ከሚሄድ እንስሳ ሁሉ በመዳፎቹ ላይ የሚሄድ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው፤ የእርሱን በድን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whatsoever goeth upon his paws, among all manner of beasts that go on all four, those are unclean unto you: whoso toucheth their carcase shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Vous regarderez comme impurs tous ceux des animaux à quatre pieds qui marchent sur leurs pattes: quiconque touchera leurs corps morts sera impur jusqu''au soir,
verses.am: በድናቸውንም የሚያነሣ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው። እነርሱም በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.en: And he that beareth the carcase of them shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: they are unclean unto you.
verses.fr: et quiconque portera leurs corps morts lavera ses vêtements et sera impur jusqu''au soir. Vous les regarderez comme impurs.
verses.am: በምድር ላይም ከሚንቀሳቀስ ተንቀሳቅሳሽ እነዚህ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ናቸው፤ ሙጭልጭላ፥ አይጥ፥ እንሽላሊት በየወገኑ፥

verses.en: These also shall be unclean unto you among the creeping things that creep upon the earth; the weasel, and the mouse, and the tortoise after his kind,
verses.fr: Voici, parmi les animaux qui rampent sur la terre, ceux que vous regarderez comme impurs: la taupe, la souris et le lézard, selon leurs espèces;
verses.am: ኤሊ፥ አዞ፥ ገበሎ፥ አርጃኖ፥ እስስት።

verses.en: And the ferret, and the chameleon, and the lizard, and the snail, and the mole.
verses.fr: le hérisson, la grenouille, la tortue, le limaçon et le caméléon.
verses.am: ከሚንቀሳቀሱት ሁሉ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች የሚሆኑ እነዚህ ናቸው። ከእነርሱም የሞተውን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: These are unclean to you among all that creep: whosoever doth touch them, when they be dead, shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Vous les regarderez comme impurs parmi tous les reptiles: quiconque les touchera morts sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም የሞተውን የሚነካ በምንም ላይ ቢወድቅ እርሱ ርኩስ ነው፤ የእንጨት ዕቃ ወይም ልብስ ወይም ቁርበት ወይም ከረጢት ቢሆን የሚሠራበት ዕቃ ሁሉ እርሱ በውኃ ውስጥ ይደረግ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And upon whatsoever any of them, when they are dead, doth fall, it shall be unclean; whether it be any vessel of wood, or raiment, or skin, or sack, whatsoever vessel it be, wherein any work is done, it must be put into water, and it shall be unclean until the even; so it shall be cleansed.
verses.fr: Tout objet sur lequel tombera quelque chose de leurs corps morts sera souillé, ustensile de bois, vêtement, peau, sac, tout objet dont on fait usage; il sera mis dans l''eau, et restera souillé jusqu''au soir; après quoi, il sera pur.
verses.am: ከእነርሱም አንዳች በውስጡ የወደቀበትን የሸክላውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ስበሩት፥ በውስጡም ያለው ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And every earthen vessel, whereinto any of them falleth, whatsoever is in it shall be unclean; and ye shall break it.
verses.fr: Tout ce qui se trouvera dans un vase de terre où il en tombera quelque chose, sera souillé, et vous briserez le vase.
verses.am: በእርሱ ውስጥ ያለው፥ ውኃም የሚፈስስበት የሚበላ መብል ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ በዚህም ዕቃ ሁሉ ያለው የሚጠጣ መጠጥ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: Of all meat which may be eaten, that on which such water cometh shall be unclean: and all drink that may be drunk in every such vessel shall be unclean.
verses.fr: Tout aliment qui sert à la nourriture, et sur lequel il sera tombé de cette eau, sera souillé; et toute boisson dont on fait usage, quel que soit le vase qui la contienne, sera souillée.
verses.am: ከእነዚህም በድን የሚወድቅበት ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ እቶን ወይም ምድጃ ቢሆን ይሰባበራል፤ ርኩሶች ናቸው፤ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩሶች ይሆናሉ።

verses.en: And every thing whereupon any part of their carcase falleth shall be unclean; whether it be oven, or ranges for pots, they shall be broken down: for they are unclean and shall be unclean unto you.
verses.fr: Tout objet sur lequel tombera quelque chose de leurs corps morts sera souillé; le four et le foyer seront détruits: ils seront souillés, et vous les regarderez comme souillés.
verses.am: ነገር ግን ምንጩ፥ ጕድጓዱም፥ የውኃውም ኵሬ ንጹሐን ናቸው፤ በድናቸውን ግን የሚነካ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: Nevertheless a fountain or pit, wherein there is plenty of water, shall be clean: but that which toucheth their carcase shall be unclean.
verses.fr: Il n''y aura que les sources et les citernes, formant des amas d''eaux, qui resteront pures; mais celui qui y touchera de leurs corps morts sera impur.
verses.am: ከበድናቸውም በሚዘራ ዘር ላይ አንዳች ቢወድቅ እርሱ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: And if any part of their carcase fall upon any sowing seed which is to be sown, it shall be clean.
verses.fr: S''il tombe quelque chose de leurs corps morts sur une semence qui doit être semée, elle restera pure;
verses.am: ነገር ግን በዘሩ ላይ ውኃ ቢፈስስበት፥ ከዚህ በኋላ ከበድናቸው አንዳች ቢወድቅበት፥ በእናንተ ዘንድ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: But if any water be put upon the seed, and any part of their carcase fall thereon, it shall be unclean unto you.
verses.fr: mais si l''on a mis de l''eau sur la semence, et qu''il y tombe quelque chose de leurs corps morts, vous la regarderez comme souillée.
verses.am: ለመብል ከሚሆኑላችሁ እንስሶች የሞተ ቢኖር፥ በድኑን የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And if any beast, of which ye may eat, die; he that toucheth the carcase thereof shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: S''il meurt un des animaux qui vous servent de nourriture, celui qui touchera son corps mort sera impur jusqu''au soir;
verses.am: ከበድኑም የሚበላ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ በድኑንም የሚያነሣ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And he that eateth of the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: he also that beareth the carcase of it shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: celui qui mangera de son corps mort lavera ses vêtements et sera impur jusqu''au soir, et celui qui portera son corps mort lavera ses vêtements et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀስ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ የተጸየፈ ነው፥ አትብሉትም።

verses.en: And every creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth shall be an abomination; it shall not be eaten.
verses.fr: Vous aurez en abomination tout reptile qui rampe sur la terre: on n''en mangera point.
verses.am: በሆዱ የሚሳብ፥ በአራትም እግሮች የሚሳብ፥ ብዙ እግሮችም ያሉት፥ በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ የተጸየፉ ናቸውና አትብሉአቸው።

verses.en: Whatsoever goeth upon the belly, and whatsoever goeth upon all four, or whatsoever hath more feet among all creeping things that creep upon the earth, them ye shall not eat; for they are an abomination.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez point, parmi tous les reptiles qui rampent sur la terre, de tous ceux qui se traînent sur le ventre, ni de tous ceux qui marchent sur quatre pieds ou sur un grand nombre de pieds; car vous les aurez en abomination.
verses.am: በሚንቀሳቀሱ ተንቀሳቃሾች ሁሉ ሰውነታችሁን አታስጸይፉ፤ በእነርሱም እንዳትረክሱ ሰውነታችሁን አታርክሱባቸው።

verses.en: Ye shall not make yourselves abominable with any creeping thing that creepeth, neither shall ye make yourselves unclean with them, that ye should be defiled thereby.
verses.fr: Ne rendez point vos personnes abominables par tous ces reptiles qui rampent; ne vous rendez point impurs par eux, ne vous souillez point par eux.
verses.am: እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና፤ ሰውነታችሁን ቀድሱ፥ ቅዱሳንም ሁኑ፥ እኔ ቅዱስ ነኝና፤ በምድርም ላይ በሚሳብ ተንቀሳቃሽ ሁሉ ሰውነታችሁን አታርክሱ።

verses.en: For I am the Lord your God: ye shall therefore sanctify yourselves, and ye shall be holy; for I am holy: neither shall ye defile yourselves with any manner of creeping thing that creepeth upon the earth.
verses.fr: Car je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu; vous vous sanctifierez, et vous serez saints, car je suis saint; et vous ne vous rendrez point impurs par tous ces reptiles qui rampent sur la terre.
verses.am: እኔ አምላካችሁ እሆን ዘንድ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ፤ እንግዲህ እኔ ቅዱስ ነኝና እናንተ ቅዱሳን ሁኑ።

verses.en: For I am the Lord that bringeth you up out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: ye shall therefore be holy, for I am holy.
verses.fr: Car je suis l''Eternel, qui vous ai fait monter du pays d''Egypte, pour être votre Dieu, et pour que vous soyez saints; car je suis saint.
verses.am: የእንስሳና የወፍ፥ በውኃም ውስጥ የሚንቀሳቀስ የፍጥረት ሁሉ፥ በምድርም ላይ የሚንቀሳቀስ የፍጥረት ሁሉ ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: This is the law of the beasts, and of the fowl, and of every living creature that moveth in the waters, and of every creature that creepeth upon the earth:
verses.fr: Telle est la loi touchant les animaux, les oiseaux, tous les êtres vivants qui se meuvent dans les eaux, et tous les êtres qui rampent sur la terre,
verses.am: በርኩስና በንጹሕ መካከል፥ የሕይወት ነፍስ ካላቸውም በምትበሉትና በማትበሉት መካከል እንድትለዩ ነው።

verses.en: To make a difference between the unclean and the clean, and between the beast that may be eaten and the beast that may not be eaten.
verses.fr: afin que vous distinguiez ce qui est impur et ce qui est pur, l''animal qui se mange et l''animal qui ne se mange pas.
verses.am: ፤ በርኩስና በንጹሕ መካከል፥ የሕይወት ነፍስ ካላቸውም በምትበሉትና በማትበሉት መካከል እንድትለዩ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a woman have conceived seed, and born a man child: then she shall be unclean seven days; according to the days of the separation for her infirmity shall she be unclean.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et dis: Lorsqu''une femme deviendra enceinte, et qu''elle enfantera un mâle, elle sera impure pendant sept jours; elle sera impure comme au temps de son indisposition menstruelle.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። ሴት ብታረግዝ ወንድ ልጅም ብትወልድ፥ ሰባት ቀን ያህል የረከሰች ናት፤ እንደ ሕመምዋ መርገም ወራት ትረክሳለች።

verses.en: And in the eighth day the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, l''enfant sera circoncis.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ልጁ ከሥጋው ሸለፈት ይገረዝ።

verses.en: And she shall then continue in the blood of her purifying three and thirty days; she shall touch no hallowed thing, nor come into the sanctuary, until the days of her purifying be fulfilled.
verses.fr: Elle restera encore trente-trois jours à se purifier de son sang; elle ne touchera aucune chose sainte, et elle n''ira point au sanctuaire, jusqu''à ce que les jours de sa purification soient accomplis.
verses.am: ከደምዋም እስክትነጻ ሠላሳ ሦስት ቀን ትቀመጥ፤ የመንጻትዋ ቀንም እስኪፈጸም ድረስ የተቀደሰን ነገር አትንካ፥ ወደ መቅደስም አትግባ።

verses.en: But if she bear a maid child, then she shall be unclean two weeks, as in her separation: and she shall continue in the blood of her purifying threescore and six days.
verses.fr: Si elle enfante une fille, elle sera impure pendant deux semaines, comme au temps de son indisposition menstruelle; elle restera soixante-six jours à se purifier de son sang.
verses.am: ሴት ልጅም ብትወልድ እንደ መርገምዋ ወራት ሁለት ሳምንት ያህል የረከሰች ናት፤ ከደምዋም እስክትነጻ ድረስ ስድሳ ስድስት ቀን ትቀመጥ።

verses.en: And when the days of her purifying are fulfilled, for a son, or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb of the first year for a burnt offering, and a young pigeon, or a turtledove, for a sin offering, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest:
verses.fr: Lorsque les jours de sa purification seront accomplis, pour un fils ou pour une fille, elle apportera au sacrificateur, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, un agneau d''un an pour l''holocauste, et un jeune pigeon ou une tourterelle pour le sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: የመንጻትዋ ወራትም በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥ ለወንድ ልጅ ወይም ለሴት ልጅ፥ የአንድ ዓመት ጠቦት ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት፥ የርግብም ግልገል ወይም ዋኖስ ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ወደ ካህኑ ታምጣለት።

verses.en: Who shall offer it before the Lord, and make an atonement for her; and she shall be cleansed from the issue of her blood. This is the law for her that hath born a male or a female.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur les sacrifiera devant l''Eternel, et fera pour elle l''expiation; et elle sera purifiée du flux de son sang. Telle est la loi pour la femme qui enfante un fils ou une fille.
verses.am: እርሱም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቀርበዋል ያስተሰርይላትማል፤ ከደምዋም ፈሳሽ ትነጻለች። ወንድ ወይም ሴት ለምትወልድ ሴት ሕጉ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And if she be not able to bring a lamb, then she shall bring two turtles, or two young pigeons; the one for the burnt offering, and the other for a sin offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for her, and she shall be clean.
verses.fr: Si elle n''a pas de quoi se procurer un agneau, elle prendra deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, l''un pour l''holocauste, l''autre pour le sacrifice d''expiation. Le sacrificateur fera pour elle l''expiation, et elle sera pure.
verses.am: ጠቦት ለማምጣት ገንዘብዋ ያልበቃት እንደ ሆነ ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች፥ አንዱን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ሌላውንም ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ታቀርባለች፤ ካህኑም ያስተሰርይላታል፥ እርስዋም ትነጻለች።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme aura sur la peau de son corps une tumeur, une dartre, ou une tache blanche, qui ressemblera à une plaie de lèpre sur la peau de son corps, on l''amènera au sacrificateur Aaron, ou à l''un de ses fils qui sont sacrificateurs.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ እባጭ ወይም ብጕር ወይም ቋቁቻ ቢታይ፥ በሥጋው ቁርበት እንደ ለምጽ ደዌ ቢመስል፥ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ አሮን ወይም ከካህናቱ ልጆቹ ወደ አንዱ ያምጡት።

verses.en: And the priest shall look on the plague in the skin of the flesh: and when the hair in the plague is turned white, and the plague in sight be deeper than the skin of his flesh, it is a plague of leprosy: and the priest shall look on him, and pronounce him unclean.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur examinera la plaie qui est sur la peau du corps. Si le poil de la plaie est devenu blanc, et que la plaie paraisse plus profonde que la peau du corps, c''est une plaie de lèpre: le sacrificateur qui aura fait l''examen déclarera cet homme impur.
verses.am: ካህኑም በሥጋው ቁርበት ያለውን ደዌ ያያል፤ ጠጕሩም ተለውጦ ቢነጣ ደዌውም ወደ ሥጋው ቁርበት ቢጠልቅ፥ እርሱ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው፤ ካህኑም አይቶ። ርኩስ ነው ይበለው።

verses.en: If the bright spot be white in the skin of his flesh, and in sight be not deeper than the skin, and the hair thereof be not turned white; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague seven days:
verses.fr: S''il y a sur la peau du corps une tache blanche qui ne paraisse pas plus profonde que la peau, et que le poil ne soit pas devenu blanc, le sacrificateur enfermera pendant sept jours celui qui a la plaie.
verses.am: ቋቁቻውም በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ ቢነጣ፥ ከቁርበቱም የጠለቀ ባይመስል፥ ጠጕሩም ባይነጣ፥ ካህኑ የታመመውን ሰው ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall look on him the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague in his sight be at a stay, and the plague spread not in the skin; then the priest shall shut him up seven days more:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur l''examinera le septième jour. Si la plaie lui paraît ne pas avoir fait de progrès et ne pas s''être étendue sur la peau, le sacrificateur l''enfermera une seconde fois pendant sept jours.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ካህኑ ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በዓይኑ ፊት እንደ ነበረ ቢሆን፥ በቁርበቱም ላይ ባይሰፋ፥ ካህኑ ሰባት ቀን ደግሞ ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall look on him again the seventh day: and, behold, if the plague be somewhat dark, and the plague spread not in the skin, the priest shall pronounce him clean: it is but a scab: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur l''examinera une seconde fois le septième jour. Si la plaie est devenue pâle et ne s''est pas étendue sur la peau, le sacrificateur déclarera cet homme pur: c''est une dartre; il lavera ses vêtements, et il sera pur.
verses.am: ደግሞ በሰባተኛው ቀን ካህኑ ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው ቢከስም፥ ደዌውም በቁርበቱ ላይ ባይሰፋ፥ ካህኑ። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ እከክ ነው፤ ልብሱንም አጥቦ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But if the scab spread much abroad in the skin, after that he hath been seen of the priest for his cleansing, he shall be seen of the priest again.
verses.fr: Mais si la dartre s''est étendue sur la peau, après qu''il s''est montré au sacrificateur pour être déclaré pur, il se fera examiner une seconde fois par le sacrificateur.
verses.am: ስለ መንጻቱ በካህኑ ዘንድ ከታየ በኋላ እከኩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ እንደ ገና ሊታይ ወደ ካህኑ ይቀርባል።

verses.en: And if the priest see that, behold, the scab spreadeth in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur l''examinera. Si la dartre s''est étendue sur la peau, le sacrificateur le déclarera impur; c''est la lèpre.
verses.am: ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ እከኩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ለምጽ ነው።

verses.en: When the plague of leprosy is in a man, then he shall be brought unto the priest;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il y aura sur un homme une plaie de lèpre, on l''amènera au sacrificateur.
verses.am: የለምጽ ደዌ በሰው ውስጥ ቢሆን እርሱን ወደ ካህኑ ያመጡለታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur l''examinera. S''il y a sur la peau une tumeur blanche, si cette tumeur a fait blanchir le poil, et qu''il y ait une trace de chair vive dans la tumeur,
verses.am: ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ በቁርበቱ ላይ ነጭ እባጭ ቢሆን፥ ጠጕሩም ተለውጦ ቢነጣ፥ ሥጋውም በእባጩ ውስጥ ቢያዥ፥

verses.en: It is an old leprosy in the skin of his flesh, and the priest shall pronounce him unclean, and shall not shut him up: for he is unclean.
verses.fr: c''est une lèpre invétérée dans la peau du corps de cet homme: le sacrificateur le déclarera impur; il ne l''enfermera pas, car il est impur.
verses.am: እርሱ በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ አሮጌ ለምጽ ነው፥ ካህኑም። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ እርሱ ርኩስ ነውና አይዘጋበትም።

verses.en: And if a leprosy break out abroad in the skin, and the leprosy cover all the skin of him that hath the plague from his head even to his foot, wheresoever the priest looketh;
verses.fr: Si la lèpre fait une éruption sur la peau et couvre toute la peau de celui qui a la plaie, depuis la tête jusqu''aux pieds, partout où le sacrificateur portera ses regards, le sacrificateur l''examinera;
verses.am: ለምጹም በቁርበቱ ላይ ሰፍቶ ቢወጣ፥ ለምጹም የታመመውን ሰው ቁርበቱን ሁሉ ከራሱ እስከ እግሮቹ ድረስ እንደ ከደነው ለካህኑ ቢመስለው፥ ካህኑ ያያል፤

verses.en: Then the priest shall consider: and, behold, if the leprosy have covered all his flesh, he shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: it is all turned white: he is clean.
verses.fr: et quand il aura vu que la lèpre couvre tout le corps, il déclarera pur celui qui a la plaie: comme il est entièrement devenu blanc, il est pur.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ለምጹ ሥጋውን ሁሉ ቢከድን የታመመውን ሰው። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ ሥጋው ሁሉ ፈጽሞ ተለውጦ ነጭ ሆኖአል፤ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: But when raw flesh appeareth in him, he shall be unclean.
verses.fr: Mais le jour où l''on apercevra en lui de la chair vive, il sera impur;
verses.am: የሚያዠው ሥጋ ግን ሲታይበት ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And the priest shall see the raw flesh, and pronounce him to be unclean: for the raw flesh is unclean: it is a leprosy.
verses.fr: quand le sacrificateur aura vu la chair vive, il le déclarera impur: la chair vive est impure, c''est la lèpre.
verses.am: ካህኑም የሚያዠውን ሥጋ አይቶ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ የሚያዠው ሥጋ ለምጽ ነውና ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: Or if the raw flesh turn again, and be changed unto white, he shall come unto the priest;
verses.fr: Si la chair vive change et devient blanche, il ira vers le sacrificateur;
verses.am: የሚያዠውም ሥጋ ተለውጦ ቢነጣ እንደ ገና ወደ ካህኑ ይመጣል።

verses.en: And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the plague be turned into white; then the priest shall pronounce him clean that hath the plague: he is clean.
verses.fr: le sacrificateur l''examinera, et si la plaie est devenue blanche, le sacrificateur déclarera pur celui qui a la plaie: il est pur.
verses.am: ካህኑም ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው ቢነጣ ካህኑ የታመመውን። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: The flesh also, in which, even in the skin thereof, was a boil, and is healed,
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme aura eu sur la peau de son corps un ulcère qui a été guéri,
verses.am: በሥጋውም ቁርበት ላይ ቍስል ቢሆንና ቢሽር፥

verses.en: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;
verses.fr: et qu''il se manifestera, à la place où était l''ulcère, une tumeur blanche ou une tache d''un blanc rougeâtre, cet homme se montrera au sacrificateur.
verses.am: በቍስሉም ስፍራ ነጭ እባጭ ወይም ቀላ ያለ ቋቁቻ ቢወጣ፥ በካህኑ ዘንድ ይታያል።

verses.en: And if, when the priest seeth it, behold, it be in sight lower than the skin, and the hair thereof be turned white; the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague of leprosy broken out of the boil.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur l''examinera. Si la tache paraît plus enfoncée que la peau, et que le poil soit devenu blanc, le sacrificateur le déclarera impur: c''est une plaie de lèpre, qui a fait éruption dans l''ulcère.
verses.am: ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ወደ ቁርበቱ ውስጥ ጠልቆ ቢታይ፥ ጠጕሩም ተለውጦ ቢነጣ፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው፤ ከቍስሉ ውስጥ ወጥቶአል።

verses.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hairs therein, and if it be not lower than the skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.fr: Si le sacrificateur voit qu''il n''y a point de poil blanc dans la tache, qu''elle n''est pas plus enfoncée que la peau, et qu''elle est devenue pâle, il enfermera cet homme pendant sept jours.
verses.am: ካህኑም ቢያየው፥ ነጭም ጠጕር ባይኖርበት፥ ወደ ቁርበቱም ውስጥ ባይጠልቅ ነገር ግን ቢከስም፥ ካህኑ ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And if it spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a plague.
verses.fr: Si la tache s''est étendue sur la peau, le sacrificateur le déclarera impur: c''est une plaie de lèpre.
verses.am: በቁርበቱም ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ደዌ ነው።

verses.en: But if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not, it is a burning boil; and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.fr: Mais si la tache est restée à la même place et ne s''est pas étendue, c''est une cicatrice de l''ulcère: le sacrificateur le déclarera pur.
verses.am: ቋቁቻው ግን በስፍራው ቢቆም ባይሰፋም፥ የቍስል ጠባሳ ነው፤ ካህኑም። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል።

verses.en: Or if there be any flesh, in the skin whereof there is a hot burning, and the quick flesh that burneth have a white bright spot, somewhat reddish, or white;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme aura eu sur la peau de son corps une brûlure par le feu, et qu''il se manifestera sur la trace de la brûlure une tache blanche ou d''un blanc rougeâtre,
verses.am: በሥጋውም ቁርበት የእሳት ትኵሳት ቢኖርበት፥ በተቃጠለውም ስፍራ ነጭ ወይም ቀላ ያለ ቋቁቻ ቢታይ፥

verses.en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the hair in the bright spot be turned white, and it be in sight deeper than the skin; it is a leprosy broken out of the burning: wherefore the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.fr: le sacrificateur l''examinera. Si le poil est devenu blanc dans la tache, et qu''elle paraisse plus profonde que la peau, c''est la lèpre, qui a fait éruption dans la brûlure; le sacrificateur déclarera cet homme impur: c''est une plaie de lèpre.
verses.am: ካህኑ ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ በቋቁቻው ጠጕሩ ተለውጦ ቢነጣ፥ ወደ ቁርበቱም ውስጥ ቢጠልቅ፥ ለምጽ ነው፤ ከተቃጠለውም ስፍራ ወጥቶአል፤ ካህኑም። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው።

verses.en: But if the priest look on it, and, behold, there be no white hair in the bright spot, and it be no lower than the other skin, but be somewhat dark; then the priest shall shut him up seven days:
verses.fr: Si le sacrificateur voit qu''il n''y a point de poil blanc dans la tache, qu''elle n''est pas plus enfoncée que la peau, et qu''elle est devenue pâle, il enfermera cet homme pendant sept jours.
verses.am: ካህኑም ቢያየው፥ በቋቁቻውም ነጭ ጠጕር ባይኖር፥ ወደ ቁርበቱም ባይጠልቅ ነገር ግን ቢከስም፥ ካህኑ ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall look upon him the seventh day: and if it be spread much abroad in the skin, then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is the plague of leprosy.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur l''examinera le septième jour. Si la tache s''est étendue sur la peau, le sacrificateur le déclarera impur: c''est une plaie de lèpre.
verses.am: ካህኑም በሰባተኛው ቀን ያየዋል፤ በቁርበቱም ላይ ቢሰፋ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው።

verses.en: And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
verses.fr: Mais si la tache est restée à la même place, ne s''est pas étendue sur la peau, et est devenue pâle, c''est la tumeur de la brûlure; le sacrificateur le déclarera pur, car c''est la cicatrice de la brûlure.
verses.am: ቋቁቻውም በስፍራው ላይ ቢቆም፥ በቁርበቱም ላይ ባይሰፋ ነገር ግን ቢከስም፥ የትኵሳት እባጭ ነው፤ የትኵሳትም ጠባሳ ነውና ካህኑ። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል።

verses.en: If a man or woman have a plague upon the head or the beard;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme ou une femme aura une plaie à la tête ou à la barbe,
verses.am: ማናቸውም ወንድ ወይም ሴት በራሱ ወይም በአገጩ ደዌ ቢኖርበት፥

verses.en: Then the priest shall see the plague: and, behold, if it be in sight deeper than the skin; and there be in it a yellow thin hair; then the priest shall pronounce him unclean: it is a dry scall, even a leprosy upon the head or beard.
verses.fr: le sacrificateur examinera la plaie. Si elle paraît plus profonde que la peau, et qu''il y ait du poil jaunâtre et mince, le sacrificateur déclarera cet homme impur: c''est la teigne, c''est la lèpre de la tête ou de la barbe.
verses.am: ካህኑ ደዌውን ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ወደ ቁርበቱ ቢጠልቅ፥ በውስጡም ቀጭን ብጫ ጠጕር ቢኖርበት፥ ካህኑ። ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ቈረቈር ነው፤ የራስ ወይም የአገጭ ለምጽ ነው።

verses.en: And if the priest look on the plague of the scall, and, behold, it be not in sight deeper than the skin, and that there is no black hair in it; then the priest shall shut up him that hath the plague of the scall seven days:
verses.fr: Si le sacrificateur voit que la plaie de la teigne ne paraît pas plus profonde que la peau, et qu''il n''y a point de poil noir, il enfermera pendant sept jours celui qui a la plaie de la teigne.
verses.am: ካህኑም የቈረቈሩን ደዌ ቢያይ፥ ወደ ቁርበቱም ባይጠልቅ፥ ጥቁርም ጠጕር ባይኖርበት፥ ካህኑ የቈረቈር ደዌ ያለበትን ሰው ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the plague: and, behold, if the scall spread not, and there be in it no yellow hair, and the scall be not in sight deeper than the skin;
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur examinera la plaie le septième jour. Si la teigne ne s''est pas étendue, s''il n''y a point de poil jaunâtre, et si elle ne paraît pas plus profonde que la peau,
verses.am: ካህኑም በሰባተኛው ቀን ደዌውን ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ቈረቈሩ ባይሰፋ፥ በውስጡም ብጫ ጠጕር ባይኖር፥ የቈረቈሩም መልክ ወደ ቁርበቱ ባይጠልቅ፥ ይላጫል፥

verses.en: He shall be shaven, but the scall shall he not shave; and the priest shall shut up him that hath the scall seven days more:
verses.fr: celui qui a la teigne se rasera, mais il ne rasera point la place où est la teigne; et le sacrificateur l''enfermera une seconde fois pendant sept jours.
verses.am: ቈረቈሩ ግን አይላጭም፤ ካህኑም ቈረቈር ያለበትን ሰው ሰባት ቀን ደግሞ ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And in the seventh day the priest shall look on the scall: and, behold, if the scall be not spread in the skin, nor be in sight deeper than the skin; then the priest shall pronounce him clean: and he shall wash his clothes, and be clean.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur examinera la teigne le septième jour. Si la teigne ne s''est pas étendue sur la peau, et si elle ne paraît pas plus profonde que la peau, le sacrificateur le déclarera pur; il lavera ses vêtements, et il sera pur.
verses.am: ካህኑም በሰባተኛው ቀን ቈረቈሩን ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ቈረቈሩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ባይሰፋ፥ መልኩም ወደ ቁርበቱ ባይጠልቅ፥ ካህኑ። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል፤ ልብሱን አጥቦ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But if the scall spread much in the skin after his cleansing;
verses.fr: Mais si la teigne s''est étendue sur la peau, après qu''il a été déclaré pur,
verses.am: ከነጻ በኋላ ግን ቈረቈሩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥ ካህኑ ያየዋል፤

verses.en: Then the priest shall look on him: and, behold, if the scall be spread in the skin, the priest shall not seek for yellow hair; he is unclean.
verses.fr: le sacrificateur l''examinera. Et si la teigne s''est étendue sur la peau, le sacrificateur n''aura pas à rechercher s''il y a du poil jaunâtre: il est impur.
verses.am: እነሆም፥ ቈረቈሩ በቁርበቱ ላይ ቢሰፋ ካህኑ ብጫውን ጠጕር አይፈልግም፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: But if the scall be in his sight at a stay, and that there is black hair grown up therein; the scall is healed, he is clean: and the priest shall pronounce him clean.
verses.fr: Si la teigne lui paraît ne pas avoir fait de progrès, et qu''il y ait crû du poil noir, la teigne est guérie: il est pur, et le sacrificateur le déclarera pur.
verses.am: ቈረቈሩ ግን በዓይኑ ፊት እንደ ነበረ ቢሆን፥ ጥቁርም ጠጕር ቢበቅልበት፥ ቈረቈሩ ሽሮአል እርሱም ንጹሕ ነው፤ ካህኑም። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል።

verses.en: If a man also or a woman have in the skin of their flesh bright spots, even white bright spots;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme ou une femme aura sur la peau de son corps des taches, des taches blanches,
verses.am: ማናቸውም ወንድ ወይም ሴት በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ ነጭ ቋቁቻ ቢኖርበት፥

verses.en: Then the priest shall look: and, behold, if the bright spots in the skin of their flesh be darkish white; it is a freckled spot that groweth in the skin; he is clean.
verses.fr: le sacrificateur l''examinera. S''il y a sur la peau de son corps des taches d''un blanc pâle, ce ne sont que des taches qui ont fait éruption sur la peau: il est pur.
verses.am: ካህኑ ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ በሥጋቸው ቁርበት ላይ ያለው ቋቁቻ ፈገግ ቢል አጓጐት ነው፤ ከቁርበቱ ውስጥ ወጥቶአል፤ ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: And the man whose hair is fallen off his head, he is bald; yet is he clean.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme aura la tête dépouillée de cheveux, c''est un chauve: il est pur.
verses.am: የሰውም ጠጕር ከራሱ ቢመለጥ እርሱ ቡሀ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: And he that hath his hair fallen off from the part of his head toward his face, he is forehead bald: yet is he clean.
verses.fr: S''il a la tête dépouillée de cheveux du côté de la face, c''est un chauve par-devant: il est pur.
verses.am: ጠጕሩም ከግምባሩ ቢመለጥ እርሱ ራሰ በራ ነው፤ ነገር ግን ንጹሕ ነው።

verses.en: And if there be in the bald head, or bald forehead, a white reddish sore; it is a leprosy sprung up in his bald head, or his bald forehead.
verses.fr: Mais s''il y a dans la partie chauve de devant ou de derrière une plaie d''un blanc rougeâtre, c''est la lèpre qui a fait éruption dans la partie chauve de derrière ou de devant.
verses.am: በቡሀነቱ ወይም በራሰ በራነቱ ነጭ ወይም ቀላ ያለ ደዌ ቢኖርበት፥ እርሱ ከቡሀነቱ ወይም ከራሰ በራነቱ የወጣ ለምጽ ነው።

verses.en: Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur l''examinera. S''il y a une tumeur de plaie d''un blanc rougeâtre dans la partie chauve de derrière ou de devant, semblable à la lèpre sur la peau du corps,
verses.am: ካህኑም ያየዋል፤ እነሆም፥ የደዌው እብጠት፥ በሥጋው ቁርበት ላይ የሆነ ለምጽ መስሎ፥ በቡሀነቱ ወይም በራሰ በራነቱ ነጭ ወይም ቀላ ያለ ቢሆን፥

verses.en: He is a leprous man, he is unclean: the priest shall pronounce him utterly unclean; his plague is in his head.
verses.fr: c''est un homme lépreux, il est impur: le sacrificateur le déclarera impur; c''est à la tête qu''est sa plaie.
verses.am: ለምጻም ሰው ነው፤ ርኩስ ነው፤ ካህኑ። በእርግጥ ርኩስ ነው ይለዋል፤ ደዌው በራሱ ነው።

verses.en: And the leper in whom the plague is, his clothes shall be rent, and his head bare, and he shall put a covering upon his upper lip, and shall cry, Unclean, unclean.
verses.fr: Le lépreux, atteint de la plaie, portera ses vêtements déchirés, et aura la tête nue; il se couvrira la barbe, et criera: Impur! Impur!
verses.am: የለምጽ ደዌ ያለበት ሰው ልብሱ የተቀደደ ይሁን፥ ራሱም የተገለጠ ይሁን፥ ከንፈሩንም ይሸፍን፤ ርኩስ ርኩስ ነኝ ይበል።

verses.en: All the days wherein the plague shall be in him he shall be defiled; he is unclean: he shall dwell alone; without the camp shall his habitation be.
verses.fr: Aussi longtemps qu''il aura la plaie, il sera impur: il est impur. Il habitera seul; sa demeure sera hors du camp.
verses.am: ደዌው ባለበት ዘመን ሁሉ ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ እርሱ ርኩስ ነው፤ ብቻውን ይቀመጣል፤ መኖሪያውም ከሰፈር በውጭ ይሆናል።

verses.en: The garment also that the plague of leprosy is in, whether it be a woollen garment, or a linen garment;
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il y aura sur un vêtement une plaie de lèpre, sur un vêtement de laine ou sur un vêtement de lin,
verses.am: የለምጽም ደዌ በልብስ ላይ ቢሆን፥ ልብሱም የበግ ጠጕር ወይም በፍታ ቢሆን፥

verses.en: Whether it be in the warp, or woof; of linen, or of woollen; whether in a skin, or in any thing made of skin;
verses.fr: la chaîne ou à la trame de lin, ou de laine, sur une peau ou sur quelque ouvrage de peau,
verses.am: በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ላይ ቢሆን፥ በፍታ ወይም የበግ ጠጕር ቢሆን፥ አጐዛ ወይም ከአጐዛ የሚደረግ ነገር ቢሆን፥

verses.en: And if the plague be greenish or reddish in the garment, or in the skin, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a plague of leprosy, and shall be shewed unto the priest:
verses.fr: et que la plaie sera verdâtre ou rougeâtre sur le vêtement ou sur la peau, à la chaîne ou à la trame, ou sur un objet quelconque de peau, c''est une plaie de lèpre, et elle sera montrée au sacrificateur.
verses.am: ደዌው በልብሱ ወይም በአጐዛው ወይም በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛው በሚደረገው ነገር አረንጓዴ ወይም ቀይ ቢሆን፥ የለምጽ ደዌ ነው፤ ለካህኑ ይታያል።

verses.en: And the priest shall look upon the plague, and shut up it that hath the plague seven days:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur examinera la plaie, et il enfermera pendant sept jours ce qui en est attaqué.
verses.am: ካህኑም ደዌውን አይቶ ደዌው ያለበትን ነገር ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And he shall look on the plague on the seventh day: if the plague be spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in a skin, or in any work that is made of skin; the plague is a fretting leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.fr: Il examinera la plaie le septième jour. Si la plaie s''est étendue sur le vêtement, à la chaîne ou à la trame, sur la peau ou sur l''ouvrage quelconque fait de peau, c''est une plaie de lèpre invétérée: l''objet est impur.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ደዌውን ያያል፤ ደዌውም በልብስ ላይ ወይም በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም በአጐዛው ወይም ከአጐዛው በሚደረግ ነገር ቢሰፋ፥ ደዌው እየፋገ የሚሄድ ለምጽ ነው፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: He shall therefore burn that garment, whether warp or woof, in woollen or in linen, or any thing of skin, wherein the plague is: for it is a fretting leprosy; it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.fr: Il brûlera le vêtement, la chaîne ou la trame de laine ou de lin, l''objet quelconque de peau sur lequel se trouve la plaie, car c''est une lèpre invétérée: il sera brûlé au feu.
verses.am: ልብሱን ያቃጥል፤ ድሩ ወይም ማጉ የበግ ጠጕር ወይም በፍታ ቢሆን ወይም ከአጐዛው የተደረገ ቢሆን፥ ደዌ ያለበት ሁሉ፥ እየፋገ የሚሄድ ለምጽ ነውና በእሳት ይቃጠል።

verses.en: And if the priest shall look, and, behold, the plague be not spread in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin;
verses.fr: Mais si le sacrificateur voit que la plaie ne s''est pas étendue sur le vêtement, sur la chaîne ou sur la trame, sur l''objet quelconque de peau,
verses.am: ካህኑ ቢያይ፥ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛ በተደረገ ነገር ቢሆን በልብሱ ላይ ባይሰፋ፥

verses.en: Then the priest shall command that they wash the thing wherein the plague is, and he shall shut it up seven days more:
verses.fr: il ordonnera qu''on lave ce qui est attaqué de la plaie, et il l''enfermera une seconde fois pendant sept jours.
verses.am: ካህኑ ደዌ ያለበቱ ነገር እንዲታጠብ ይዘዝ፤ ሌላም ሰባት ቀን ይዘጋበታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall look on the plague, after that it is washed: and, behold, if the plague have not changed his colour, and the plague be not spread; it is unclean; thou shalt burn it in the fire; it is fret inward, whether it be bare within or without.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur examinera la plaie, après qu''elle aura été lavée. Si la plaie n''a pas changé d''aspect et ne s''est pas étendue, l''objet est impur: il sera brûlé au feu; c''est une partie de l''endroit ou de l''envers qui a été rongée.
verses.am: ደዌውም ከታጠበ በኋላ ካህኑ ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው መልኩን ባይለውጥ ባይሰፋም፥ ርኩስ ነው፤ በእሳት አቃጥለው፤ ምልክቱ በውስጥ ወይም በውጭ ቢሆን እየፋገ የሚሄድ ደዌ ነው።

verses.en: And if the priest look, and, behold, the plague be somewhat dark after the washing of it; then he shall rend it out of the garment, or out of the skin, or out of the warp, or out of the woof:
verses.fr: Si le sacrificateur voit que la plaie est devenue pâle, après avoir été lavée, il l''arrachera du vêtement ou de la peau, de la chaîne ou de la trame.
verses.am: ካህኑም ቢያይ፥ እነሆም፥ ደዌው ከታጠበ በኋላ ቢከስም፥ ከልብሱ ወይም ከአጐዛው ወይም ከድሩ ወይም ከማጉ ይቅደደው።

verses.en: And if it appear still in the garment, either in the warp, or in the woof, or in any thing of skin; it is a spreading plague: thou shalt burn that wherein the plague is with fire.
verses.fr: Si elle paraît encore sur le vêtement, à la chaîne ou à la trame, ou sur l''objet quelconque de peau, c''est une éruption de lèpre: ce qui est attaqué de la plaie sera brûlé au feu.
verses.am: በልብሱም ወይም በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛው በተደረገ ነገር ላይ ደግሞ ቢታይ፥ የወጣ ለምጽ ነው፤ ደዌው ያለበትን ነገር አቃጥለው።

verses.en: And the garment, either warp, or woof, or whatsoever thing of skin it be, which thou shalt wash, if the plague be departed from them, then it shall be washed the second time, and shall be clean.
verses.fr: Le vêtement, la chaîne ou la trame, l''objet quelconque de peau, qui a été lavé, et d''où la plaie a disparu, sera lavé une seconde fois, et il sera pur.
verses.am: አንተም ካጠብኸው ልብስ ወይም ከድሩ ወይም ከማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛው ከተደረገው ነገር ላይ ደዌው ቢጠፋ፥ ሁለተኛ ጊዜ ይታጠባል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል።

verses.en: This is the law of the plague of leprosy in a garment of woollen or linen, either in the warp, or woof, or any thing of skins, to pronounce it clean, or to pronounce it unclean.
verses.fr: Telle est la loi sur la plaie de la lèpre, lorsqu''elle attaque les vêtements de laine ou de lin, la chaîne ou la trame, ou un objet quelconque de peau, et d''après laquelle ils seront déclarés purs ou impurs.
verses.am: በበግ ጠጕር ልብስ ወይም በበፍታ ወይም በድሩ ወይም በማጉ ወይም ከአጐዛ በተደረገ ነገር ላይ ቢሆን፥ ንጹሕ ወይም ርኩስ ያሰኝ ዘንድ የለምጽ ደዌ ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ሲል ተናገረው።

verses.en: This shall be the law of the leper in the day of his cleansing: He shall be brought unto the priest:
verses.fr: Voici quelle sera la loi sur le lépreux, pour le jour de sa purification. On l''amènera devant le sacrificateur.
verses.am: በመንጻቱ ቀን የለምጻሙ ሕግ ይህ ይሆናል፤ ወደ ካህኑ ይወስዱታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall go forth out of the camp; and the priest shall look, and, behold, if the plague of leprosy be healed in the leper;
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur sortira du camp, et il examinera le lépreux. Si le lépreux est guéri de la plaie de la lèpre,
verses.am: ካህኑም ከሰፈር ወደ ውጭ ይወጣል፤ ካህኑም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ የለምጹ ደዌ ከለምጻሙ ላይ ቢጠፋ፥

verses.en: Then shall the priest command to take for him that is to be cleansed two birds alive and clean, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.fr: le sacrificateur ordonnera que l''on prenne, pour celui qui doit être purifié, deux oiseaux vivants et purs, du bois de cèdre, du cramoisi et de l''hysope.
verses.am: ካህኑ ስለሚነጻው ሰው ሁለት ንጹሐን ወፎች በሕይወታቸው፥ የዝግባም እንጨት፥ ቀይ ግምጃም፥ ሂሶጵም ያመጣ ዘንድ ያዝዛል።

verses.en: And the priest shall command that one of the birds be killed in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur ordonnera qu''on égorge l''un des oiseaux sur un vase de terre, sur de l''eau vive.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከሁለቱ ወፎች አንዱን በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ በምንጭ ውኃ ላይ ያርድ ዘንድ ይዝዛል።

verses.en: As for the living bird, he shall take it, and the cedar wood, and the scarlet, and the hyssop, and shall dip them and the living bird in the blood of the bird that was killed over the running water:
verses.fr: Il prendra l''oiseau vivant, le bois de cèdre, le cramoisi et l''hysope; et il les trempera, avec l''oiseau vivant, dans le sang de l''oiseau égorgé sur l''eau vive.
verses.am: ሕያውንም ወፍ ዝግባውንም እንጨት ቀዩንም ግምጃ ሂሶጱንም ወስዶ ከሕያው ወፍ ጋር በምንጭ ውኃ ላይ በታረደው ወፍ ደም ውስጥ ይነክራቸዋል።

verses.en: And he shall sprinkle upon him that is to be cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and shall pronounce him clean, and shall let the living bird loose into the open field.
verses.fr: Il en fera sept fois l''aspersion sur celui qui doit être purifié de la lèpre. Puis il le déclarera pur, et il lâchera dans les champs l''oiseau vivant.
verses.am: ከለምጹ በሚነጻው ሰው ላይ ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጫል፤ ንጹሕም ነው ይለዋል፥ ሕያውንም ወፍ ወደ ሜዳ ይለቅቀዋል።

verses.en: And he that is to be cleansed shall wash his clothes, and shave off all his hair, and wash himself in water, that he may be clean: and after that he shall come into the camp, and shall tarry abroad out of his tent seven days.
verses.fr: Celui qui se purifie lavera ses vêtements, rasera tout son poil, et se baignera dans l''eau; et il sera pur. Ensuite il pourra entrer dans le camp, mais il restera sept jours hors de sa tente.
verses.am: የነጻውም ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ጠጕሩንም ሁሉ ይላጫል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል። ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈር ይገባል፥ ነገር ግን ከድንኳኑ በውጭ ሆኖ ሰባት ቀን ይቀመጣል።

verses.en: But it shall be on the seventh day, that he shall shave all his hair off his head and his beard and his eyebrows, even all his hair he shall shave off: and he shall wash his clothes, also he shall wash his flesh in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.fr: Le septième jour, il rasera tout son poil, sa tête, sa barbe, ses sourcils, il rasera tout son poil; il lavera ses vêtements, et baignera son corps dans l''eau, et il sera pur.
verses.am: በሰባተኛውም ቀን ጠጕሩን ሁሉ ይላጫል፤ ራሱንም፥ ጢሙንም፥ ቅንድቡንም፥ የገላውንም ጠጕር ሁሉ ይላጫል፤ ልብሱንም፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ያጥባል፤ ንጹሕም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And on the eighth day he shall take two he lambs without blemish, and one ewe lamb of the first year without blemish, and three tenth deals of fine flour for a meat offering, mingled with oil, and one log of oil.
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, il prendra deux agneaux sans défaut et une brebis d''un an sans défaut, trois dixièmes d''un épha de fleur de farine en offrande pétrie à l''huile, et un log d''huile.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ነውር የሌለባቸውን ሁለት ተባት ጠቦት፥ ነውር የሌለባትንም አንዲት የዓመት እንስት ጠቦት፥ ስለ እህልም ቍርባን ከመስፈሪያው ከአሥር እጅ ሦስት እጅ የሆነ በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት፥ አንድ የሎግ መስፈሪያም ዘይት ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And the priest that maketh him clean shall present the man that is to be made clean, and those things, before the Lord, at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur qui fait la purification présentera l''homme qui se purifie et toutes ces choses devant l''Eternel, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: የሚያነጻውም ካህን እነዚህን ነገሮች የሚነጻውንም ሰው በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያኖራቸዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take one he lamb, and offer him for a trespass offering, and the log of oil, and wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra l''un des agneaux, et il l''offrira en sacrifice de culpabilité, avec le log d''huile; il les agitera de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም አንዱን ጠቦት ወስዶ ስለ በደል መሥዋዕት ያቀርበዋል፥ ያንንም የሎግ መስፈሪያ ዘይት፤ ስለ መወዝወዝ ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይወዘውዘዋል።

verses.en: And he shall slay the lamb in the place where he shall kill the sin offering and the burnt offering, in the holy place: for as the sin offering is the priest's, so is the trespass offering: it is most holy:
verses.fr: Il égorgera l''agneau dans le lieu où l''on égorge les victimes expiatoires et les holocaustes, dans le lieu saint; car, dans le sacrifice de culpabilité, comme dans le sacrifice d''expiation, la victime est pour le sacrificateur; c''est une chose très sainte.
verses.am: የኃጢአትን መሥዋዕትና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት በሚያርዱበት በተቀደሰው ስፍራ ጠቦቱን ያርደዋል፤ የኃጢአቱ መሥዋዕት ለካህኑ እንደሚሆን፥ እንዲሁ የበደል መሥዋዕት ነው፤ ቅዱስ ቅዱሳን ነው።

verses.en: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra du sang de la victime de culpabilité; il en mettra sur le lobe de l''oreille droite de celui qui se purifie, sur le pouce de sa main droite et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከበደል መሥዋዕት ደም ወስዶ የሚነጻውን ሰው የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት ያስነካዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take some of the log of oil, and pour it into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra du log d''huile, et il en versera dans le creux de sa main gauche.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከዘይቱ ከሎግ መስፈሪያው ወስዶ በግራ እጁ ውስጥ ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall dip his right finger in the oil that is in his left hand, and shall sprinkle of the oil with his finger seven times before the Lord:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur trempera le doigt de sa main droite dans l''huile qui est dans le creux de sa main gauche, et il fera avec le doigt sept fois l''aspersion de l''huile devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም በግራ እጁ ውስጥ ባለው ዘይት ቀኝ ጣቱን ነክሮ ከዘይቱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ሰባት ጊዜ በጣቱ ይረጫል።

verses.en: And of the rest of the oil that is in his hand shall the priest put upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur mettra de l''huile qui lui reste dans la main sur le lobe de l''oreille droite de celui qui se purifie, sur le pouce de sa main droite et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit, par-dessus le sang de la victime de culpabilité.
verses.am: ካህኑም በእጁ ውስጥ ከቀረው ዘይት የሚነጻውን ሰው የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት የበደል መሥዋዕት ደም ባረፈበት ላይ ያስነካዋል።

verses.en: And the remnant of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall pour upon the head of him that is to be cleansed: and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur mettra ce qui lui reste d''huile dans la main sur la tête de celui qui se purifie; et le sacrificateur fera pour lui l''expiation devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: በካህኑም እጅ ውስጥ የቀረውን ዘይት በሚነጻው ሰው ራስ ላይ ያደርግበታል፤ ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed from his uncleanness; and afterward he shall kill the burnt offering:
verses.fr: Puis le sacrificateur offrira le sacrifice d''expiation; et il fera l''expiation pour celui qui se purifie de sa souillure. Ensuite il égorgera l''holocauste.
verses.am: ካህኑም የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል፥ ከርኵሰቱም ለሚነጻው ሰው ያስተሰርይለታል፤ በኋላም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያርዳል።

verses.en: And the priest shall offer the burnt offering and the meat offering upon the altar: and the priest shall make an atonement for him, and he shall be clean.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur offrira sur l''autel l''holocauste et l''offrande; et il fera pour cet homme l''expiation, et il sera pur.
verses.am: ካህኑም የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የእህሉን ቍርባን በመሠዊያው ላይ ያቀርባል፥ ካህኑም ያስተሰርይለታል፤ እርሱም ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And if he be poor, and cannot get so much; then he shall take one lamb for a trespass offering to be waved, to make an atonement for him, and one tenth deal of fine flour mingled with oil for a meat offering, and a log of oil;
verses.fr: S''il est pauvre et que ses ressources soient insuffisantes, il prendra un seul agneau, qui sera offert en sacrifice de culpabilité, après avoir été agité de côté et d''autre, et avec lequel on fera pour lui l''expiation. Il prendra un seul dixième de fleur de farine pétrie à l''huile pour l''offrande, et un log d''huile.
