verses.am: ድሀም ቢሆን ይህንም ለማምጣት ገንዘቡ ባይበቃው፥ ማስተስረያ ይሆንለት ዘንድ እንዲወዘወዝ አንድ ጠቦት ለበደል መሥዋዕት፥ ከመስፈሪያውም ከአሥር እጅ አንድ እጅ የሆነ በዘይት የተለወሰ መልካም ዱቄት ለእህል ቍርባን፥ አንድ የሎግ መስፈሪያም ዘይት ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, such as he is able to get; and the one shall be a sin offering, and the other a burnt offering.
verses.fr: Il prendra aussi deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, selon ses ressources, l''un pour le sacrifice d''expiation, l''autre pour l''holocauste.
verses.am: ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም የርግብ ግልገሎች እንደሚቻለው፥ አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሌላውን ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And he shall bring them on the eighth day for his cleansing unto the priest, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, before the Lord.
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, il apportera pour sa purification toutes ces choses au sacrificateur, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ስለ መንጻት ወደ ካህኑ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያመጣቸዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall take the lamb of the trespass offering, and the log of oil, and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the Lord:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur prendra l''agneau pour le sacrifice de culpabilité, et le log d''huile; et il les agitera de côté et d''autre devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ጠቦት የሎግ መስፈሪያውንም ዘይት ይወስዳል፤ ካህኑም ለመወዝወዝ ቍርባን በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይወዘውዛቸዋል።

verses.en: And he shall kill the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and put it upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot:
verses.fr: Il égorgera l''agneau du sacrifice de culpabilité. Le sacrificateur prendra du sang de la victime de culpabilité; il en mettra sur le lobe de l''oreille droite de celui qui se purifie, sur le pouce de sa main droite et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit.
verses.am: የበደሉንም መሥዋዕት ጠቦት ያርዳል፤ ካህኑም ከበደሉ መሥዋዕት ደም ወስዶ የሚነጻውን ሰው የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት ያስነካዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall pour of the oil into the palm of his own left hand:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur versera de l''huile dans le creux de sa main gauche.
verses.am: ካህኑም ከዘይቱ በግራ እጁ ውስጥ ያፈስሰዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur fera avec le doigt de sa main droite sept fois l''aspersion de l''huile qui est dans sa main gauche, devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም በግራ እጁ ውስጥ ካለው ዘይት በቀኝ ጣቱ ሰባት ጊዜ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall put of the oil that is in his hand upon the tip of the right ear of him that is to be cleansed, and upon the thumb of his right hand, and upon the great toe of his right foot, upon the place of the blood of the trespass offering:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur mettra de l''huile qui est dans sa main sur le lobe de l''oreille droite de celui qui se purifie, sur le pouce de sa main droite et sur le gros orteil de son pied droit, à la place où il a mis du sang de la victime de culpabilité.
verses.am: ካህኑም በእጁ ውስጥ ካለው ዘይት የሚነጻውን ሰው የቀኝ ጆሮውን ጫፍ፥ የቀኝ እጁንም አውራ ጣት፥ የቀኝ እግሩንም አውራ ጣት የበደል መሥዋዕት ደም ባረፈበት ላይ ያስነካዋል።

verses.en: And the rest of the oil that is in the priest's hand he shall put upon the head of him that is to be cleansed, to make an atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur mettra ce qui lui reste d''huile dans la main sur la tête de celui qui se purifie, afin de faire pour lui l''expiation devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለት ዘንድ በካህኑ እጅ ውስጥ የቀረውን ዘይት በሚነጻው ሰው ራስ ላይ ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: And he shall offer the one of the turtledoves, or of the young pigeons, such as he can get;
verses.fr: Puis il offrira l''une des tourterelles ou l''un des jeunes pigeons qu''il a pu se procurer,
verses.am: እንደሚቻለው ከዋኖሶች ወይም ከርግብ ግልገሎች አንዱን ያቀርባል።

verses.en: Even such as he is able to get, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, with the meat offering: and the priest shall make an atonement for him that is to be cleansed before the Lord.
verses.fr: l''un en sacrifice d''expiation, l''autre en holocauste, avec l''offrande; et le sacrificateur fera pour celui qui se purifie l''expiation devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: እንደሚቻለው አንዱን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሌላውንም ከእህል ቍርባን ጋር ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል ካህኑም ለሚነጻው ሰው በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.en: This is the law of him in whom is the plague of leprosy, whose hand is not able to get that which pertaineth to his cleansing.
verses.fr: Telle est la loi pour la purification de celui qui a une plaie de lèpre, et dont les ressources sont insuffisantes.
verses.am: ለመንጻቱ የሚያስፈልገውን ነገር ለማያገኝ የለምጽ ደዌ ላለበት ሰው ሕግ ይህ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: When ye be come into the land of Canaan, which I give to you for a possession, and I put the plague of leprosy in a house of the land of your possession;
verses.fr: Lorsque vous serez entrés dans le pays de Canaan, dont je vous donne la possession; si je mets une plaie de lèpre sur une maison du pays que vous posséderez,
verses.am: ወደምሰጣችሁ ርስት ወደ ከነዓን ምድር በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥ እኔም የለምጽ ደዌ በርስታችሁ ምድር በአንድ ቤት ባደረግሁ ጊዜ፥

verses.en: And he that owneth the house shall come and tell the priest, saying, It seemeth to me there is as it were a plague in the house:
verses.fr: celui à qui appartiendra la maison ira le déclarer au sacrificateur, et dira: J''aperçois comme une plaie dans ma maison.
verses.am: ባለቤቱ መጥቶ ካህኑን። ደዌ በቤቴ ውስጥ እንዳለ ይመስለኛል ብሎ ይንገረው።

verses.en: Then the priest shall command that they empty the house, before the priest go into it to see the plague, that all that is in the house be not made unclean: and afterward the priest shall go in to see the house:
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur, avant d''y entrer pour examiner la plaie, ordonnera qu''on vide la maison, afin que tout ce qui y est ne devienne pas impur. Après cela, le sacrificateur entrera pour examiner la maison.
verses.am: ካህኑም በቤቱ ውስጥ ያለው ዕቃ ሁሉ እንዳይረክስ፥ እርሱ ደዌውን ለማየት ወደ ቤት ሳይገባ፥ ቤቱን ባዶ እንዲያደርጉት ያዝዛል፤ በኋላም ካህኑ ቤቱን ለማየት ይገባል።

verses.en: And he shall look on the plague, and, behold, if the plague be in the walls of the house with hollow strakes, greenish or reddish, which in sight are lower than the wall;
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur examinera la plaie. S''il voit qu''elle offre sur les murs de la maison des cavités verdâtres ou rougeâtres, paraissant plus enfoncées que le mur,
verses.am: ደዌውንም ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በግንቡ ላይ በአረንጓዴና በቀይ ቢዥጐረጐር፥ መልኩም ወደ ግንቡ ውስጥ ቢጠልቅ፥

verses.en: Then the priest shall go out of the house to the door of the house, and shut up the house seven days:
verses.fr: il sortira de la maison, et, quand il sera à la porte, il fera fermer la maison pour sept jours.
verses.am: ካህኑ ከቤቱ ውስጥ ወደ ቤቱ በር ወጥቶ ሰባት ቀን ቤቱን ይዘጋዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall come again the seventh day, and shall look: and, behold, if the plague be spread in the walls of the house;
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur y retournera le septième jour. S''il voit que la plaie s''est étendue sur les murs de la maison,
verses.am: ካህኑም በሰባተኛው ቀን ተመልሶ ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በቤቱ ግንብ ላይ ቢሰፋ፥

verses.en: Then the priest shall command that they take away the stones in which the plague is, and they shall cast them into an unclean place without the city:
verses.fr: il ordonnera qu''on ôte les pierres attaquées de la plaie, et qu''on les jette hors de la ville, dans un lieu impur.
verses.am: ካህኑ ደዌ ያለባቸውን ድንጋዮች እንዲያወጡ፥ ከከተማውም ወደ ውጭ ወደ ረከሰው ስፍራ እንዲጥሉአቸው ያዝዛል።

verses.en: And he shall cause the house to be scraped within round about, and they shall pour out the dust that they scrape off without the city into an unclean place:
verses.fr: Il fera râcler tout l''intérieur de la maison; et l''on jettera hors de la ville, dans un lieu impur, la poussière qu''on aura râclée.
verses.am: ቤቱንም በውስጡ በዙሪያው ያስፍቀዋል፤ የፋቁትንም የምርጊቱን አፈር ከከተማው ወደ ውጭ ወደ ረከሰ ስፍራ ያፈስሱታል።

verses.en: And they shall take other stones, and put them in the place of those stones; and he shall take other morter, and shall plaister the house.
verses.fr: On prendra d''autres pierres, que l''on mettra à la place des premières; et l''on prendra d''autre mortier, pour recrépir la maison.
verses.am: በእነዚያም ድንጋዮች ስፍራ ሌሎች ድንጋዮች ያገባሉ፤ ሌላም ጭቃ ወስደው ቤቱን ይመርጉታል።

verses.en: And if the plague come again, and break out in the house, after that he hath taken away the stones, and after he hath scraped the house, and after it is plaistered;
verses.fr: Si la plaie revient et fait éruption dans la maison, après qu''on a ôté les pierres, râclé et recrépi la maison,
verses.am: ደዌውም ዳግም ቢመለስ፥ ድንጋዮቹም ከወጡ ቤቱም ከተፋቀና ከተመረገ በኋላ በቤቱ ውስጥ ቢሰፋ፥

verses.en: Then the priest shall come and look, and, behold, if the plague be spread in the house, it is a fretting leprosy in the house; it is unclean.
verses.fr: le sacrificateur y retournera. S''il voit que la plaie s''est étendue dans la maison, c''est une lèpre invétérée dans la maison: elle est impure.
verses.am: ካህኑ ገብቶ ያያል፤ እነሆም፥ ደዌው በቤቱ ውስጥ ቢሰፋ በቤቱ ውስጥ ያለው እየፋገ የሚሄድ ለምጽ ነው፤ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And he shall break down the house, the stones of it, and the timber thereof, and all the morter of the house; and he shall carry them forth out of the city into an unclean place.
verses.fr: On abattra la maison, les pierres, le bois, et tout le mortier de la maison; et l''on portera ces choses hors de la ville dans un lieu impur.
verses.am: ቤቱንም፥ ድንጋዮቹንም፥ እንጨቱንም፥ የቤቱንም ምርጊት ሁሉ ያፈርሳል፤ እነርሱንም ከከተማው ወደ ውጭ ወደ ርኩስ ስፍራ ያወጣል።

verses.en: Moreover he that goeth into the house all the while that it is shut up shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Celui qui sera entré dans la maison pendant tout le temps qu''elle était fermée sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: በተዘጋበትም ጊዜ ሁሉ ወደ ቤቱ የሚገባ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ይሆናል።

verses.en: And he that lieth in the house shall wash his clothes; and he that eateth in the house shall wash his clothes.
verses.fr: Celui qui aura couché dans la maison lavera ses vêtements. Celui qui aura mangé dans la maison lavera aussi ses vêtements.
verses.am: በቤቱም የሚተኛ ልብሱን ያጥባል፤ በቤቱም የሚበላ ልብሱን ያጥባል።

verses.en: And if the priest shall come in, and look upon it, and, behold, the plague hath not spread in the house, after the house was plaistered: then the priest shall pronounce the house clean, because the plague is healed.
verses.fr: Si le sacrificateur, qui est retourné dans la maison, voit que la plaie ne s''est pas étendue, après que la maison a été recrépie, il déclarera la maison pure, car la plaie est guérie.
verses.am: ካህኑም ገብቶ ቢያይ፥ እነሆም፥ ቤቱ ከተመረገ በኋላ ደዌው በቤቱ ውስጥ ባይሰፋ፥ ደዌው ስለ ሻረ ካህኑ ቤቱን። ንጹሕ ነው ይለዋል።

verses.en: And he shall take to cleanse the house two birds, and cedar wood, and scarlet, and hyssop:
verses.fr: Il prendra, pour purifier la maison, deux oiseaux, du bois de cèdre, du cramoisi et de l''hysope.
verses.am: ቤቱንም ለማንጻት ሁለት ወፎች፥ የዝግባም እንጨት፥ ቀይ ግምጃም፥ ሂሶጵም ይወስዳል።

verses.en: And he shall kill the one of the birds in an earthen vessel over running water:
verses.fr: Il égorgera l''un des oiseaux sur un vase de terre, sur de l''eau vive.
verses.am: አንደኛውንም ወፍ በሸክላ ዕቃ ውስጥ ከምንጩ ውኃ በላይ ያርዳል።

verses.en: And he shall take the cedar wood, and the hyssop, and the scarlet, and the living bird, and dip them in the blood of the slain bird, and in the running water, and sprinkle the house seven times:
verses.fr: Il prendra le bois de cèdre, l''hysope, le cramoisi et l''oiseau vivant; il les trempera dans le sang de l''oiseau égorgé et dans l''eau vive, et il en fera sept fois l''aspersion sur la maison.
verses.am: የዝግባውን እንጨት፥ ሂሶጱንም፥ ቀዩንም ግምጃ፥ ሕያውንም ወፍ ወስዶ በታረደው ወፍ ደምና በምንጩ ውኃ ውስጥ ይነክራቸዋል፥ ቤቱንም ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And he shall cleanse the house with the blood of the bird, and with the running water, and with the living bird, and with the cedar wood, and with the hyssop, and with the scarlet:
verses.fr: Il purifiera la maison avec le sang de l''oiseau, avec de l''eau vive, avec l''oiseau vivant, avec le bois de cèdre, l''hysope et le cramoisi.
verses.am: ቤቱንም በወፉ ደም በምንጩም ውኃ በሕያውም ወፍ በዝግባውም እንጨት በሂሶጱም በቀዩም ግምጃ ያነጻዋል።

verses.en: But he shall let go the living bird out of the city into the open fields, and make an atonement for the house: and it shall be clean.
verses.fr: Il lâchera l''oiseau vivant hors de la ville, dans les champs. C''est ainsi qu''il fera pour la maison l''expiation, et elle sera pure.
verses.am: ሕያውንም ወፍ ከከተማ ወደ ሜዳ ይሰድደዋል፤ ለቤቱም ያስተሰርይለታል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል።

verses.en: This is the law for all manner of plague of leprosy, and scall,
verses.fr: Telle est la loi pour toute plaie de lèpre et pour la teigne,
verses.am: ይህም ሕግ ነው ለሁሉ ዓይነት ለምጽ ደዌ፥

verses.en: And for the leprosy of a garment, and of a house,
verses.fr: pour la lèpre des vêtements et des maisons,
verses.am: ለቈረቈርም፥ በልብስና በቤትም ላለ ለምጽ፥

verses.en: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
verses.fr: pour les tumeurs, les dartres et les taches:
verses.am: ለእባጭም፥ ለብጕርም፥ ለቋቁቻም፤

verses.en: To teach when it is unclean, and when it is clean: this is the law of leprosy.
verses.fr: elle enseigne quand une chose est impure, et quand elle est pure. Telle est la loi sur la lèpre.
verses.am: በሚረክስና በሚነጻ ጊዜ እንዲያስታውቅ ይህ የለምጽ ሕግ ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse et à Aaron, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴንና አሮንን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገራቸው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When any man hath a running issue out of his flesh, because of his issue he is unclean.
verses.fr: Parlez aux enfants d''Israël, et dites-leur: Tout homme qui a une gonorrhée est par là même impur.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብላችሁ ንገሩአቸው። ማንም ሰው ከሥጋው ፈሳሽ ነገር ቢወጣ፥ ስለሚፈስሰው ነገር ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And this shall be his uncleanness in his issue: whether his flesh run with his issue, or his flesh be stopped from his issue, it is his uncleanness.
verses.fr: C''est à cause de sa gonorrhée qu''il est impur: que sa chair laisse couler son flux, ou qu''elle le retienne, il est impur.
verses.am: ስለሚፈስሰው ነገር ርኵስነቱ ይህ ነው፤ ፈሳሹ ነገር ከሥጋው ቢፈስስ ወይም ከመፍሰሱ ቢቆም፥ ርኩስ መሆኑ ነው።

verses.en: Every bed, whereon he lieth that hath the issue, is unclean: and every thing, whereon he sitteth, shall be unclean.
verses.fr: Tout lit sur lequel il couchera sera impur, et tout objet sur lequel il s''assiéra sera impur.
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው የሚተኛበት መኝታ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ የሚቀመጥበትም ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth his bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Celui qui touchera son lit lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: መኝታውንም የሚነካ ሁሉ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And he that sitteth on any thing whereon he sat that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Celui qui s''assiéra sur l''objet sur lequel il s''est assis lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው በተቀመጠበት ነገር ላይ የሚቀመጥበት ሰው ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And he that toucheth the flesh of him that hath the issue shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Celui qui touchera sa chair lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበትን የሰውን ሥጋ የሚነካ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And if he that hath the issue spit upon him that is clean; then he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: S''il crache sur un homme pur, cet homme lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው በንጹሕ ሰው ላይ ቢተፋ፥ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And what saddle soever he rideth upon that hath the issue shall be unclean.
verses.fr: Toute monture sur laquelle il s''assiéra sera impure.
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው የተቀመጠበት ኮርቻ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that was under him shall be unclean until the even: and he that beareth any of those things shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Celui qui touchera une chose quelconque qui a été sous lui sera impur jusqu''au soir; et celui qui la portera lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ከበታቹም ያለውን ነገር የሚነካ ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ነው፤ እነዚህንም ነገሮች የሚያነሣ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whomsoever he toucheth that hath the issue, and hath not rinsed his hands in water, he shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Celui qui sera touché par lui, et qui ne se sera pas lavé les mains dans l''eau, lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው እጁን በውኃ ሳይታጠብ የሚነካው ሁሉ ልብሱን ይጠብ፥ በውኃም ይታጠብ፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And the vessel of earth, that he toucheth which hath the issue, shall be broken: and every vessel of wood shall be rinsed in water.
verses.fr: Tout vase de terre qui sera touché par lui sera brisé, et tout vase de bois sera lavé dans l''eau.
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው የሚነካውን የሸክላ ዕቃ ይስበሩት፤ የእንጨቱም ዕቃ ሁሉ በውኃ ይታጠብ።

verses.en: And when he that hath an issue is cleansed of his issue; then he shall number to himself seven days for his cleansing, and wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in running water, and shall be clean.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il sera purifié de son flux, il comptera sept jours pour sa purification; il lavera ses vêtements, il lavera sa chair avec de l''eau vive, et il sera pur.
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ያለበት ሰው ከፈሳሹ ነገር ሲነጻ ስለ መንጻቱ ሰባት ቀን ይቈጥራል፤ ልብሱንም ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በምንጭ ውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ንጹሕም ይሆናል።

verses.en: And on the eighth day he shall take to him two turtledoves, or two young pigeons, and come before the Lord unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and give them unto the priest:
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, il prendra deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, il ira devant l''Eternel, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, et il les donnera au sacrificateur.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ይዞ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ይመጣል፥ ለካህኑም ይሰጣቸዋል።

verses.en: And the priest shall offer them, the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for him before the Lord for his issue.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur les offrira, l''un en sacrifice d''expiation, et l''autre en holocauste; et le sacrificateur fera pour lui l''expiation devant l''Eternel, à cause de son flux.
verses.am: ካህኑም አንደኛውን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሌላውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል፤ ካህኑም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ስለ ፈሳሹ ነገር ያስተሰርይለታል።

verses.en: And if any man's seed of copulation go out from him, then he shall wash all his flesh in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: L''homme qui aura une pollution lavera tout son corps dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: የማንም ሰው ዘር ከእርሱ ቢወጣ፥ ገላውን ሁሉ በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And every garment, and every skin, whereon is the seed of copulation, shall be washed with water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Tout vêtement et toute peau qui en seront atteints seront lavés dans l''eau, et seront impurs jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ዘር የነካው ልብስ ሁሉ ቁርበትም ሁሉ በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: The woman also with whom man shall lie with seed of copulation, they shall both bathe themselves in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Si une femme a couché avec un tel homme, ils se laveront l''un et l''autre, et seront impurs jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ወንዱ በሴቲቱ ቢደርስባት ሁለቱ በውኃ ይታጠባሉ፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩሶች ናቸው።

verses.en: And if a woman have an issue, and her issue in her flesh be blood, she shall be put apart seven days: and whosoever toucheth her shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: La femme qui aura un flux, un flux de sang en sa chair, restera sept jours dans son impureté. Quiconque la touchera sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: ሴት ፈሳሽ ነገር ቢኖርባት በሥጋዋም ያለው ፈሳሽ ነገር ደም ቢሆን፥ በመርገምዋ ሰባት ቀን ትቀመጣለች፤ የሚነካትም ሁሉ እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And every thing that she lieth upon in her separation shall be unclean: every thing also that she sitteth upon shall be unclean.
verses.fr: Tout lit sur lequel elle couchera pendant son impureté sera impur, et tout objet sur lequel elle s''assiéra sera impur.
verses.am: መርገምም ስትሆን የምትተኛበት ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ የምትቀመጥበትም ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth her bed shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Quiconque touchera son lit lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: መኝታዋንም የሚነካ ሁሉ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth any thing that she sat upon shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Quiconque touchera un objet sur lequel elle s''est assise lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: የምትቀመጥበትንም ነገር ሁሉ የሚነካ ሁሉ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And if it be on her bed, or on any thing whereon she sitteth, when he toucheth it, he shall be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: S''il y a quelque chose sur le lit ou sur l''objet sur lequel elle s''est assise, celui qui la touchera sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: በመኝታዋም ላይ ወይም በምትቀመጥበት ነገር ላይ ቢሆን ሲነካው እስከ ማታ ድረስ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And if any man lie with her at all, and her flowers be upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and all the bed whereon he lieth shall be unclean.
verses.fr: Si un homme couche avec elle et que l''impureté de cette femme vienne sur lui, il sera impur pendant sept jours, et tout lit sur lequel il couchera sera impur.
verses.am: ማንም ከእርስዋ ጋር ቢተኛ መርገምዋም ቢነካው፥ ሰባት ቀን ርኩስ ነው፤ የሚተኛበትም መኝታ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: And if a woman have an issue of her blood many days out of the time of her separation, or if it run beyond the time of her separation; all the days of the issue of her uncleanness shall be as the days of her separation: she shall be unclean.
verses.fr: La femme qui aura un flux de sang pendant plusieurs jours hors de ses époques régulières, ou dont le flux durera plus qu''à l''ordinaire, sera impure tout le temps de son flux, comme au temps de son indisposition menstruelle.
verses.am: ሴትም ከመርገም ቀን ሌላ ደምዋ ብዙ ቀን ቢፈስስ፥ ወይም ደምዋ ከመርገምዋ ወራት የሚበልጥ ቢፈስስ፥ በመርገምዋ ወራት እንደ ሆነች እንዲሁ በፈሳሽዋ ርኵስነት ወራት ትሆናለች፤ ርኩስ ናት።

verses.en: Every bed whereon she lieth all the days of her issue shall be unto her as the bed of her separation: and whatsoever she sitteth upon shall be unclean, as the uncleanness of her separation.
verses.fr: Tout lit sur lequel elle couchera pendant la durée de ce flux sera comme le lit de son flux menstruel, et tout objet sur lequel elle s''assiéra sera impur comme lors de son flux menstruel.
verses.am: ደምዋም በሚፈስስበት ወራት ሁሉ የምትተኛበት መኝታ ሁሉ በመርገምዋ ጊዜ እንደ ነበረው መኝታ ያለ ይሆንባታል፤ የምትቀመጥበት ነገር ሁሉ እንደ መርገምዋ ርኵስነት ርኵስ ነው።

verses.en: And whosoever toucheth those things shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even.
verses.fr: Quiconque les touchera sera souillé; il lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impur jusqu''au soir.
verses.am: እነዚህንም ነገሮች የሚነካ ሁሉ ርኩስ ነው፤ ልብሱንም ያጥባል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ነው።

verses.en: But if she be cleansed of her issue, then she shall number to herself seven days, and after that she shall be clean.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''elle sera purifiée de son flux, elle comptera sept jours, après lesquels elle sera pure.
verses.am: ከፈሳሽዋም ብትነጻ ሰባት ቀን ትቈጥራለች ከዚያም በኋላ ንጹሕ ትሆናለች።

verses.en: And on the eighth day she shall take unto her two turtles, or two young pigeons, and bring them unto the priest, to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Le huitième jour, elle prendra deux tourterelles ou deux jeunes pigeons, et elle les apportera au sacrificateur, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: በስምንተኛውም ቀን ሁለት ዋኖሶች ወይም ሁለት የርግብ ግልገሎች ይዛ ወደ ካህኑ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ታመጣቸዋለች።

verses.en: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering; and the priest shall make an atonement for her before the Lord for the issue of her uncleanness.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur offrira l''un en sacrifice d''expiation, et l''autre en holocauste; et le sacrificateur fera pour elle l''expiation devant l''Eternel, à cause du flux qui la rendait impure.
verses.am: ካህኑም አንደኛውን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት፥ ሌላውንም ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ያቀርባል፤ ካህኑም ስለ ፈሳሽዋ ርኵስነት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያስተሰርይላታል።

verses.en: Thus shall ye separate the children of Israel from their uncleanness; that they die not in their uncleanness, when they defile my tabernacle that is among them.
verses.fr: Vous éloignerez les enfants d''Israël de leurs impuretés, de peur qu''ils ne meurent à cause de leurs impuretés, s''ils souillent mon tabernacle qui est au milieu d''eux.
verses.am: እንዲሁም በእነርሱ መካከል ያለችውን ማደሪያዬን ባረከሱ ጊዜ፥ በርኵስነታቸው እንዳይሞቱ የእስራኤልን ልጆች ከርኵስነታቸው ለያቸው።

verses.en: This is the law of him that hath an issue, and of him whose seed goeth from him, and is defiled therewith;
verses.fr: Telle est la loi pour celui qui a une gonorrhée ou qui est souillé par une pollution,
verses.am: ፈሳሽ ነገር ላለበት ሰው፥ ይረክስም ዘንድ ዘሩ ለሚወጣበት ሰው፥

verses.en: And of her that is sick of her flowers, and of him that hath an issue, of the man, and of the woman, and of him that lieth with her that is unclean.
verses.fr: pour celle qui a son flux menstruel, pour l''homme ou la femme qui a un flux, et pour l''homme qui couche avec une femme impure.
verses.am: በመርገምዋም ለታመመች፥ ፈሳሽም ነገር ላለባቸው ለወንድም ለሴትም፥ የረከሰችንም ሴት ለሚገናኝ ሰው ሕጉ ይኸው ነው።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the Lord, and died;
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, après la mort des deux fils d''Aaron, qui moururent en se présentant devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ፊት የቀረቡና የሞቱ ሁለት የአሮን ልጆች ከሞቱ በኋላ እግዚአብሔር ሙሴን ተናገረው፤

verses.en: And the Lord said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.
verses.fr: L''Eternel dit à Moïse: Parle à ton frère Aaron, afin qu''il n''entre pas en tout temps dans le sanctuaire, au dedans du voile, devant le propitiatoire qui est sur l''arche, de peur qu''il ne meure; car j''apparaîtrai dans la nuée sur le propitiatoire.
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን አለው። እኔ በስርየቱ መክደኛ ላይ በደመናው ውስጥ እታያለሁና እንዳይሞት በመጋረጃው ውስጥ በታቦቱ ላይ ወዳለው ወደ ስርየቱ መክደኛ ወደ ተቀደሰው ስፍራ ሁልጊዜ እንዳይገባ ለወንድምህ ለአሮን ንገረው።

verses.en: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.fr: Voici de quelle manière Aaron entrera dans le sanctuaire. Il prendra un jeune taureau pour le sacrifice d''expiation et un bélier pour l''holocauste.
verses.am: እንዲሁ አሮን ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ወይፈን፥ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕትም አውራ በግ ይዞ ወደ ተቀደሰ ስፍራ ይግባ።

verses.en: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.
verses.fr: Il se revêtira de la tunique sacrée de lin, et portera sur son corps des caleçons de lin; il se ceindra d''une ceinture de lin, et il se couvrira la tête d''une tiare de lin: ce sont les vêtements sacrés, dont il se revêtira après avoir lavé son corps dans l''eau.
verses.am: የተቀደሰውን የበፍታ ቀሚስ ይልበስ፥ የበፍታውም ሱሪ በገላው ላይ ይሁን፥ የበፍታውንም መታጠቂያ ይታጠቅ፥ የበፍታውንም መጠምጠሚያ ይጠምጥም፤ እነዚህ የተቀደሱ ልብሶች ናቸው፤ ገላውንም በውኃ ታጥቦ ይልበሳቸው።

verses.en: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.fr: Il recevra de l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël deux boucs pour le sacrifice d''expiation et un bélier pour l''holocauste.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ማኅበር ለኃጢአት መሥዋዕት ሁለት አውራ ፍየሎች፥ ለሚቃጠልም መሥዋዕት አንድ አውራ በግ ይውሰድ።

verses.en: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.
verses.fr: Aaron offrira son taureau expiatoire, et il fera l''expiation pour lui et pour sa maison.
verses.am: አሮንም ለእርሱ ያለውን የኃጢአቱን መሥዋዕት ወይፈን ያቀርባል፥ ለራሱም ለቤተ ሰቡም ያስተሰርያል።

verses.en: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.fr: Il prendra les deux boucs, et il les placera devant l''Eternel, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation.
verses.am: ሁለቱንም አውራ ፍየሎች ወስዶ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ አጠገብ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቆማቸዋል።

verses.en: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the Lord, and the other lot for the scapegoat.
verses.fr: Aaron jettera le sort sur les deux boucs, un sort pour l''Eternel et un sort pour Azazel.
verses.am: አሮንም በሁለቱ ፍየሎች ላይ ዕጣ ይጥልባቸዋል፥ አንዱን ዕጣ ለእግዚአብሔር ሌላውንም ዕጣ ለሚለቀቅ።

verses.en: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the Lord's lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.
verses.fr: Aaron fera approcher le bouc sur lequel est tombé le sort pour l''Eternel, et il l''offrira en sacrifice d''expiation.
verses.am: አሮንም የእግዚአብሔር ዕጣ የሆነበትን ፍየል ያቀርባል፥ ስለ ኃጢአትም መሥዋዕት ያደርገዋል።

verses.en: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the Lord, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.
verses.fr: Et le bouc sur lequel est tombé le sort pour Azazel sera placé vivant devant l''Eternel, afin qu''il serve à faire l''expiation et qu''il soit lâché dans le désert pour Azazel.
verses.am: የመለቀቅም ዕጣ የሆነበትን ፍየል ያስተሰርይበት ዘንድ፥ ለመለቀቅም ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይሰድደው ዘንድ በሕይወቱ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ያቆመዋል።

verses.en: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:
verses.fr: Aaron offrira son taureau expiatoire, et il fera l''expiation pour lui et pour sa maison. Il égorgera son taureau expiatoire.
verses.am: አሮንም ስለ ራሱ ኃጢአት የሚሠዋውን መሥዋዕት ወይፈኑን ያቀርባል፤ ለራሱም ለቤተ ሰቡም ያስተሰርያል፤ ስለ ኃጢአቱ የእርሱን መሥዋዕት ወይፈኑን ያርዳል።

verses.en: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the Lord, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:
verses.fr: Il prendra un brasier plein de charbons ardents ôtés de dessus l''autel devant l''Eternel, et de deux poignées de parfum odoriférant en poudre; il portera ces choses au delà du voile;
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ካለው መሠዊያ ላይ የእሳት ፍም አምጥቶ ጥናውን ይሞላል፥ ከተወቀጠውም ከጣፋጭ ዕጣን እጁን ሙሉን ይወስዳል፤ ወደ መጋረጃውም ውስጥ ያመጣዋል።

verses.en: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the Lord, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:
verses.fr: il mettra le parfum sur le feu devant l''Eternel, afin que la nuée du parfum couvre le propitiatoire qui est sur le témoignage, et il ne mourra point.
verses.am: እንዳይሞትም የጢሱ ደመና በምስክሩ ላይ ያለውን መክደኛ ይሸፍን ዘንድ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ዕጣኑን በእሳቱ ላይ ያደርጋል።

verses.en: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.
verses.fr: Il prendra du sang du taureau, et il fera l''aspersion avec son doigt sur le devant du propitiatoire vers l''orient; il fera avec son doigt sept fois l''aspersion du sang devant le propitiatoire.
verses.am: ከወይፈኑም ደም ወስዶ በስርየቱ መክደኛ ላይ ወደ ምሥራቅ በጣቱ ይረጨዋል፤ ከደሙም በመክደኛው ፊት በጣቱ ሰባት ጊዜ ይረጫል።

verses.en: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:
verses.fr: Il égorgera le bouc expiatoire pour le peuple, et il en portera le sang au delà du voile. Il fera avec ce sang comme il a fait avec le sang du taureau, il en fera l''aspersion sur le propitiatoire et devant le propitiatoire.
verses.am: ስለ ሕዝቡም ኃጢአት የሚሠዋውን መሥዋዕት ፍየል ያርዳል፥ ደሙም ወደ መጋረጃው ውስጥ ያመጣዋል፤ በወይፈኑም ደም እንዳደረገ በፍየሉ ደም ያደርጋል፤ በመክደኛውም ላይና በመክደኛውም ፊት ይረጨዋል።

verses.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.fr: C''est ainsi qu''il fera l''expiation pour le sanctuaire à cause des impuretés des enfants d''Israël et de toutes les transgressions par lesquelles ils ont péché. Il fera de même pour la tente d''assignation, qui est avec eux au milieu de leurs impuretés.
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ልጆች ርኵስነት ከመተላለፋቸውም ከኃጢአታቸውም የተነሣ ለመቅደሱ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ እንዲሁም በርኩስነታቸው መካከል ከእነርሱ ጋር ለኖረች ለመገናኛው ድንኳን ያደርጋል።

verses.en: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.
verses.fr: Il n''y aura personne dans la tente d''assignation lorsqu''il entrera pour faire l''expiation dans le sanctuaire, jusqu''à ce qu''il en sorte. Il fera l''expiation pour lui et pour sa maison, et pour toute l''assemblée d''Israël.
verses.am: እርሱም ለማስተስረይ ወደ መቅደሱ በገባ ጊዜ ለራሱ፥ ለቤተ ሰቡም፥ ለእስራኤል ጉባዔ ሁሉ አስተስርዮ እስኪወጣ ድረስ በመገናኛው ድንኳን ውስጥ ማንም አይኖርም።

verses.en: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the Lord, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.
verses.fr: En sortant, il ira vers l''autel qui est devant l''Eternel, et il fera l''expiation pour l''autel; il prendra du sang du taureau et du bouc, et il en mettra sur les cornes de l''autel tout autour.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ወዳለው ወደ መሠዊያ ወጥቶ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ ከወይፈኑም ደም ከፍየሉም ደም ወስዶ በመሠዊያው ዙሪያ ያሉትን ቀንዶች ያስነካል።

verses.en: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.
verses.fr: Il fera avec son doigt sept fois l''aspersion du sang sur l''autel; il le purifiera et le sanctifiera, à cause des impuretés des enfants d''Israël.
verses.am: ከደሙም በእርሱ ላይ ሰባት ጊዜ በጣቱ ይረጫል፥ ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ርኵስነት ያነጻዋል፥ ይቀድሰውማል።

verses.en: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:
verses.fr: Lorsqu''il aura achevé de faire l''expiation pour le sanctuaire, pour la tente d''assignation et pour l''autel, il fera approcher le bouc vivant.
verses.am: መቅደሱንም፥ የመገናኛውንም ድንኳን፥ መሠዊያውንም ማስተስረይ ከፈጸመ በኋላ ሕያውን ፍየል ያቀርባል፤

verses.en: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:
verses.fr: Aaron posera ses deux mains sur la tête du bouc vivant, et il confessera sur lui toutes les iniquités des enfants d''Israël et toutes les transgressions par lesquelles ils ont péché; il les mettra sur la tête du bouc, puis il le chassera dans le désert, à l''aide d''un homme qui aura cette charge.
verses.am: አሮንም ሁለቱን እጆቹን በሕያው ፍየል ራስ ላይ ይጭናል፥ በላዩም የእስራኤልን ልጆች በደል ሁሉ መተላለፋቸውንም ሁሉ ኃጢአታቸውንም ሁሉ ይናዝዛል፤ በፍየሉም ራስ ላይ ያሸክመዋል፥ በተዘጋጀው ሰውም እጅ ወደ ምድረ በዳ ይሰድደዋል።

verses.en: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.
verses.fr: Le bouc emportera sur lui toutes leurs iniquités dans une terre désolée; il sera chassé dans le désert.
verses.am: ፍየሉም ኃጢአታቸውን ሁሉ ወደ በረሀ ይሸከማል፤ ፍየሉንም በምድረ በዳ ውስጥ ይለቅቀዋል።

verses.en: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:
verses.fr: Aaron entrera dans la tente d''assignation; il quittera les vêtements de lin qu''il avait mis en entrant dans le sanctuaire, et il les déposera là.
verses.am: አሮንም ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ይገባል፥ ወደ መቅደሱም በገባ ጊዜ የለበሰውን የበፍታ ልብስ ያወልቃል፥ በዚያም ይተወዋል፤

verses.en: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.
verses.fr: Il lavera son corps avec de l''eau dans un lieu saint, et reprendra ses vêtements. Puis il sortira, offrira son holocauste et l''holocauste du peuple, et fera l''expiation pour lui et pour le peuple.
verses.am: በተቀደሰውም ስፍራ ገላውን በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ሌላውንም ልብስ ለብሶ ይወጣል፤ የእርሱንም የሚቃጠል መስዋዕት፥ የሕዝቡንም የሚቃጠል መስዋዕት ያቀርባል፥ ለራሱም ለሕዝቡም ያስተሰርያል።

verses.en: And the fat of the sin offering shall he burn upon the altar.
verses.fr: Il brûlera sur l''autel la graisse de la victime expiatoire.
verses.am: የኃጢያቱንም መስዋዕት ስብ በመሰዊያው ላይ ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And he that let go the goat for the scapegoat shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward come into the camp.
verses.fr: Celui qui aura chassé le bouc pour Azazel lavera ses vêtements, et lavera son corps dans l''eau; après cela, il rentrera dans le camp.
verses.am: ለመለቀቅ የሚሆነውን ፍየል የወሰደ ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈሩ ይገባል።

verses.en: And the bullock for the sin offering, and the goat for the sin offering, whose blood was brought in to make atonement in the holy place, shall one carry forth without the camp; and they shall burn in the fire their skins, and their flesh, and their dung.
verses.fr: On emportera hors du camp le taureau expiatoire et le bouc expiatoire dont on a porté le sang dans le sanctuaire pour faire l''expiation, et l''on brûlera au feu leurs peaux, leur chair et leurs excréments.
verses.am: ለማስተስረያም እንዲሆን ደማቸው ወደ መቅደስ የገባውን የኃጢአቱን መስዋዕት ወይፈንና የኃጢአቱን መስዋዕት ፍየል ከሰፈሩ ወደ ውጭ ያወጡአቸዋል፤ ቁርበታቸውንም፥ ሥጋቸውንም፥ ፈርሳቸውንም በእሳት ያቃጥላሉ።

verses.en: And he that burneth them shall wash his clothes, and bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp.
verses.fr: Celui qui les brûlera lavera ses vêtements, et lavera son corps dans l''eau; après cela, il rentrera dans le camp.
verses.am: ያቃጠላቸውም ሰው ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ ገላውንም በውኃ ይታጠባል፥ ከዚያም በኋላ ወደ ሰፈር ይገባል።

verses.en: And this shall be a statute for ever unto you: that in the seventh month, on the tenth day of the month, ye shall afflict your souls, and do no work at all, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.fr: C''est ici pour vous une loi perpétuelle: au septième mois, le dixième jour du mois, vous humilierez vos âmes, vous ne ferez aucun ouvrage, ni l''indigène, ni l''étranger qui séjourne au milieu de vous.
verses.am: ታላቅ ሰንበት ይሆንላችኋል፥ ራሳችሁንም ታዋርዳላችሁ፤ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.en: For on that day shall the priest make an atonement for you, to cleanse you, that ye may be clean from all your sins before the Lord.
verses.fr: Car en ce jour on fera l''expiation pour vous, afin de vous purifier: vous serez purifiés de tous vos péchés devant l''Eternel.
verses.am: ታላቅ ሰንበት ይሆንላችኋል፥ ራሳችሁንም ታዋርዳላችሁ፤ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ነው።

verses.en: It shall be a sabbath of rest unto you, and ye shall afflict your souls, by a statute for ever.
verses.fr: Ce sera pour vous un sabbat, un jour de repos, et vous humilierez vos âmes. C''est une loi perpétuelle.
verses.am: የሚቀባውም፥ በአባቱ ፋንታ ካህን ሊሆን የሚካነው ካህን ያስተስርይ፥ የተቀደሰውንም የበፍታ ልብስ ይልበስ፤

verses.en: And the priest, whom he shall anoint, and whom he shall consecrate to minister in the priest's office in his father's stead, shall make the atonement, and shall put on the linen clothes, even the holy garments:
verses.fr: L''expiation sera faite par le sacrificateur qui a reçu l''onction et qui a été consacré pour succéder à son père dans le sacerdoce; il se revêtira des vêtements de lin, des vêtements sacrés.
verses.am: ለቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑም ያስተስርይ፤ ለመገናኛውም ድንኳን ለመሠዊያውም ያስተስርይ፤ ለካህናቱም ለጉባኤውም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ያስተስርይ።

verses.en: And he shall make an atonement for the holy sanctuary, and he shall make an atonement for the tabernacle of the congregation, and for the altar, and he shall make an atonement for the priests, and for all the people of the congregation.
verses.fr: Il fera l''expiation pour le sanctuaire de sainteté, il fera l''expiation pour la tente d''assignation et pour l''autel, et il fera l''expiation pour les sacrificateurs et pour tout le peuple de l''assemblée.
verses.am: ይህም አንድ ጊዜ በዓመት ለእስራኤል ልጆች ስለ ኃጢአታቸው ሁሉ ያስተስርይ ዘንድ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁንላችሁ። እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And this shall be an everlasting statute unto you, to make an atonement for the children of Israel for all their sins once a year. And he did as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.fr: Ce sera pour vous une loi perpétuelle: il se fera une fois chaque année l''expiation pour les enfants d''Israël, à cause de leurs péchés. On fit ce que l''Eternel avait ordonné à Moïse.
verses.am: ፤ ይህም አንድ ጊዜ በዓመት ለእስራኤል ልጆች ስለ ኃጢአታቸው ሁሉ ያስተስርይ ዘንድ የዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁንላችሁ። እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዳዘዘው እንዲሁ አደረገ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto Aaron, and unto his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them; This is the thing which the Lord hath commanded, saying,
verses.fr: Parle à Aaron et à ses fils, et à tous les enfants d''Israël, et tu leur diras: Voici ce que l''Eternel a ordonné.
verses.am: ለአሮንና ለልጆቹ ለእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ እንዲህ ብለህ ንገር። እግዚአብሔር ያዘዘው ይህ ነው፥ እንዲህም አለ።

verses.en: What man soever there be of the house of Israel, that killeth an ox, or lamb, or goat, in the camp, or that killeth it out of the camp,
verses.fr: Si un homme de la maison d''Israël égorge dans le camp ou hors du camp un boeuf, un agneau ou une chèvre,
verses.am: ከእስራኤል ቤት ማናቸውም ሰው በሬ ወይም በግ ወይም ፍየል ቢያርድ፥ በሰፈሩ ውስጥ ወይም ከሰፈሩ ውጭ ቢያርደው፥

verses.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer an offering unto the Lord before the tabernacle of the Lord; blood shall be imputed unto that man; he hath shed blood; and that man shall be cut off from among his people:
verses.fr: et ne l''amène pas à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, pour en faire une offrande à l''Eternel devant le tabernacle de l''Eternel, le sang sera imputé à cet homme; il a répandu le sang, cet homme-là sera retranché du milieu de son peuple.
verses.am: በእግዚአብሔር ማደሪያ ፊት ለእግዚአብሔር ቍርባን ያቀርብ ዘንድ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ባያመጣው፥ ደሙ በዚያ ሰው ላይ ይቈጠርበታል፤ ደም አፍስሶአል፤ ያም ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: To the end that the children of Israel may bring their sacrifices, which they offer in the open field, even that they may bring them unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, unto the priest, and offer them for peace offerings unto the Lord.
verses.fr: C''est afin que les enfants d''Israël, au lieu de sacrifier leurs victimes dans les champs, les amènent au sacrificateur, devant l''Eternel, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, et qu''ils les offrent à l''Eternel en sacrifices d''actions de grâces.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤል ልጆች በሜዳ የሚያርዱትን መሥዋዕታቸውን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ያመጡታል፤ ወደ ካህኑም አምጥተው ለእግዚአብሔር ለደኅንነት መሥዋዕት ይሠዉታል።

verses.en: And the priest shall sprinkle the blood upon the altar of the Lord at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and burn the fat for a sweet savour unto the Lord.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur en répandra le sang sur l''autel de l''Eternel, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation; et il brûlera la graisse, qui sera d''une agréable odeur à l''Eternel.
verses.am: ካህኑም በመገኛኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ባለው በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ ደሙን ይረጨዋል፥ ስቡንም ለእግዚአብሔር ጣፋጭ ሽታ እንዲሆን ያቃጥለዋል።

verses.en: And they shall no more offer their sacrifices unto devils, after whom they have gone a whoring. This shall be a statute for ever unto them throughout their generations.
verses.fr: Ils n''offriront plus leurs sacrifices aux boucs, avec lesquels ils se prostituent. Ce sera une loi perpétuelle pour eux et pour leurs descendants.
verses.am: መሥዋዕታቸውንም ደግሞ ተከትለው ላመነዘሩባቸው ለሰይጣናት አይሠዉ። ይህ ለእነርሱ ለልጅ ልጃቸው ለዘላለም ሥርዓት ይሁን።

verses.en: And thou shalt say unto them, Whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers which sojourn among you, that offereth a burnt offering or sacrifice,
verses.fr: Tu leur diras donc: Si un homme de la maison d''Israël ou des étrangers qui séjournent au milieu d''eux offre un holocauste ou une victime,
verses.am: ለእነርሱም እንዲህ በላቸው። ከእስራኤል ቤት በመካከላቸውም ከሚኖሩ እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው የሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት ወይም ሌላ መሥዋዕት ቢያቀርብ፥

verses.en: And bringeth it not unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, to offer it unto the Lord; even that man shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.fr: et ne l''amène pas à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, pour l''offrir en sacrifice à l''Eternel, cet homme-là sera retranché de son peuple.
verses.am: ለእግዚአብሔር ይሠዋ ዘንድ ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ባያመጣው፥ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And whatsoever man there be of the house of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, that eateth any manner of blood; I will even set my face against that soul that eateth blood, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.fr: Si un homme de la maison d''Israël ou des étrangers qui séjournent au milieu d''eux mange du sang d''une espèce quelconque, je tournerai ma face contre celui qui mange le sang, et je le retrancherai du milieu de son peuple.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች ወይም በመካከላቸው ከሚኖሩ እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው ደም ቢበላ፥ ደም በሚበላው በዚያ ሰው ላይ ፊቴን አከብድበታለሁ፥ ያንንም ሰው ከሕዝቡ ለይቼ አጠፋዋለሁ።

verses.en: For the life of the flesh is in the blood: and I have given it to you upon the altar to make an atonement for your souls: for it is the blood that maketh an atonement for the soul.
verses.fr: Car l''âme de la chair est dans le sang. Je vous l''ai donné sur l''autel, afin qu''il servît d''expiation pour vos âmes, car c''est par l''âme que le sang fait l''expiation.
verses.am: የሥጋ ሕይወት በደሙ ውስጥ ነውና፤ ደሙም ከሕይወቱ የተነሣ ያስተሰርያልና በመሠዊያው ላይ ለነፍሳችሁ ማስተስረያ ይሆን ዘንድ እኔ ለእናንተ ሰጠሁት።

verses.en: Therefore I said unto the children of Israel, No soul of you shall eat blood, neither shall any stranger that sojourneth among you eat blood.
verses.fr: C''est pourquoi j''ai dit aux enfants d''Israël: Personne d''entre vous ne mangera du sang, et l''étranger qui séjourne au milieu de vous ne mangera pas du sang.
verses.am: ስለዚህ የእስራኤልን ልጆች። ከእናንተ ማንም ደምን አይበላም፥ በመካከላችሁም ከሚኖሩ እንግዶች ማንም ደምን አይበላም አልሁ።

verses.en: And whatsoever man there be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn among you, which hunteth and catcheth any beast or fowl that may be eaten; he shall even pour out the blood thereof, and cover it with dust.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un des enfants d''Israël ou des étrangers qui séjournent au milieu d''eux prend à la chasse un animal ou un oiseau qui se mange, il en versera le sang et le couvrira de poussière.
verses.am: ከእስራኤልም ልጆች በመካከላቸውም ከሚኖሩ እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው የሚበላ እንስሳ ወይም ወፍ እያደነ ቢይዝ፥ ደሙን ያፈስሳል በአፈርም ይከድነዋል።

verses.en: For it is the life of all flesh; the blood of it is for the life thereof: therefore I said unto the children of Israel, Ye shall eat the blood of no manner of flesh: for the life of all flesh is the blood thereof: whosoever eateth it shall be cut off.
verses.fr: Car l''âme de toute chair, c''est son sang, qui est en elle. C''est pourquoi j''ai dit aux enfants d''Israël: Vous ne mangerez le sang d''aucune chair; car l''âme de toute chair, c''est son sang: quiconque en mangera sera retranché.
verses.am: የሥጋ ሁሉ ሕይወትና ደሙ አንድ ነውና ስለዚህ ለእስራኤል ልጆች። የሥጋ ሁሉ ሕይወት ደሙ ነውና የሥጋውን ሁሉ ደም አትብሉ፤ የሚበላውም ሁሉ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ አልኋቸው።

verses.en: And every soul that eateth that which died of itself, or that which was torn with beasts, whether it be one of your own country, or a stranger, he shall both wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and be unclean until the even: then shall he be clean.
verses.fr: Toute personne, indigène ou étrangère, qui mangera d''une bête morte ou déchirée, lavera ses vêtements, se lavera dans l''eau, et sera impure jusqu''au soir; puis elle sera pure.
verses.am: የሞተውን ወይም አውሬ የሰበረውን የሚበላ ሰው ሁሉ፥ የአገር ልጅ ወይም እንግዳ ቢሆን፥ ልብሱን ያጥባል፥ በውኃም ይታጠባል፥ እስከ ማታም ርኩስ ይሆናል፤ ከዚያም በኋላ ንጹሕ ይሆናል።

verses.en: But if he wash them not, nor bathe his flesh; then he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.fr: Si elle ne lave pas ses vêtements, et ne lave pas son corps, elle portera la peine de sa faute.
verses.am: ልብሱንና ገላውን ባያጥብ ግን ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Parle aux enfants d''Israël, et tu leur diras: Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች እንዲህ ብለህ ንገራቸው። እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: After the doings of the land of Egypt, wherein ye dwelt, shall ye not do: and after the doings of the land of Canaan, whither I bring you, shall ye not do: neither shall ye walk in their ordinances.
verses.fr: Vous ne ferez point ce qui se fait dans le pays d''Egypte où vous avez habité, et vous ne ferez point ce qui se fait dans le pays de Canaan où je vous mène: vous ne suivrez point leurs usages.
verses.am: እንደ ተቀመጣችሁባት እንደ ግብፅ ምድር ሥራ አትሥሩ፤ እኔም ወደ እርስዋ እንደማገባችሁ እንደ ከነዓን ምድር ሥራ አትሥሩ፤ በሥርዓታቸውም አትሂዱ።

verses.en: Ye shall do my judgments, and keep mine ordinances, to walk therein: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Vous pratiquerez mes ordonnances, et vous observerez mes lois: vous les suivrez. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ፍርዴን አድርጉ፥ በእርስዋም ትሄዱ ዘንድ ሥርዓቴን ጠብቁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes, and my judgments: which if a man do, he shall live in them: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous observerez mes lois et mes ordonnances: l''homme qui les mettra en pratique vivra par elles. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: የሚሠራቸው ሰው በእነርሱ በሕይወት ይኖራልና ሥርዓቴንና ፍርዴን ጠብቁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: None of you shall approach to any that is near of kin to him, to uncover their nakedness: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Nul de vous ne s''approchera de sa parente, pour découvrir sa nudité. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከእናንተም ማንም ሰው ኃፍረተ ሥጋውን ይገልጥ ዘንድ ወደ ዘመዱ ሁሉ አይቅረብ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father, or the nakedness of thy mother, shalt thou not uncover: she is thy mother; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de ton père, ni la nudité de ta mère. C''est ta mère: tu ne découvriras point sa nudité.
verses.am: የአባትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋና የእናትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ እናትህ ናት፤ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን አትግለጥ።

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father's wife shalt thou not uncover: it is thy father's nakedness.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de la femme de ton père. C''est la nudité de ton père.
verses.am: የአባትህን ሚስት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የአባትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ነው።

verses.en: The nakedness of thy sister, the daughter of thy father, or daughter of thy mother, whether she be born at home, or born abroad, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de ta soeur, fille de ton père ou fille de ta mère, née dans la maison ou née hors de la maison.
verses.am: የእኅትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የአባትህ ልጅ ወይም የእናትህ ልጅ፥ በቤት ወይም በውጭ የተወለደች ብትሆን፥ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን አትግለጥ።

verses.en: The nakedness of thy son's daughter, or of thy daughter's daughter, even their nakedness thou shalt not uncover: for theirs is thine own nakedness.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de la fille de ton fils ou de la fille de ta fille. Car c''est ta nudité.
verses.am: የወንድ ልጅህን ሴት ልጅ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን ወይም የሴት ልጅህን ሴት ልጅ ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የአንተ ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ነውና።

verses.en: The nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter, begotten of thy father, she is thy sister, thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de la fille de la femme de ton père, née de ton père. C''est ta soeur.
verses.am: ከአባትህ የተወለደችውን የአባትህን ሚስት ልጅ ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ እህትህ ናት፤ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን አትግለጥ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's sister: she is thy father's near kinswoman.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de la soeur de ton père. C''est la proche parente de ton père.
verses.am: የአባትህን እኅት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የአባትህ ዘመድ ናት።

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy mother's sister: for she is thy mother's near kinswoman.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de la soeur de ta mère. Car c''est la proche parente de ta mère.
verses.am: የእናትህን እኅት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የእናትህ ዘመድ ናት።

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy father's brother, thou shalt not approach to his wife: she is thine aunt.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité du frère de ton père. Tu ne t''approcheras point de sa femme. C''est ta tante.
verses.am: የአባትህን ወንድም ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፥ ወደ ሚስቱም አትቅረብ፤ የአጎትህ ሚስት ናት።

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy daughter in law: she is thy son's wife; thou shalt not uncover her nakedness.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de ta belle-fille. C''est la femme de ton fils: tu ne découvriras point sa nudité.
verses.am: የምራትህን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የልጅህ ሚስት ናት፤ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን አትግለጥ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife: it is thy brother's nakedness.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité de la femme de ton frère. C''est la nudité de ton frère.
verses.am: የወንድምህን ሚስት ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የወንድምህ ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ነው።

verses.en: Thou shalt not uncover the nakedness of a woman and her daughter, neither shalt thou take her son's daughter, or her daughter's daughter, to uncover her nakedness; for they are her near kinswomen: it is wickedness.
verses.fr: Tu ne découvriras point la nudité d''une femme et de sa fille. Tu ne prendras point la fille de son fils, ni la fille de sa fille, pour découvrir leur nudité. Ce sont tes proches parentes: c''est un crime.
verses.am: የሴትንና የሴት ልጅዋን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ አትግለጥ፤ የወንድ ልጅዋን ሴት ልጅ ወይም የሴት ልጅዋን ሴት ልጅ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን ትግለጥ ዘንድ አታግባ፤ ዘመዶች ናቸው፤ ዝሙት ነው።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou take a wife to her sister, to vex her, to uncover her nakedness, beside the other in her life time.
verses.fr: Tu ne prendras point la soeur de ta femme, pour exciter une rivalité, en découvrant sa nudité à côté de ta femme pendant sa vie.
verses.am: ሚስትህ በሕይወት ሳለች እኅትዋ ጣውንትዋ እንዳትሆን፥ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን ትገልጥ ዘንድ ከእርስዋ ጋር እኅትዋን አታግባ።

verses.en: Also thou shalt not approach unto a woman to uncover her nakedness, as long as she is put apart for her uncleanness.
verses.fr: Tu ne t''approcheras point d''une femme pendant son impureté menstruelle, pour découvrir sa nudité.
verses.am: እርስዋም በመርገምዋ ርኵሰት ሳለች ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋን ትገልጥ ዘንድ ወደ ሴት አትቅረብ።

verses.en: Moreover thou shalt not lie carnally with thy neighbour's wife, to defile thyself with her.
verses.fr: Tu n''auras point commerce avec la femme de ton prochain, pour te souiller avec elle.
verses.am: እንዳትረክስባትም ከባልንጀራህ ሚስት ጋር አትተኛ።

verses.en: And thou shalt not let any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu ne livreras aucun de tes enfants pour le faire passer à Moloc, et tu ne profaneras point le nom de ton Dieu. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ከዘርህም ለሞሎክ በእሳት አሳልፈህ አትስጥ፥ የአምላክህንም ስም አታርክስ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not lie with mankind, as with womankind: it is abomination.
verses.fr: Tu ne coucheras point avec un homme comme on couche avec une femme. C''est une abomination.
verses.am: ከሴትም ጋር እንደምትተኛ ከወንድ ጋር አትተኛ፤ ጸያፍ ነገር ነውና።

verses.en: Neither shalt thou lie with any beast to defile thyself therewith: neither shall any woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto: it is confusion.
verses.fr: Tu ne coucheras point avec une bête, pour te souiller avec elle. La femme ne s''approchera point d''une bête, pour se prostituer à elle. C''est une confusion.
verses.am: እንዳትረክስባትም ከእንሰሳ ጋር አትተኛ፤ ሴት ከእርሱ ጋር ትተኛ ዘንድ በእንስሳ ፊት አትቁም፤ የተጠላ ነገር ነውና።

verses.en: Defile not ye yourselves in any of these things: for in all these the nations are defiled which I cast out before you:
verses.fr: Ne vous souillez par aucune de ces choses, car c''est par toutes ces choses que se sont souillées les nations que je vais chasser devant vous.
verses.am: በእነዚህ ሁሉ ከፊታችሁ የማሳድዳቸው አሕዛብ ረክሰዋልና በእነዚህ ነገሮች ሁሉ አትርከሱ።

verses.en: And the land is defiled: therefore I do visit the iniquity thereof upon it, and the land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants.
verses.fr: Le pays en a été souillé; je punirai son iniquité, et le pays vomira ses habitants.
verses.am: ምድሪቱም ረከሰች፤ ስለዚህ ኃጢአትዋን በእርስዋ ላይ እመልሳለሁ፥ ምድሪቱም የሚኖሩባትን ሰዎች ትተፋለች።

verses.en: Ye shall therefore keep my statutes and my judgments, and shall not commit any of these abominations; neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you:
verses.fr: Vous observerez donc mes lois et mes ordonnances, et vous ne commettrez aucune de ces abominations, ni l''indigène, ni l''étranger qui séjourne au milieu de vous.
verses.am: ሥርዓቴንና ፍርዴን ጠብቁ፤ እናንተም የአገሩ ልጆች በእናንተም መካከል የሚኖሩት እንግዶች ከዚህ ርኵሰት ምንም አትሥሩ፤

verses.en: (For all these abominations have the men of the land done, which were before you, and the land is defiled;)
verses.fr: Car ce sont là toutes les abominations qu''ont commises les hommes du pays, qui y ont été avant vous; et le pays en a été souillé.
verses.am: ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩ የአገሩ ልጆች ይህን ርኵሰት ሁሉ ሠርተዋልና፥ ምድሪቱም ረክሳለችና፤

verses.en: That the land spue not you out also, when ye defile it, as it spued out the nations that were before you.
verses.fr: Prenez garde que le pays ne vous vomisse, si vous le souillez, comme il aura vomi les nations qui y étaient avant vous.
verses.am: ባረከሳችኋት ጊዜ ምድሪቱ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበረውን ሕዝብ እንደ ተፋች እናንተን እንዳትተፋችሁ።

verses.en: For whosoever shall commit any of these abominations, even the souls that commit them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.fr: Car tous ceux qui commettront quelqu''une de ces abominations seront retranchés du milieu de leur peuple.
verses.am: ከዚህ ርኵሰት ሁሉ ማናቸውን የሚያደርግ ያ ሰው ከሕዝቡ መካከል ተለይቶ ይጠፋልና።

verses.en: Therefore shall ye keep mine ordinance, that ye commit not any one of these abominable customs, which were committed before you, and that ye defile not yourselves therein: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Vous observerez mes commandements, et vous ne pratiquerez aucun des usages abominables qui se pratiquaient avant vous, vous ne vous en souillerez pas. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ስለዚህ ከእናንተ በፊት የነበሩ ሰዎች የሠሩትን ጸያፍ የሆነውን ወግ ሁሉ እንዳትሠሩ፥ በእርሱም እንዳትረክሱ ሥርዓቴን ጠብቁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Speak unto all the congregation of the children of Israel, and say unto them, Ye shall be holy: for I the Lord your God am holy.
verses.fr: Parle à toute l''assemblée des enfants d''Israël, et tu leur diras: Soyez saints, car je suis saint, moi, l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ለእስራኤል ልጆች ማኅበር ሁሉ እንዲህ ባላቸው። እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ቅዱስ ነኝና እናንተ ቅዱሳን ሁኑ።

verses.en: Ye shall fear every man his mother, and his father, and keep my sabbaths: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Chacun de vous respectera sa mère et son père, et observera mes sabbats. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ከእናንተ ሰው ሁሉ እናቱንና አባቱን ይፍራ፥ ሰንበታቴንም ጠብቁ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: Turn ye not unto idols, nor make to yourselves molten gods: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Vous ne vous tournerez point vers les idoles, et vous ne vous ferez point des dieux de fonte.
verses.am: ወደ ጣዖታትም ዘወር አትበሉ፥ ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም የአማልክት ምስሎች ለእናንተ አታድርጉ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: And if ye offer a sacrifice of peace offerings unto the Lord, ye shall offer it at your own will.
verses.fr: Quand vous offrirez à l''Eternel un sacrifice d''actions de grâces, vous l''offrirez en sorte qu''il soit agréé.
verses.am: የደኅንነትንም መሥዋዕት ለእግዚአብሔር ስትሰዉ እርሱን ደስ እንድታሰኙበት ሠዉት።

verses.en: It shall be eaten the same day ye offer it, and on the morrow: and if ought remain until the third day, it shall be burnt in the fire.
verses.fr: La victime sera mangée le jour où vous la sacrifierez, ou le lendemain; ce qui restera jusqu''au troisième jour sera brûlé au feu.
verses.am: በምትሠዉት ቀንና በነጋው ይበላል፤ እስከ ሦስተኛውም ቀን ድረስ ቢተርፍ በእሳት ይቃጠላል።

verses.en: And if it be eaten at all on the third day, it is abominable; it shall not be accepted.
verses.fr: Si l''on en mange le troisième jour, ce sera une chose infecte: le sacrifice ne sera point agréé.
verses.am: በሦስተኛውም ቀን ቢበላ ጸያፍ ነው፥ ደስም አያሰኝም፤

verses.en: Therefore every one that eateth it shall bear his iniquity, because he hath profaned the hallowed thing of the Lord: and that soul shall be cut off from among his people.
verses.fr: Celui qui en mangera portera la peine de son péché, car il profane ce qui est consacré à l''Eternel: cette personne-là sera retranchée de son peuple.
verses.am: የበላውም ለእግዚአብሔር የተቀደሰውን ነገር አርክሶአልና ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል፤ ያም ሰው ከሕዝቡ ተለይቶ ይጥፋ።

verses.en: And when ye reap the harvest of your land, thou shalt not wholly reap the corners of thy field, neither shalt thou gather the gleanings of thy harvest.
verses.fr: Quand vous ferez la moisson dans votre pays, tu laisseras un coin de ton champ sans le moissonner, et tu ne ramasseras pas ce qui reste à glaner.
verses.am: የምድራችሁንም መከር በሰበሰባችሁ ጊዜ የእርሻችሁን ድንበር ፈጽማችሁ አትጨዱ፥ የመከሩንም ቃርሚያ አትልቀሙ።

verses.en: And thou shalt not glean thy vineyard, neither shalt thou gather every grape of thy vineyard; thou shalt leave them for the poor and stranger: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Tu ne cueilleras pas non plus les grappes restées dans ta vigne, et tu ne ramasseras pas les grains qui en seront tombés. Tu abandonneras cela au pauvre et à l''étranger. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: የወይንህንም ቃርሚያ አትቃርም፥ የወደቀውንም የወይንህን ፍሬ አትሰብስብ፤ ለድሆችና ለእንግዶች ተወው፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: Ye shall not steal, neither deal falsely, neither lie one to another.
verses.fr: Vous ne déroberez point, et vous n''userez ni de mensonge ni de tromperie les uns envers les autres.
verses.am: አትስረቁ፥ አትካዱም፥ ከእናንተም እርስ በርሳችሁ ሐሰት አትነጋገሩ።

verses.en: And ye shall not swear by my name falsely, neither shalt thou profane the name of thy God: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous ne jurerez point faussement par mon nom, car tu profanerais le nom de ton Dieu. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በስሜም በሐሰት አትማሉ፥ የአምላካችሁንም ስም አታርክሱ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not defraud thy neighbour, neither rob him: the wages of him that is hired shall not abide with thee all night until the morning.
verses.fr: Tu n''opprimeras point ton prochain, et tu ne raviras rien par violence. Tu ne retiendras point jusqu''au lendemain le salaire du mercenaire.
verses.am: በባልንጀራህ ግፍ አታድርግ፥ አትቀማውም። የሞያተኛው ዋጋ እስከ ነገ ድረስ በአንተ ዘንድ አይደርብህ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not curse the deaf, nor put a stumblingblock before the blind, but shalt fear thy God: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu ne maudiras point un sourd, et tu ne mettras devant un aveugle rien qui puisse le faire tomber; car tu auras la crainte de ton Dieu. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ደንቆሮውን አትስደብ፥ በዕውርም ፊት ዕንቅፋት አታድርግ፥ ነገር ግን አምላክህን ፍራ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment: thou shalt not respect the person of the poor, nor honor the person of the mighty: but in righteousness shalt thou judge thy neighbour.
verses.fr: Tu ne commettras point d''iniquité dans tes jugements: tu n''auras point égard à la personne du pauvre, et tu ne favoriseras point la personne du grand, mais tu jugeras ton prochain selon la justice.
verses.am: በፍርድ ዓመፃ አታድርጉ፤ ለድሀ አታድላ፥ ባለ ጠጋውንም አታክብር፤ ነገር ግን ለባልንጀራህ በእውነት ፍረድ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour; I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu ne répandras point de calomnies parmi ton peuple. Tu ne t''élèveras point contre le sang de ton prochain. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሕዝብህ መካከል በሸንጋይነት አትዙር፤ በባልንጀራህም ደም ላይ አትቁም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt not hate thy brother in thine heart: thou shalt in any wise rebuke thy neighbour, and not suffer sin upon him.
verses.fr: Tu ne haïras point ton frère dans ton coeur; tu auras soin de reprendre ton prochain, mais tu ne te chargeras point d''un péché à cause de lui.
verses.am: ወንድምህን በልብህ አትጥላው፤ በባልንጀራህ ምክንያት ኃጢአት እንዳይሆንብህ ገሥጸው።

verses.en: Thou shalt not avenge, nor bear any grudge against the children of thy people, but thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu ne te vengeras point, et tu ne garderas point de rancune contre les enfants de ton peuple. Tu aimeras ton prochain comme toi-même. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: አትበቀልም፥ በሕዝብህም ልጆች ቂም አትያዝ፥ ነገር ግን ባልንጀራህን እንደ ራስህ ውደድ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: Ye shall keep my statutes. Thou shalt not let thy cattle gender with a diverse kind: thou shalt not sow thy field with mingled seed: neither shall a garment mingled of linen and woollen come upon thee.
verses.fr: Vous observerez mes lois. Tu n''accoupleras point des bestiaux de deux espèces différentes; tu n''ensemenceras point ton champ de deux espèces de semences; et tu ne porteras pas un vêtement tissé de deux espèces de fils.
verses.am: ሥርዓቴን ጠብቁ። እንስሳህ ከሌላ ዓይነት ጋር አይደባለቅ፤ በእርሻህም ሁለት ዓይነት ዘር አትዝራ፤ ከሁለት ዓይነት ነገር የተሠራ ልብስ አትልበስ።

verses.en: And whosoever lieth carnally with a woman, that is a bondmaid, betrothed to an husband, and not at all redeemed, nor freedom given her; she shall be scourged; they shall not be put to death, because she was not free.
verses.fr: Lorsqu''un homme couchera et aura commerce avec une femme, si c''est une esclave fiancée à un autre homme, et qui n''a pas été rachetée ou affranchie, ils seront châtiés, mais non punis de mort, parce qu''elle n''a pas été affranchie.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ከሴት ባሪያ ጋር ቢተኛ፥ እርስዋም ለባል የተሰጠች ዋጋዋም ያልተከፈለ አርነት ያልወጣች ብትሆን፥ ቅጣት አለባቸው፤ አርነት አልወጣችምና አይገደሉም።

verses.en: And he shall bring his trespass offering unto the Lord, unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, even a ram for a trespass offering.
verses.fr: L''homme amènera pour sa faute à l''Eternel, à l''entrée de la tente d''assignation, un bélier en sacrifice de culpabilité.
verses.am: እርሱም የበደሉን መሥዋዕት ይዞ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ወደ መገናኛው ድንኳን ደጃፍ ይመጣል፥ ለበደልም መሥዋዕት አውራ በግ ያመጣል።

verses.en: And the priest shall make an atonement for him with the ram of the trespass offering before the Lord for his sin which he hath done: and the sin which he hath done shall be forgiven him.
verses.fr: Le sacrificateur fera pour lui l''expiation devant l''Eternel, pour le péché qu''il a commis, avec le bélier offert en sacrifice de culpabilité, et le péché qu''il a commis lui sera pardonné.
verses.am: ካህኑም ስለ ሠራው ኃጢአት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት በበደል መሥዋዕት በግ ያስተሰርይለታል፤ የሠራውም ኃጢአት ይቀርለታል።

verses.en: And when ye shall come into the land, and shall have planted all manner of trees for food, then ye shall count the fruit thereof as uncircumcised: three years shall it be as uncircumcised unto you: it shall not be eaten of.
verses.fr: Quand vous serez entrés dans le pays, et que vous y aurez planté toutes sortes d''arbres fruitiers, vous en regarderez les fruits comme incirconcis; pendant trois ans, ils seront pour vous incirconcis; on n''en mangera point.
verses.am: ወደ አገሩም በገባችሁ ጊዜ፥ የሚበላ የፍሬ ዛፍ ሁሉ በተከላችሁም ጊዜ፥ ፍሬውን እንዳልተገረዘ ትቈጥሩታላችሁ፤ ሦስት ዓመት እንዳልተገረዘ ይሆንላችኋል፤ አይበላም።

verses.en: But in the fourth year all the fruit thereof shall be holy to praise the Lord withal.
verses.fr: La quatrième année, tous leurs fruits seront consacrés à l''Eternel au milieu des réjouissances.
verses.am: የአራተኛውም ዓመት ፍሬ ሁሉ ለእግዚአብሔር ምስጋና ቅዱስ ይሁን።

verses.en: And in the fifth year shall ye eat of the fruit thereof, that it may yield unto you the increase thereof: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: La cinquième année, vous en mangerez les fruits, et vous continuerez à les récolter. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ፍሬውም ይበዛላችሁ ዘንድ የአምስተኛውን ዓመት ፍሬ ብሉ፤ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: Ye shall not eat any thing with the blood: neither shall ye use enchantment, nor observe times.
verses.fr: Vous ne mangerez rien avec du sang. Vous n''observerez ni les serpents ni les nuages pour en tirer des pronostics.
verses.am: ከደሙ ጋር ምንም አትብሉ፤ አስማትም አታድርጉ፥ ሞራ ገላጭም አትሁኑ።

verses.en: Ye shall not round the corners of your heads, neither shalt thou mar the corners of thy beard.
verses.fr: Vous ne couperez point en rond les coins de votre chevelure, et tu ne raseras point les coins de ta barbe.
verses.am: የራስ ጠጕራችሁንም ዙሪያውን አትከርክሙት፥ ጢማችሁንም ዙሪያውን አትቍረጡት።

verses.en: Ye shall not make any cuttings in your flesh for the dead, nor print any marks upon you: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous ne ferez point d''incisions dans votre chair pour un mort, et vous n''imprimerez point de figures sur vous. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ስለ ሞተውም ሥጋችሁን አትንጩ፥ ገላችሁንም አትንቀሱት፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: Do not prostitute thy daughter, to cause her to be a whore; lest the land fall to whoredom, and the land become full of wickedness.
verses.fr: Tu ne profaneras point ta fille en la livrant à la prostitution, de peur que le pays ne se prostitue et ne se remplisse de crimes.
verses.am: ምድሪቱ ከግልሙትና ከርኵሰትም እንዳትሞላ ሴት ልጅህን ታመነዝር ዘንድ አታርክሳት።

verses.en: Ye shall keep my sabbaths, and reverence my sanctuary: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous observerez mes sabbats, et vous révérerez mon sanctuaire. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሰንበታቴን ጠብቁ፥ መቅደሴንም አክብሩ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: Regard not them that have familiar spirits, neither seek after wizards, to be defiled by them: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Ne vous tournez point vers ceux qui évoquent les esprits, ni vers les devins; ne les recherchez point, de peur de vous souiller avec eux. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: ወደ መናፍስት ጠሪዎችና ወደ ጠንቋዮች አትሂዱ፤ እንዳትረክሱባቸውም አትፈልጉአቸው፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: Thou shalt rise up before the hoary head, and honour the face of the old man, and fear thy God: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Tu te lèveras devant les cheveux blancs, et tu honoreras la personne du vieillard. Tu craindras ton Dieu. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: በሽበታሙ ፊት ተነሣ፥ ሽማግሌውንም አክብር፥ አምላክህንም ፍራ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: And if a stranger sojourn with thee in your land, ye shall not vex him.
verses.fr: Si un étranger vient séjourner avec vous dans votre pays, vous ne l''opprimerez point.
verses.am: በአገራችሁ ውስጥ ከእናንተ ጋር እንግዳ ቢቀመጥ ግፍ አታድርጉበት።

verses.en: But the stranger that dwelleth with you shall be unto you as one born among you, and thou shalt love him as thyself; for ye were strangers in the land of Egypt: I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Vous traiterez l''étranger en séjour parmi vous comme un indigène du milieu de vous; vous l''aimerez comme vous-mêmes, car vous avez été étrangers dans le pays d''Egypte. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: እናንተ በግብፅ ምድር እንግዶች ነበራችሁና ከእናንተ ጋር የሚቀመጥ እንግዳ እንደ አገር ልጅ ይሁንላችሁ፥ እርሱንም እንደ ራስህ ውደድ፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝ።

verses.en: Ye shall do no unrighteousness in judgment, in meteyard, in weight, or in measure.
verses.fr: Vous ne commettrez point d''iniquité ni dans les jugements, ni dans les mesures de dimension, ni dans les poids, ni dans les mesures de capacité.
verses.am: በፍርድ፥ በመለካትም፥ በመመዘንም፥ በመስፈርም ዓመፃ አታድርጉ።

verses.en: Just balances, just weights, a just ephah, and a just hin, shall ye have: I am the Lord your God, which brought you out of the land of Egypt.
verses.fr: Vous aurez des balances justes, des poids justes, des épha justes et des hin justes. Je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu, qui vous ai fait sortir du pays d''Egypte.
verses.am: የእውነትም ሚዛን፥ የእውነትም መመዘኛ፥ የእውነትም የኢፍ መስፈሪያ፥ የእውነትም የኢን መስፈሪያ ይሁንላችሁ፤ ከግብፅ ምድር ያወጣኋችሁ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ እኔ ነኝ።

verses.en: Therefore shall ye observe all my statutes, and all my judgments, and do them: I am the Lord.
verses.fr: Vous observerez toutes mes lois et toutes mes ordonnances, et vous les mettrez en pratique. Je suis l''Eternel.
verses.am: ሥርዓቴን ሁሉ ፍርዴንም ሁሉ ጠብቁ አድርጉም፤ እኔ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: And the Lord spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.fr: L''Eternel parla à Moïse, et dit:
verses.am: እግዚአብሔርም ሙሴን እንዲህ ብሎ ተናገረው።

verses.en: Again, thou shalt say to the children of Israel, Whosoever he be of the children of Israel, or of the strangers that sojourn in Israel, that giveth any of his seed unto Molech; he shall surely be put to death: the people of the land shall stone him with stones.
verses.fr: Tu diras aux enfants d''Israël: Si un homme des enfants d''Israël ou des étrangers qui séjournent en Israël livre à Moloc l''un de ses enfants, il sera puni de mort: le peuple du pays le lapidera.
verses.am: ደግሞ የእስራኤልን ልጆች እንዲህ በላቸው። ከእስራኤል ልጆች ወይም በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከሚቀመጡ እንግዶች ማናቸውም ሰው ዘሩን ለሞሎክ ቢሰጥ ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ የአገሩ ሕዝብ በድንጋይ ይውገረው።

verses.en: And I will set my face against that man, and will cut him off from among his people; because he hath given of his seed unto Molech, to defile my sanctuary, and to profane my holy name.
verses.fr: Et moi, je tournerai ma face contre cet homme, et je le retrancherai du milieu de son peuple, parce qu''il a livré de ses enfants à Moloc, souillé mon sanctuaire et profané mon saint nom.
verses.am: መቅደሴን ያረክስ ዘንድ፥ የተቀደሰውንም ስሜን ያጐሰቍል ዘንድ ዘሩን ለሞሎክ ሰጥቶአልና እኔ በዚያ ሰው ላይ ፊቴን አከብዳለሁ፥ ከሕዝቡም መካከል ለይቼ አጠፋዋለሁ።

verses.en: And if the people of the land do any ways hide their eyes from the man, when he giveth of his seed unto Molech, and kill him not:
verses.fr: Si le peuple du pays détourne ses regards de cet homme, qui livre de ses enfants à Moloc, et s''il ne le fait pas mourir,
verses.am: ዘሩንም ለሞሎክ ሲሰጥ፥ የአገሩ ሕዝብ ያን ቸል ቢለው ባይገድሉትም፥

verses.en: Then I will set my face against that man, and against his family, and will cut him off, and all that go a whoring after him, to commit whoredom with Molech, from among their people.
verses.fr: je tournerai, moi, ma face contre cet homme et contre sa famille, et je le retrancherai du milieu de son peuple, avec tous ceux qui se prostituent comme lui en se prostituant à Moloc.
verses.am: እኔ በዚያ ሰውና በቤተ ሰቡ ላይ ፊቴን አከብዳለሁ፤ እርሱንም፥ ከሞሎክም ጋር ያመነዝሩ ዘንድ የሚከተሉትን ሁሉ ከሕዝባቸው መካከል ለይቼ አጠፋለሁ።

verses.en: And the soul that turneth after such as have familiar spirits, and after wizards, to go a whoring after them, I will even set my face against that soul, and will cut him off from among his people.
verses.fr: Si quelqu''un s''adresse aux morts et aux esprits, pour se prostituer après eux, je tournerai ma face contre cet homme, je le retrancherai du milieu de son peuple.
verses.am: መናፍስት ጠሪዎችንና ጠንቋዮችንም በሚከተል፥ በሥራቸውም በሚያመነዝር፥ በዚያ ሰው ላይ ፊቴን አከብዳለሁ፥ ከሕዝቡም መካከል ለይቼ አጠፋዋለሁ።

verses.en: Sanctify yourselves therefore, and be ye holy: for I am the Lord your God.
verses.fr: Vous vous sanctifierez et vous serez saints, car je suis l''Eternel, votre Dieu.
verses.am: እንግዲህ እኔ እግዚአብሔር አምላካችሁ ነኝና ሰውነታችሁን ቀድሱ፥ ቅዱሳንም ሁኑ።

verses.en: And ye shall keep my statutes, and do them: I am the Lord which sanctify you.
verses.fr: Vous observerez mes lois, et vous les mettrez en pratique. Je suis l''Eternel, qui vous sanctifie.
verses.am: ሥርዓቴን ጠብቁ፥ አድርጉትም፤ እኔ የምቀድሳችሁ እግዚአብሔር ነኝ።

verses.en: For every one that curseth his father or his mother shall be surely put to death: he hath cursed his father or his mother; his blood shall be upon him.
verses.fr: Si un homme quelconque maudit son père ou sa mère, il sera puni de mort; il a maudit son père ou sa mère: son sang retombera sur lui.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው አባቱን ወይም እናቱን ቢሰድብ ፈጽሞ ይገደል፥ አባቱንና እናቱን ሰድቦአልና፤ ደሙ በራሱ ላይ ነው።

verses.en: And the man that committeth adultery with another man's wife, even he that committeth adultery with his neighbour's wife, the adulterer and the adulteress shall surely be put to death.
verses.fr: Si un homme commet un adultère avec une femme mariée, s''il commet un adultère avec la femme de son prochain, l''homme et la femme adultères seront punis de mort.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ከሌላ ሰው ሚስት ወይም ከባልንጀራው ሚስት ጋር ቢያመነዝር አመንዝራውና አመንዝራይቱ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ።

verses.en: And the man that lieth with his father's wife hath uncovered his father's nakedness: both of them shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.fr: Si un homme couche avec la femme de son père, et découvre ainsi la nudité de son père, cet homme et cette femme seront punis de mort: leur sang retombera sur eux.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ከአባቱ ሚስት ጋር ቢተኛ የአባቱን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ገልጦአል፤ ሁለቱ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ ደማቸው በላያቸው ነው።

verses.en: And if a man lie with his daughter in law, both of them shall surely be put to death: they have wrought confusion; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.fr: Si un homme couche avec sa belle-fille, ils seront tous deux punis de mort; ils ont fait une confusion: leur sang retombera sur eux.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ከምራቱ ጋር ቢተኛ ሁለቱ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ ጸያፍ ነገር አድርገዋል፤ ደማቸውም በላያቸው ነው።

verses.en: If a man also lie with mankind, as he lieth with a woman, both of them have committed an abomination: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.fr: Si un homme couche avec un homme comme on couche avec une femme, ils ont fait tous deux une chose abominable; ils seront punis de mort: leur sang retombera sur eux.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ከሴት ጋር እንደሚተኛ ከወንድ ጋር ቢተኛ ሁለቱ ጸያፍ ነገር አድርገዋል፤ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ ደማቸው በላያቸው ነው።

verses.en: And if a man take a wife and her mother, it is wickedness: they shall be burnt with fire, both he and they; that there be no wickedness among you.
verses.fr: Si un homme prend pour femmes la fille et la mère, c''est un crime: on les brûlera au feu, lui et elles, afin que ce crime n''existe pas au milieu de vous.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው እናቲቱንና ልጂቱን ቢያገባ ርኵሰት ነው፤ በመካከላችሁ ኃጢአት እንዳይሆን እርሱና እነርሱ በእሳት ይቃጠሉ።

verses.en: And if a man lie with a beast, he shall surely be put to death: and ye shall slay the beast.
verses.fr: Si un homme couche avec une bête, il sera puni de mort; et vous tuerez la bête.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ከእንስሳ ጋር ቢገናኝ ፈጽሞ ይገደል፤ እንስሳይቱንም ግደሉአት።

verses.en: And if a woman approach unto any beast, and lie down thereto, thou shalt kill the woman, and the beast: they shall surely be put to death; their blood shall be upon them.
verses.fr: Si une femme s''approche d''une bête, pour se prostituer à elle, tu tueras la femme et la bête; elles seront mises à mort: leur sang retombera sur elles.
verses.am: ማናቸይቱም ሴት ወደ እንስሳ ብትቀርብ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ብትገናኝ፥ ሴቲቱንና እንስሳውን ግደል፤ ፈጽመው ይገደሉ፤ ደማቸው በላያቸው ነው።

verses.en: And if a man shall take his sister, his father's daughter, or his mother's daughter, and see her nakedness, and she see his nakedness; it is a wicked thing; and they shall be cut off in the sight of their people: he hath uncovered his sister's nakedness; he shall bear his iniquity.
verses.fr: Si un homme prend sa soeur, fille de son père ou fille de sa mère, s''il voit sa nudité et qu''elle voie la sienne, c''est une infamie; ils seront retranchés sous les yeux des enfants de leur peuple: il a découvert la nudité de sa soeur, il portera la peine de son péché.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው የአባቱን ልጅ ወይም የእናቱን ልጅ እኅቱን ቢያገባ፥ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋንም ቢያይ፥ እርስዋም ኃፍረተ ሥጋውን ብታይ፥ ይህ ጸያፍ ነገር ነው፤ በሕዝባቸውም ልጆች ፊት ይገደሉ፤ የእኅቱን ኃፍረተ ሥጋ ገልጦአልና ኃጢአቱን ይሸከማል።

verses.en: And if a man shall lie with a woman having her sickness, and shall uncover her nakedness; he hath discovered her fountain, and she hath uncovered the fountain of her blood: and both of them shall be cut off from among their people.
verses.fr: Si un homme couche avec une femme qui a son indisposition, et découvre sa nudité, s''il découvre son flux, et qu''elle découvre le flux de son sang, ils seront tous deux retranchés du milieu de leur peuple.
verses.am: ማናቸውም ሰው ከባለ መርገም ሴት ጋር ቢተኛ ኃፍረተ ሥጋዋንም ቢገልጥ፥ ፈሳሽዋን ገልጦአልና፥ እርስዋም የደምዋን ፈሳሽ ገልጣለችና ሁለቱ ከሕዝባቸው መካከል ተለይተው ይጥፉ።
